jobs.description:
(Senior) Director, Digital Experience

A career that makes a difference!

RKD Group, a direct response marketing and advertising agency, is seeking a Director, Digital Experience or Senior Director, Digital Experience to achieve breakthrough results that make a positive impact in this world. By joining our team, you become an integral part of that mission. With our headquarters located in Dallas, Texas, RKD Group is a remote-first company that has helped hundreds of nonprofits raise billions of dollars to fulfill their missions.

The Director, Digital Experience is a senior leader responsible for the overall performance, growth, and culture of a Digital Experience team portfolio. This role sets the strategic direction for digital client engagements across their portfolio, champions innovative digital programs, drives team excellence, and serves as a senior leader to their client portfolio. The Director ensures that Digital Experience delivers measurable impact, strong client retention, and continuous innovation across all digital disciplines. The successful candidate will most likely have a strong fundraising background with solid paid media experience.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Vision

  • Lead a portfolio of high-value and/or complex client accounts as the senior strategic partner
  • Hold accountability for overall client satisfaction, retention, and revenue performance across the portfolio
  • Set the strategic vision for each account and ensure alignment of digital programs to client mission and business goals
  • Lead senior client presentations, annual reviews, and strategic planning sessions

Executive Client Partnership

  • Develop sophisticated, integrated digital strategies that span email, CRO, digital media (paid search, paid social, programmatic), texting, and emerging channels
  • Bring forward-thinking POVs on digital trends, audience behavior, and technology to client engagements
  • Lead budget development, multi-year projections, and financial reporting at the account level
  • Lead high-impact client engagements including annual strategy sessions, senior reviews, and renewal negotiations
  • Represent RKD's digital capabilities and POV with confidence and credibility

Digital Strategy & Program Excellence

  • Set standards for the development and execution of integrated digital strategies spanning email, CRO, digital media (paid search, paid social, programmatic), texting, and adjacent channels
  • Drive innovation in digital program design, ensuring RKD stays ahead of channel trends and industry best practices
  • Oversee portfolio-level performance, ensuring programs deliver against client goals and RKD benchmarks
  • Oversee budgets, revenue targets, and financial projections across their Digital Experience portfolio
  • Drive client retention, contract renewals, and scope growth

Cross-Functional & Organizational Leadership

  • Partner with Pod Managers, department heads (creative, data, technology, media delivery, SEO, organic social, marketing science, direct mail), and senior leadership to drive integrated, high-quality delivery
  • Identify and champion improvements to cross-functional workflows, tools, and processes

Business Development

  • Lead or co-lead new business efforts for digital clients, including RFPs, pitches, and proposals
  • Define and articulate RKD's digital experience value proposition in the market
  • Grow existing accounts through proactive identification of new service opportunities

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred
  • 7-10 years of experience in digital marketing, with significant leadership experience in an agency setting
  • Proven success leading integrated digital programs and managing multi-million-dollar account portfolios
  • Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills
  • Deep expertise across digital channels including email, paid media, CRO, and texting
  • Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, projections, and P&

Location: remote.

Qualified candidates, please apply to this position using the link below.

Pay Range expected for the position: $110,000 - $130,000 annually.

(The position level and compensation for this role will be determined based on the market location, experience, job skills, and qualifications of the candidate.)

RKD Group offers highly competitive compensation commensurate with experience, and a full range of benefits.

RKD Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

No sponsorships available for this position.

Title: SVP, Global Head of Brand and Communications

Location: All of CAN & All of US - Remote

The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei, Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

This senior leadership role will play a pivotal part in shaping Nuvei’s global presence, guiding communication strategies, and ensuring our message resonates with key stakeholders. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), the role will also work closely with the CEO and the broader leadership team. You will lead a high-performing team of PR, social, and internal communications professionals, driving consistency, innovation, and excellence in all communications efforts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Corporate Narrative & Strategy: Partner with leadership to define and continuously refine Nuvei’s corporate narrative, ensuring alignment with our strategic goals and market positioning.
  • Comprehensive Communication Strategy: Develop and execute an integrated communications strategy that reinforces Nuvei’s brand identity and communicates our value proposition across diverse platforms.
  • Storytelling & Key Events: Lead the creation of impactful storytelling around significant corporate milestones, including mergers and acquisitions, product launches, client successes, senior leadership appointments, and ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) initiatives.
  • Messaging & Voice: Establish a unified and consistent corporate voice across all communications, coaching internal teams and executives to maintain cohesion and clarity in messaging.
  • Media Relations & Visibility: Build and nurture relationships with top-tier media outlets, industry analysts, and influencers to secure broad and strategic media coverage for Nuvei. Ensure maximum visibility for the company, its leadership, and its achievements.
  • Crisis Management: Develop and manage a robust crisis communications plan, including rapid-response strategies and reputation management protocols, ensuring Nuvei is prepared to handle any challenges effectively.
  • • Executive Thought Leadership: Position Nuvei’s CEO and executive leadership team as thought leaders in the fintech, technology, and payments sectors. Secure high-profile media placements and public speaking opportunities in top-tier business and financial outlets.
  • Media Training & Development: Design and implement comprehensive media training programs for senior executives and key spokespersons to enhance their media presence and communication skills. • Industry Thought Leadership: Cultivate strong relationships with influential journalists, analysts, and industry experts, positioning Nuvei as a leading voice in the fintech and e-commerce space.
  • Social Media Strategy: Oversee the development and execution of a strategic social media plan to amplify Nuvei’s brand message, engage with stakeholders, and drive thought leadership across relevant platforms.
  • Employer Brand & Talent Acquisition: Partner with HR to craft and execute Nuvei’s employer branding strategy, supporting talent acquisition and recruitment efforts to attract top-tier candidates.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire the communications team, fostering a culture of creativity, innovation, and continuous improvement while driving measurable results.
  • Performance Metrics & Optimization: Develop and implement key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate the effectiveness of communication initiatives, adjusting strategies as needed to maximize impact.
  • Internal & External Communication Alignment: Ensure seamless alignment of internal and external messaging to maintain consistency and clarity across all communication channels and stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the product, marketing, and business development teams to communicate Nuvei’s technological innovations and market differentiators, driving growth and brand awareness.

Requirements

  • 15+ years of experience in corporate communications, public relations, or related fields, with strong strategic and leadership skills.
  • Expertise: Demonstrated success in developing corporate narratives, building brand positioning, and crafting high-impact communication strategies.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of B2B communications in fintech, technology, e-commerce, or payments industries.
  • Media Relationships: Proven ability to cultivate relationships with top-tier business and financial media outlets, as well as trade publications.
  • Leadership: Strong leadership skills with experience managing, coaching, and motivating senior content experts and communications professionals.
  • Skills: Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling abilities across a range of formats and platforms.

Benefits

Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can’t wait to meet you.

Working Language
English (written and spoken) is the language used most of the time, as work colleagues, clients, and strategic suppliers are geographically dispersed.

Our recruitment process may use automated tools, including AI, to support application management and candidate shortlisting.

Solution Architect - Digital & AI Products

In our Service Supply Chain offering, we leverage a combination of proprietary technology and client systems to develop, execute, and deliver BPaaS (business process as a service) or Managed Service solutions across the service lifecycle: Plan, Deliver, and Recover. Join our dynamic Service Supply Chain (SSC) team and be at the forefront of helping world class organizations unlock their full potential. Imagine a career where your innovative work makes a real impact, and every day brings new challenges and opportunities for growth. We're on the lookout for passionate, talented individuals ready to make a difference. If you're eager to shape the future and drive success, this is your chance—join us now and let’s build something extraordinary together!


About the Role

We are seeking a Solution Architect to design innovative digital solutions that help organizations improve operational performance, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role bridges business strategy, product management, technology architecture, and implementation delivery. You will translate complex business problems into scalable technology solutions by connecting business objectives, architecture decisions, and implementation trade-offs. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and hands-on problem solver who can simplify complexity and guide organizations from idea to execution.


What You'll Do

You will be expected to answer critical questions such as:

• What business problem are we solving?

• How does the solution align with broader product and technology strategies?

• What capabilities are required to achieve the desired outcomes?

• Which systems, platforms, and data sources should be involved?

• How should systems integrate and exchange information?

• What are the trade-offs between cost, speed, risk, scalability, and maintainability?


Core Responsibilities

• Design end-to-end solution architectures for digital products and platforms.

• Develop business process flows, capability maps, architecture diagrams, and solution blueprints.

• Translate business requirements into scalable technical designs.

• Partner with Product Managers and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.

• Define integration strategies across enterprise applications, platforms, APIs, and third-party systems.

• Evaluate technology options and recommend fit-for-purpose solutions.

• Support AI, analytics, automation, and data-driven solution initiatives.

• Ensure architecture decisions consider scalability, security, governance, reliability, and operational supportability.

• Guide delivery teams through implementation and deployment.

• Communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Systems Architecture, Enterprise Applications, or Product Engineering.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience solutioning for API integrations

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI, machine learning, analytics platforms, and intelligent automation.
  • Knowledge of supply chain, logistics, service operations, field service, or enterprise workflow technologies.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures and modern software patterns.
  • Knowledge of data governance, responsible AI, security, and compliance requirements.
  • Agile delivery and product development experience.

Professional Skills Requirements:

  • Experience designing distributed systems and enterprise integrations
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Innovation and value creation
  • Structured problem solving
  • Experience creating architecture artifacts and process maps

Business Operations Specialist

Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers, don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As a Business Operations Specialist, your role will be pivotal to the business operations of an Oceans client. When paired with a visionary leader, you’ll ensure that the critical operations within their business run smoothly, efficiently, and effectively. You'll be the backbone of operations, driving everything from strategic coordination to problem-solving while making sure that business functions align perfectly with overarching goals. Your contributions will be the driving force that helps scale and grow the business.

Accountability

Your success as a Business Operations Specialist will be measured by your ability to optimize processes, enhance operational efficiency, and support sustainable business growth.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Operational Excellence & Business Coordination

  • Ensure seamless day-to-day operations by managing workflows, optimizing internal processes, and maintaining clear documentation.
  • Draft company policies, SOPs, and internal guidelines to enhance structure and clarity.
  • Identify inefficiencies in business operations and implement practical solutions to improve overall performance.
  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives, ensuring teams are aligned with key business objectives.

Performance & Stakeholder Management

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure operational success and identify areas for improvement.
  • Manage the flow of critical business information, ensuring the Executive has timely access to relevant insights.
  • Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate smooth operations and decision-making.

Strategic Growth & Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate with the client to identify opportunities for business scalability and efficiency.
  • Implement best practices and support long-term strategic planning efforts to drive sustainable growth.
  • Adapt to evolving business needs, proactively optimizing operations to meet company goals.

Correspondence & Communication

  • Serve as the point of contact for your client’s emails, phone calls, and other professional communication, ensuring responses are timely and professional.
  • Manage and streamline the flow of information to ensure your client receives all the relevant updates and data they need.
  • Prepare and organize materials for meetings, including agendas, presentations, and reports.

Colleagues

Your primary stakeholders will be the Executive you will be paired with, alongside their internal teams and stakeholders. Together you’ll ensure smooth operations and continued business growth. Depending on your area of focus, you may collaborate closely with Customer Success, Sales, or other operational teams.

At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Business Operations Specialist, your vertical focus will be on optimizing business operations, ensuring workflows, processes, and cross-functional coordination drive efficiency. Your horizontal focus will cover strategic thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management—giving you the tools to identify inefficiencies, drive improvements, and collaborate seamlessly across teams. You’ll be expected to balance high-level strategy with hands-on execution, a key component of delivering impactful results that fuel business success.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Language Skills: Professional fluency in English, with excellent reading, writing, and speaking abilities.
  • Experience: At least 3 years in a communication-heavy role at a reputable firm, demonstrating strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Education: An undergraduate degree is preferred, though relevant work experience is also valued. Certifications such as an MBA, CFA, CIM, CIPM, or CIMA will be considered as an added advantage

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Business Acumen / Operational Excellence with Attention-to-Detail: How have you managed and improved business processes while maintaining a strong attention to detail?
  • Thinking Ahead & Problem-Solving: How have you proactively identified and resolved inefficiencies in a business function?
  • Stakeholder Management & Empathetic Communications: How have you effectively coordinated across teams to ensure alignment and clear communication?
  • Strategic Thinking & Time Management: How do you align daily operations with broader business strategy and goals?
  • Leadership & Collaboration: Have you successfully managed or guided teams toward operational success while taking ownership and fostering a collaborative environment?
  • Tech proficiency: How have you utilized technology or tools to streamline processes and drive efficiency in business operations?

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

jobs.description:
The Stanford Center for Clinical Research (CRH) is a growing academic research organization within the Stanford Department of Medicine. Our mission is to conduct and promote high-impact, innovative clinical research to improve human health.

CRH is seeking a Clinical Research Operations Specialist II to conduct and manage a large multi-site clinical trial. Research will be conducted in cardiovascular medicine. The Clinical Research Operations Specialist II will be responsible for providing study sites with live support and the overall site management of virtual and multisite operations. This position will be the main point of contact for the study sponsor and the study PI.

In addition to the core duties described below, this position will be responsible for the following: a) providing study sites with live support for time-sensitive requests; b) leading efforts in collection of participant safety data; b) reviewing study Operations Manuals and Documents; and c) providing non-urgent support to study sites that impact enrollment and safety.

At CRH, we strive to find team members who are passionate about their work, flexible, fun, and want to deliver results. We place a high priority on equipping our staff to perform their job efficiently, helping them acquire new skills and grow within the organization. We encourage our team to have a healthy balance between work commitments and life outside of work and provide support to achieve this balance. If you are looking to make a large impact through global-reaching clinical research, we encourage you to apply!

This is a remote position.

jobs.description:
HoopStars | Parent-company Marketing Team Lead

Full-time. Remote from LATAM. Toronto working hours. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

Build the business. Build the marketing team.

HoopStars is a Toronto-based youth basketball business with recurring customers and technology-enabled operations. We are looking for a hands-on General Manager whose strongest skills are marketing, ecommerce and profitable growth, and who can take responsibility for the whole business.

You will divide your time approximately equally between running HoopStars and building and managing the parent company Community Sports Partners' marketing team across its brands. This is one vacancy advertised across multiple locations. Candidates elsewhere in LATAM are also welcome; apply once using your preferred location listing.

You should understand how to turn advertising into customers, improve conversion, increase repeat purchases and make the numbers work. You will also own budgets, operating performance and the team delivering the customer experience.

What you will own

  • Run HoopStars: Own its business plan, budget, revenue, profitability and cash forecasts. Lead sales and operations, ensuring programmes, coaches, venues and service quality keep pace with demand.
  • Drive digital growth: Improve paid search and social, creative, landing pages, enrollment funnels, pricing, offers, referrals and retention.
  • Build the parent marketing team: Define the structure, recruit specialists, appoint contractors or agencies where useful, and manage priorities and performance across brands.
  • Establish commercial discipline: Connect campaign performance to paying customers, repeat enrollment and contribution profit. Allocate marketing investment using reliable reporting and testing.
  • Stay close to execution: Inspect advertising accounts, diagnose funnel problems and help launch improvements yourself while building a team that can execute consistently.

Support and autonomy

The parent provides bookkeeping assistance, HR support, IT and website support, and a local manager covering customer service and day-to-day sales. You will propose budgets and team plans, then make operating decisions within agreed authority. After onboarding, the founder expects a monthly business review, supported by clear weekly reporting and escalation of exceptional issues.

Your first 90 days

Understand the customers, operations and economics. Audit marketing across the brands. Establish reporting, propose the marketing team structure and hiring priorities, launch the first growth tests, and take ownership of normal HoopStars business decisions.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You may have built an ecommerce business, led growth for a consumer brand, run a digital agency with meaningful operating responsibility, or managed a business where digital acquisition was central to its success.

  • Demonstrated results in paid acquisition, conversion and retention.
  • Commercial responsibility beyond a marketing budget: pricing, margins, staffing, forecasts or business profitability.
  • Experience hiring and managing marketers, creatives, agencies or other specialists.
  • Ability to translate ecommerce methods into a service business with real delivery capacity and customer commitments.
  • Comfort doing practical work while developing people and systems.
  • Strong professional English and effective remote leadership.

jobs.description:
About Unlimit

Unlimit is the global financial infrastructure for the borderless agentic economy. Designed to bridge the gap between fragmented local markets and the future of autonomous commerce, Unlimit provides the programmable operating layer for the world’s most ambitious businesses.

Through an integrated technology stack, the platform unifies global payment acceptance, programmable financial accounts, and digital asset rails into a singular financial layer. By mapping hyper-local payment ecosystems directly into its architecture, Unlimit enables businesses to move value and settle transactions instantly across continents.

Built on decades of hard-won regulatory depth and an extensive global license portfolio, the platform provides direct access to a massive global infrastructure. With major hubs in London, San Francisco, Singapore, São Paulo, and Mexico City, Unlimit is building the infrastructure that makes global expansion a matter of code, not geography.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager with a true headhunter mindset. You love the hunt: you go after passive candidates, find people who are not on the market, and keep going when the first, second, and tenth outreach get no answer. You own your vacancies end to end, set your own pace and priorities, and don't need anyone to check in on you to deliver.

Your focus will be commercial hiring across the UK and Europe: senior commercial leadership and account management teams, from individual contributors to regional heads. From time to time you will also pick up other business roles as priorities shift. You will act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and executives.

What You'll Do

    • Own full-cycle hiring for commercial roles across the UK and Europe, from senior leadership to account management, from kickoff with the hiring manager to signed offer

    • Run executive search projects: market mapping, target company lists, talent pools, direct approach to passive candidates

    • Source relentlessly across LinkedIn, professional communities, referrals, events and your own network; build pipelines where there were none

    • Craft outreach that gets replies and turn "not looking" into "let's talk"

    • Advise hiring managers on the market: talent availability, compensation expectations, realistic profiles and timelines

    • Assess candidates in depth and present shortlists with clear arguments, not just CVs

    • Manage offers and negotiations, and keep candidates engaged until their first day

    • Keep Lever data clean and report on pipeline health and hiring results

    • Share your search know-how with the team and help raise the bar on sourcing.

What We're Looking For

    • 6+ years in recruitment, with a strong focus on sourcing and direct search

    • Proven executive search experience: you have closed senior and C-level roles through direct approach

    • Ideally, a background that combines a recruitment or executive search agency, an in-house team and an international fintech or payments company, with around 2 years or more in each. Other paths are welcome if you bring the same hunting skills

    • Strong track record of hiring commercial roles (sales, business development, account management) in the UK and Europe

    • Self-driven and autonomous: you plan your own work, raise blockers early and don't need micromanagement

    • Persistence and resilience: a "no" from a candidate is the start of the conversation, not the end

    • Strong stakeholder management: confident with senior hiring managers and executives

    • English at C1 level or higher, written and spoken

    • Fluent Russian.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote role within the European time zone

  • Senior, high-impact searches with direct access to leadership

  • Corporate Claude license and the full sourcing toolkit you need to succeed

  • Freedom to choose your own approach

  • A team of international TA professionals to learn from and share with

  • Multicultural working environment in a fast-growing global fintech

  • Vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays

  • Company-provided laptop.


Join Unlimit Team now!

Unlimit is an equal opportunity employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

About Us

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

About the Role

The best sales leaders don't inherit a machine. They build one.

As VP of Commercial Sales, you will own the end-to-end performance of our high-velocity acquisition engine. You will lead managers and Account Executives, and turn market potential into predictable ARR through disciplined process, not heroics. You will report to the CRO and sit at the center of Marketing, RevOps, Partnerships, and Product, shaping how nonprofits discover and adopt our platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Commercial revenue strategy, driving new business and expansion against ambitious ARR targets.
  • Scale an organization of 15+ people, including frontline managers and Account Executives, and build a leadership bench by coaching managers directly.

  • Lead the adoption of sales technology and RevOps infrastructure that removes manual work and raises rep productivity.
  • Build an inclusive, high-performance culture that ties professional growth to mission-driven results.

At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. In this role, that means using AI to measurably improve sales outcomes, and leading your team to do the same.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 10+ years in B2B SaaS sales, including 5+ years leading managers.

Nice to Have

You'll Thrive Here If You…

  • Build systems first, then trust the system to scale, instead of relying on individual heroics.
  • Treat forecasting and pipeline hygiene as non-negotiable, not administrative overhead.
  • Coach managers to coach their teams, rather than solving every deal yourself.
  • Move fast on decisions, then adjust based on data instead of waiting for certainty.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Interface Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions that connect clinical laboratories with hospital, laboratory, and medical practice information systems (HIS), electronic health records (EHR), and other healthcare systems. This role ensures seamless data exchange, secure communication, and data integrity between systems to support clinical operations and improve patient care.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop, implement and support/maintain interfaces that enable the exchange of patient and lab data between hospital systems (such as HIS and EHR) and laboratory information management systems (LIMS).
  • Productivity expectations for a Corepoint Interface Engineer include:
    • Development of 3-4 concurrent interface projects, 10-15 projects yearly.
    • Complete an interface project in 90 days, or as quickly as possible given lab/client resources and competencies.
    • Handle a proportionate share of support tickets for Corepoint environment.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders including clinical laboratory staff, hospital IT teams, and vendors to define requirements and technical specifications, and clearly set and maintain expectations, challenges, and proposed solutions.
  • Implement industry-standard protocols and data formats, such as HL7, JSON or XML, to ensure interoperability between systems.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve interface-related issues, ensuring timely and accurate data flow between systems.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code for interface development and integration, without flaws, taking into account the specific needs and idiosyncrasies of each lab and hospital/medical practice.
  • Conduct testing and quality assurance to validate interfaces, ensuring data consistency, accuracy, and integrity.
  • Monitor and optimize system performance, ensuring efficient and reliable interface operations.
  • Ensure compliance with healthcare standards, regulations (HIPAA, etc.), and best practices for patient data security.
  • Participate in system upgrades, migrations, and other ongoing development efforts as needed.
  • Communicate project status and issues to the management and other stakeholders through meetings, emails and key documents.
  • Interact and clearly communicate with clients, industry peers, software support teams, and ELE staff as required.

Basic Minimum Qualifications (BMQ)

  • Deep experience designing, developing, testing, implementing, and maintaining interfaces using the Corepoint Interface Engine, including 3-5 years’ experience minimum, more preferred, particularly in the healthcare/clinical laboratory domain.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, debug, optimize and support Corepoint interfaces.
  • Familiarity with engine upgrades, version management and performance tuning.
  • Strong knowledge of HL7 messaging, ADT ORM ORU DFT, etc. and message segmentation data types and flows.
  • Experience with standards such as JSON, XML, CDA.
  • Experience with networking and file transfer protocols such as TCP-IP, VPN sFTP/FTPs), HTTP/S web services, REST/SOAP, and the requisite certificate authentication methods.
  • Experience developing APIs and integrating with external systems using secure transport and authentication methods.
  • Strong experience with data mapping and transformation, logic between source systems, laboratory LIS/LIMS, EHRs and HIS systems and other target systems through the engine.
  • Experience with software development lifecycle principles and version controls.
  • Ability to translate functional/clinical requirements into interface specifications and complete technical designs.
  • Clear effective oral and written communication skills, in the English language.

Education/Experience

  • Ten years’ experience in healthcare IT interface development with a strong emphasis on HL7, interface engine technology and requirements.
  • Extensive experience developing and maintaining interfaces in Corepoint Integration Engine.
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics or equivalent real world experience.

Ability and/or Skills

  • Strong project planning, leadership, negotiation and communication skills as well as an ability to contribute creative and practical solutions to problems.
  • Excellent organization, communication (oral and written) and attention to detail, committed to quality and timely deliverables.
  • Experience with system integration design, data flow architecture and scalable solutions design.
  • Strong testing skills, building test plans, performing interface validation, error analysis and regression testing.
  • Troubleshooting production issues, determining root causes, and implementing fixes under SLA requirements.
  • On-call support rotation capability.
  • Knowledge of clinical workflows, lab system requirements, lab order and results handling in the US clinical space.
  • Exposure to EHR systems, such as Epic, Cerner, Meditech, etc., and strong understanding of how they interface with Corepoint.
  • Understanding HIPAA and various other compliance/privacy/security requirements and compliance standards around healthcare data integration.
  • Ability to work closely with clinical stakeholders, project managers, WQA teams, vendors and cross functional IT teams.
  • Excellent documentation skills.
  • Excellent clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, self-motivation, adaptability, and a positive attitude.

What we offer:

  • Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
  • Life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid vacation and holidays

Eurofins USA Clinical Diagnostics is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. Eurofins is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. The Group also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 55,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 50 countries. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

jobs.description:
About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it Frontier.

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. If you’re interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we’ll screen you through a couple of internal interviews and aim to get you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

Think of us as your personal talent agent — and good luck with the application! 😊

About Bundle

Bundle delivers live 1:1 leadership and manager training with expert instructors. No micro-lessons, no click-through tutorials, just real conversations that build skills people actually use. We work with enterprise and mid-market companies across manufacturing, healthcare, construction, and beyond, and we’ve hit our goals six quarters in a row. Now we’re building toward where performance management meets live leadership development.

Role Overview

We’re hiring our second sales hire, and this role is built for a hunter. You will own outbound at Bundle: greenfield territory, a proven playbook built and validated by our founder, and full ownership of the pipeline you create, from first touch to close.

This is not a role where leads land in your lap. Marketing generates strong inbound today, but we’re hiring you to build the other engine. The majority of your pipeline will be self-sourced through cold outreach to CHROs, CPOs, and L&D leaders at mid-market and enterprise companies. You’ll work directly with our founder and CEO and our Head of Sales, sell alongside them, and shape how outbound works here for everyone who comes after you. If you’ve done the early-stage thing before and want to do it again with a company that’s already working, this is your seat.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and own your pipeline. Prospect daily through cold calls, email, and LinkedIn; the majority of your opportunities should be self-sourced.
  • Run the full sales cycle: identify target accounts, reach decision-makers, run discovery and pitches, negotiate pricing and terms, and close.
  • Work from and improve our proven outbound playbook, including message templates, target lists, and pain-point-led outreach.
  • Partner with marketing on shared target accounts so outbound and inbound warm the same buyers.
  • Travel to industry conferences and events to build pipeline, booking meetings before you go and sourcing new leads on the ground.
  • Hit daily, weekly, and quarterly activity and pipeline metrics.
  • Meet and exceed quarterly sales quota.
  • Track and update all sales activities and contacts in the CRM.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of full-cycle closing experience where you sourced most of your own pipeline. Be ready to walk us through what percentage of your pipeline you personally generated and how.

  • Proven success with cold outreach (calls, email, LinkedIn) and a track record of new logo acquisition in an underdeveloped or under-penetrated territory.

  • Experience selling to HR, People, or L&D buyers (CHRO, CPO, Head of L&D, or similar).

  • Startup experience at a company under 100 people, ideally as one of the first few salespeople, and a genuine preference for early-stage building over big-company infrastructure.

  • Proven track record of meeting sales quota and metrics.

  • Independent work ethic with the ability to problem-solve; outstanding verbal and written communication skills.

  • Experience with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.

Desired Requirements

  • You were an early or founding sales hire somewhere before.
  • Past experience at a performance management, leadership development, coaching, or L&D technology company.

Why Join Bundle?

  • Six straight quarters of hitting our goals, with a validated playbook waiting for you
  • Greenfield outbound territory and a direct line to the founder and CEO
  • Uncapped Commission
  • 100% remote
  • Flexible Work Schedule

Associate Ad Operations Manager

Remote (US) | Advertising Operations

A bit about us

GroundTruth is an advertising platform that turns real-world behavior into marketing that drives in-store visits and other real business results. We use observed real-world consumer behavior, including location and purchase data, to create targeted advertising campaigns across all screens, measure how consumers respond, and uncover unique insights to help optimize ongoing and future marketing efforts.

With this focus on media, measurement, and insights, we provide marketers with tools to deliver media campaigns that drive measurable impact, such as in-store visits, sales, and more.

Learn more at .

At Groundtruth, we believe that innovative technology starts with the best talent and have been ranked one of Ad Age’s Best Places to Work in 2021, 2022, 2023, & 2025! Learn more about the perks of joining our team here.

A bit about you

As an Associate Ad Operations Manager, you will support the execution and management of digital advertising campaigns across a variety of formats. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, using your knowledge of digital media and ad technology to ensure campaigns are set up accurately, deliver against client goals, and run smoothly from launch through reconciliation.

You’re someone who takes initiative, pays close attention to the details, and is comfortable troubleshooting issues and managing priorities independently while partnering closely with the broader team.

  • Intentional: We question assumptions, turn off auto-pilot, think through each task, act with purpose, and see objectives through to resolution.

Why you'll love working here

jobs.title: Assistant General Counsel, Commercial Contracts (AI, Data & IP)
jobs.excerpt: Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country.
jobs.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

The Role

We are hiring an Assistant General Counsel to own how AI, data, and related IP terms are drafted and negotiated across our commercial agreements. You will report to the Deputy General Counsel and partner with them on the full commercial portfolio, but the center of gravity of this role is the set of issues that decide whether a Machinify deal works: what our customers' data can be used for, how model training and outputs are governed, how PHI moves and is protected, and how our intellectual property is defined and preserved.

Machinify has a Chief Privacy Officer and a compliance function that set our privacy, security, and regulatory positions. This role does not own those programs. It is the person who turns their guidance into contract language that holds up at the negotiating table — and who brings real deal friction back to them so the standard can be adjusted with full information.

This is a hands-on drafting and negotiating job. You will sit across the table from health plan counsel and procurement teams, work alongside Sales and Client Success on live deals, and sit with product and engineering to make sure the contract terms and the product match.

What You'll Do

AI and data rights

  • Own the AI provisions in customer, partner, and vendor agreements — training and improvement rights, de-identification and aggregation, model and output ownership, human oversight, performance and accuracy commitments, transparency and explainability obligations, and allocation of AI-specific risk.
  • Draft and maintain the company's standard AI contract language and the fallback positions behind it, so deal teams know what is standard, what is negotiable, and what requires escalation.
  • Negotiate data use and data rights terms with sophisticated health plan customers, including secondary use, derived data, retention and deletion, and downstream restrictions.
  • Advise product and engineering on new AI features before launch — what the contracts permit, what the contracts would need to say, and where a design choice creates a legal constraint.
  • Track AI regulation and health-sector AI guidance to enable translating it into contract language and product guidance, not just memos.

Translating privacy, security, and compliance requirements into contract terms

  • Take the positions set by the Chief Privacy Officer, Compliance, and Information Security and convert them into contract language, standard clauses, and defined fallback positions.
  • Negotiate BAAs, data processing agreements, data protection schedules, and security exhibits, resolving conflicts between customer paper and our platform architecture.
  • Know HIPAA, state health privacy and consumer privacy requirements, and offshore access and subcontractor restrictions well enough to negotiate them credibly and to recognize when a customer ask exceeds what has been approved.
  • Escalate to the Chief Privacy Officer and Compliance when a deal requires a position outside the approved standard, with a clear read on what is being asked and why.
  • Close the loop back to those teams: where language repeatedly fails in negotiation, bring it back so the standard can be revised rather than re-fought deal by deal.

Intellectual property

  • Structure IP ownership, license scope, and feedback and improvement provisions so that platform-level IP stays with Machinify while customers get what they need.

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

The Italy Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-80,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

jobs.excerpt: Job OverviewWe’re looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer to build, secure, and maintain scalable platform infrastructure and delivery pipelines.
jobs.description:
Job Overview

We’re looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer to build, secure, and maintain scalable platform infrastructure and delivery pipelines. The ideal candidate combines hands-on experience with managed PaaS platforms and core AWS services (RDS, S3, Lambda) with strong capabilities in Infrastructure as Code, automated CI/CD, and transactional email deliverability. This role will collaborate closely with project leads and software engineers, establish comprehensive observability and security controls, and deliver reliable, automated, and well-documented cloud environments.

Core Tasks

1. Cloud architecture and platform

  • Assess the current infrastructure — what is running, how it is configured, what is manual, and where the risk sits — and produce a written assessment with prioritized findings.
  • Define and implement the target infrastructure across PaaS platform, e.g., Heroku, Render, Elastic Beanstalk, App Runner and supporting AWS services, with environment separation for dev / staging / production.
  • Define infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible rather than hand-configured. Terraform / CloudFormation / CDK / Pulumi, as agreed.
  • Implement IAM roles and least-privilege access, secrets management, and network configuration (VPC, security groups, TLS).

2. Data and storage layer

  • RDS: provision and tune the database — instance sizing, parameter groups, connection pooling, read replicas if warranted — and configure automated backups, point-in-time recovery, and encryption at rest.
  • Run and document a restore test. A backup that has never been restored is not a backup.
  • S3: configure buckets for uploads / assets / exports / logs with correct access policies, lifecycle rules, versioning, and encryption. No public buckets that should not be public.
  • Set up CDN delivery for static and user-uploaded assets where appropriate.

3.Serverless and background processing

  • Lambda: build and deploy the functions in scope — e.g., scheduled jobs, event-driven processing, webhook handlers, image or file processing — with appropriate triggers, concurrency limits, and timeouts.
  • Handle failure properly: retries, dead-letter queues, idempotency, and alerting on repeated failure.
  • Bring Lambda deployments into the same CI/CD pipeline and IaC definitions as the rest of the stack, not a separate manual path.

4.Email and outbound messaging

  • SMTP services: configure transactional email through SES / SendGrid / Postmark / other for e.g., account, notification, and system emails.
  • Set up domain authentication — SPF, DKIM, DMARC — and manage sending reputation, warmup, and dedicated IP if warranted.
  • Configure bounce, complaint, and suppression handling, plus deliverability monitoring so a drop in inbox placement is visible before users report it.

5. CI/CD and release engineering

  • Build pipelines in GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / CircleCI / other that run tests, lint, build, and deploy on merge, with environment promotion from staging to production.
  • Implement deployment strategy and rollback: blue-green / rolling / canary, as agreed, with a rollback that is a single documented action rather than an improvisation.
  • Automate database migrations as part of deploy, safely and reversibly.
  • Reduce pipeline runtime so the team is not waiting on it.

6. Observability, security, and cost

  • Set up centralized logging, metrics, and alerting through CloudWatch / Datadog / other, with alerts that page on real problems and stay quiet otherwise.
  • Define and monitor the health indicators that matter for the team: uptime, error rate, latency, queue depth, job failure.
  • Review the stack against HIPAA / PCI / SOC 2 / other requirements where applicable, and document what is in place and what is not.
  • Establish cost visibility and tagging; identify and remove waste.

Deliverables

  • Infrastructure assessment with prioritized findings, reviewed with project lead.
  • Architecture diagram of the target infrastructure, with data flow and trust boundaries.
  • Infrastructure as code covering all environments, in repository.
  • Configured and hardened RDS, S3, Lambda, and PaaS environments, with a documented and tested restore procedure.
  • Transactional email configured and authenticated, with deliverability monitoring in place.
  • CI/CD pipelines deploying dev / staging / production with automated tests, migrations, and one-step rollback.
  • Monitoring, logging, and alerting, with an on-call runbook covering the top failure modes and what to do about each.
  • Cost baseline and tagging scheme, with identified savings.
  • Handoff package: infrastructure documentation, access inventory, known limitations, recommended next steps, and a walkthrough with the team.

Must Haves

  • 3+ years of engineering experience
  • PaaS — production experience running applications on a managed platform, and clear judgment about where the platform's abstractions stop being enough.
  • AWS RDS — provisioning, tuning, backup and recovery, and diagnosing the database problems that surface as application slowness.
  • AWS S3 — bucket policies, lifecycle management, encryption, and secure handling of user-uploaded content.
  • AWS Lambda — building, deploying, and operating serverless functions, including their less obvious failure modes.
  • SMTP services — configuring transactional email, domain authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and deliverability management.
  • CI/CD — you have built pipelines a team actually relied on, and have made deploying boring for people who were previously nervous about it.

Nice to Haves

  • Infrastructure as code at depth in Terraform / CloudFormation / CDK.
  • Containers and orchestration where the stack calls for it.
  • Experience with HIPAA / PCI / SOC 2 compliance in a cloud environment.
  • Domain experience in medical software and/or e-commerce.
  • Prior contract work where you owned infrastructure end to end and handed it off cleanly.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client is an Australian laser cutting and sheet metal fabrication business supplying a wide range of businesses nationally. One division of the company designs and manufactures architectural planter boxes, also supplied nationally to construction companies. The division has grown steadily over recent years and is now expanding, and currently includes an estimator and a designer.

ABOUT THE ROLE

  • This role owns the whole path of a planter box job, from reading the architect's, landscape or structural drawings and completing the take-off, to drafting and structurally assessing the planter box against the project's specific dimensions and quoting the job, and (on won jobs) producing the drawings the customer approves and the cut-ready files the factory works from.

  • This is a structural drafting and stress-analysis-led role, with estimating as the lighter component. The planter box's overall design has already been established by the company, so the core skill isn't ground-up product design, it's working out the stiffener count and placement for each job's specific dimensions, and carrying out the structural/stress analysis (particularly where planter boxes are used as balustrades on high-rise developments) to confirm the structure won't tip or fail under load. Quoting runs on the company's own standard estimating formulas, so take-off accuracy and this structural judgement matter far more than estimating technique.

  • The role is dedicated to this company and works as part of its existing team (which already includes an estimator and a designer), rather than being shared across multiple clients.

  • During quieter periods (for example the construction industry's December–January shutdown), the candidate may be asked to support other departments, such as general estimation or laser-machine programming, to keep them productively engaged.

PRIMARY PURPOSE

To independently take a planter box job from an architect's or construction drawing through take-off, structural drafting and quoting, and (once a job is won) through to customer approval drawings and factory-ready cut files, applying sound structural judgement and commercial scope awareness throughout.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    ▸ Take-Off & Scope Review (Every Enquiry)

    • Review architectural, landscape and structural drawings submitted by construction companies

    • Complete accurate take-offs from these drawings, working out the planter box's size and footprint even where the construction plan shows little more than its marked location

    • Apply commercial judgement to identify what is, and isn't, covered within the scope of each job

      • ▸ Design (Every Enquiry)

      • Determine the stiffener arrangement, quantity and placement required for each planter box's specific dimensions, working within the company's established design, rather than designing the product from scratch

      • Work from architect/construction drawings to a practical, fabrication-ready drafting output

      • The successful candidate will be responsible for using SolidWorks for product design and drafting, as well as undertaking structural assessments and analysis to ensure designs meet relevant construction and project specifications

      • Undertake structural/stress analysis for planter boxes used as balustrades on high-rise developments, including working out anchoring/bolting-to-ground arrangements and stiffener design so the structure does not tip or collapse under load

        • ▸ Estimating & Quoting (Every Enquiry)

        • Quote each job using the company's standard estimating formulas

        • Apply commercial judgement on scope inclusions and exclusions when quoting

        • Receive training from the company's internal estimators on costing and estimation formulas, drawing interpretation and structural/stress analysis are skills the candidate must already bring

          • ▸ Approval & Fabrication Documentation (Won Jobs)

          • Produce drawings for customer approval on won jobs

          • Produce fabrication drawings and cut-ready files for cutting, folding and fabrication on the shop floor

          • In the first few months, quotes and drawings are reviewed internally before anything is sent to the client's customers; as confidence builds, the candidate will progress to liaising directly with them

            • ▸ Working Hours

          • Full-time, standard 8-hour days, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Australian time

MUST-HAVE (ESSENTIAL)

  • 7–10 years of hands-on experience in structural drafting and stress/structural analysis for fabricated products such as tanks, pressure vessels or retention structures (for example oil tanks, hydraulic tanks or water tanks) where side-wall stress under load must be calculated, the client's own benchmark for relevant experience. General sheet-metal or structural fabrication experience alone is not considered sufficient.

  • High proficiency in SolidWorks, as this will be a primary software tool used in the role

  • A structural engineering background (formal qualification or clearly demonstrated equivalent competency), sufficient to produce structural/stress analysis reports comparable to local council or regulatory sign-off standard. Philippine certification/qualification is accepted as equivalent validation; Australian registration is not required.

  • Able to undertake detailed structural/stress analysis of planter boxes used as balustrades in high-rise developments, including working out anchoring/bolting-to-ground arrangements and stiffener placement so the structure does not tip or collapse under load, and to validate designs against relevant construction and project specifications

  • Confident, independent reading and interpretation of architectural, landscape and structural drawings

  • Demonstrated take-off experience (translating drawings into accurate measurements and quantities)

  • Accurate structural drafting against the company's established planter box design: determining stiffener quantity and placement for each job's specific dimensions. This is a drafting and structural-assessment role working within an existing design, not ground-up product design.

  • Commercial judgement (able to identify what is, and isn't, included in a job's scope before quoting it)

  • Comfortable producing both customer-facing approval drawings and factory-ready fabrication/cut-ready files

  • Able to work standard full-time, eight-hour days, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Australian time, Monday to Friday, Weekends Off

  • Comfortable working as a dedicated, embedded member of a single company's team, rather than spread across multiple shared clients

NICE-TO-HAVE (DESIRABLE)

  • Experience working with aluminium, mild steel and Corten steel products

  • Experience preparing DXF files for CNC laser cutting

  • Prior specific experience with planter boxes used as architectural balustrades on high-rise developments

  • Experience quoting or estimating using a company's own standard formulas or templates, rather than building pricing from scratch

  • Experience producing fabrication or cut-ready files specifically for laser cutting, folding or sheet-metal fabrication

  • Experience working as a dedicated, remote, embedded team member for a single Australian business

  • Willingness to support other departments during quieter periods, for example general estimation or laser-machine programming

Highly Desirable

  • Experience working with aluminium, mild steel and Corten steel products

  • Experience preparing DXF files for CNC laser cutting

  • Prior specific experience with planter boxes used as architectural balustrades on high-rise developments

  • Experience producing outputs specifically for laser cutting or sheet-metal fabrication

  • Experience working as a dedicated, embedded remote team member for a single business

  • Willingness to support other departments during quieter periods (for example general estimation or laser-machine programming)

jobs.title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Tempe, AZ, USA
jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!
