jobs.description:
Overview

Role Summary

The Clinical Development and Engagement Lead is responsible for advancing the professional development, engagement, onboarding, and integration of MPOWERHealth’s Surgical Assist (SA) teams. This role partners closely with Clinical Leadership, Operations, Talent Acquisition, HR, Marketing, and Business Development to ensure a high-quality clinician experience from candidate assessment through long-term engagement and retention. The Lead serves as a key steward of clinical culture, clinician experience, and workforce growth.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

1. Clinical Talent Assessment & Selection

  • Partner with internal and external Talent Acquisition teams to conduct first-pass reviews of candidates and identify high-potential clinicians
  • Determine candidates to advance through the interview process and coordinate next steps with SA Managers and Talent Acquisition
  • Develop and maintain SOPs, interview guides, and assessment tools to evaluate clinical skills, professionalism, culture fit, and alignment with MPOWERHealth values
  • Ensure Culture Index completion and distribution alongside candidate materials
  • Provide SA Managers with consistently high-quality candidate pools for final interviews
  • Coach clinical leaders on effective interviewing techniques to strengthen talent identification and ensure a positive candidate experience
  • Continuously review and improve job descriptions and recruiting materials
  • Maintain organized tracking of candidates, interviews, and hired clinicians

2. Clinical Onboarding & Early Development

  • Own and continuously improve clinical onboarding materials, training content, workflows, and SOPs
  • Partner with HR, IT, Credentialing, Operations, and Talent Managers to ensure seamless onboarding execution
  • Lead onboarding meetings for new hires and coordinate hybrid onboarding experiences when appropriate
  • Ensure all clinical access, logins, equipment, and resources are in place prior to onboarding start date
  • Conduct 30-day follow-ups with new hires, provide feedback to SA Leadership, and implement improvement actions
  • Collaborate with clinical markets to develop structured onboarding, mentorship, and market-specific orientation support
  • Travel as needed to support onboarding initiatives

3. Clinical Development & Professional Growth

  • Partner with Clinical Leadership to identify skill gaps and development needs across SA teams
  • Support development and implementation of clinical education resources, competency standards, and best practices
  • Assist in identifying high-potential clinicians and opportunities for mentorship or advanced responsibility
  • Collaborate with Quality and Education teams to align development initiatives with clinical excellence standards

4. Clinical Engagement & Experience

  • Own and evolve clinician engagement strategies across the full clinician lifecycle
  • Maintain and enhance engagement initiatives, including company updates, announcements, recognition efforts, and team communications
  • Develop new engagement opportunities that foster connection, inclusion, and alignment with MPOWERHealth culture
  • Partner with Operations to address engagement challenges related to scheduling, workload, and market-specific needs
  • Serve as an advocate for SA teams by elevating feedback, trends, and improvement opportunities
  • Collaborate with Marketing to tailor branding materials for recruiting, conferences, and engagement initiatives

5. Recruiting Conferences & Brand Representation

  • Partner with Business Development to identify, organize, and attend high-yield recruiting conferences
  • Serve as a clinical-facing representative of MPOWERHealth at events
  • Lead follow-up efforts with interested candidates post-conference
  • Evaluate conference effectiveness and return on investment related to recruiting and brand awareness

6. Integration & Retention Support

  • Support SA Operations and Clinical Leadership during integrations, market expansions, or acquisitions
  • Provide integration support including engagement strategy, communication, and onboarding alignment
  • Conduct post-integration follow-ups to assess clinician satisfaction and experience
  • Partner with HR and Clinical Leadership on retention strategies and early intervention efforts
  • Provide recommendations to leadership based on engagement, onboarding, and retention insights
  • Travel as needed to support integration efforts

7. Data, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and analyze metrics related to recruiting pipeline, onboarding timelines, engagement, and retention
  • Identify trends and opportunities for improvement across the clinician lifecycle
  • Ensure documentation, SOPs, and processes remain current and audit-ready
  • Present insights and recommendations to clinical and operational leadership

Qualifications

Qualifications & Skills

  • Clinical background or significant experience working with surgical teams preferred
  • Strong interpersonal, interviewing, coaching, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
  • Comfortable working in a growth-oriented, evolving environment

· Willingness to travel as needed

jobs.description:
Principal Incident Response Analyst

North - Remote


The Principal Incident Response Analyst is a seasoned, deeply experienced incident response expert who runs North’s most complex security incidents from detection through recovery, without supervision.


Incident response is the primary area of expertise for this role, complemented by strong secondary expertise in detection engineering and tertiary expertise in threat hunting. The Principal Incident Response Analyst serves as the top escalation point for security incidents, sets the technical standard for how the organization investigates and contains threats, and mentors other engineers and analysts on incident handling practice. This role works closely with the SOC, IT, and engineering teams, and represents the deepest incident response expertise on the security team, operating across our payment processing environment.


What You'll do:



  • Incident Response
    • Serve as the principal escalation point and lead investigator for the most complex, highest-severity, and novel security incidents, running them end to end without supervision
    • Independently triage, investigate, contain, eradicate, and recover from security incidents spanning endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and application layers
    • Lead full-scope forensic investigations of compromised hosts, accounts, applications, and cloud infrastructure, and reconstruct complete attack timelines from initial access through impact
    • Translate complex investigation findings into clear narratives for engineering teams and clear executive-level narratives for leadership
    • Own and continuously evolve incident response process, documentation, and playbooks, incorporating lessons learned from real incidents
    • Lead root cause analysis and structured post-incident reviews, and drive cross-team remediation of systemic gaps
    • Serve as the senior technical lead during major incidents, coordinating across IT, legal, compliance, and executive leadership as needed
    • Provide case-level guidance and mentorship to other incident responders and SOC analysts during live incidents
    • Participate in or lead on-call rotation for critical incident response as needed
  • Detection Engineering
    • Translate incident findings and root cause analysis directly into new or improved detection logic, closing the loop between investigation and prevention
    • Write, tune, and validate detection content in the SIEM/NG-SIEM platform, focused on techniques observed in real investigations and threat hunts
    • Maintain and improve coverage and gap analysis against the MITRE ATT&CK framework, informed by incident and hunt findings
    • Review detection logic for accuracy and false-positive rate, and partner with the detection engineering team on rule quality
    • Contribute documentation of known coverage and detection gaps surfaced through incident response and hunting work
  • Threat Hunting
    • Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts based on incident trends, emerging adversary TTPs, and threat intelligence
    • Use hunt outcomes to surface undetected compromises, validate detection coverage, and strengthen incident response readiness
    • Prioritize hunts against the techniques and attack paths most relevant to a payments/fintech environment
    • Partner with threat intelligence sources and feeds to inform hunt hypotheses and target selection
    • Document hunt methodology, findings, and follow-on actions, including new detections and updated incident response playbook material
  • Cross-Functional & Leadership
    • Represent incident response in cross-org planning, tabletop exercises, and architecture reviews
    • Lead complex, ambiguous incident-related investigations and initiatives independently from scoping through delivery
    • Mentor other engineers and analysts on incident response, detection engineering, and threat hunting practices
    • Partner with cloud, network, and identity teams to close visibility and telemetry gaps identified during incidents and hunts
    • Stay current on threat intelligence, adversary TTPs, and vulnerabilities relevant to a payments/fintech environment
    • Communicate findings, coverage gaps, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership
    • Develop and maintain procedure and policy documentation supporting incident response operations


What we need from you:



  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 7+ years of hands-on information security experience, with deep, demonstrated subject-matter expertise in incident response, and strong working proficiency in detection engineering and threat hunting
  • Demonstrated track record independently leading complex, high-severity security incidents from detection through recovery, without supervision
  • Experience mentoring or providing technical leadership to other security engineers and analysts
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical findings for non-technical stakeholders and leadership, including during active incidents
  • Deep, hands-on expertise leading end-to-end incident response (triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and root cause analysis) on complex or novel incidents, independently
  • Advanced digital forensics skills across endpoint, network, cloud, and identity sources, including memory and disk forensics
  • Advanced experience with EDR/XDR platforms and log analysis across diverse sources: endpoint, network, cloud, and identity
  • Strong working knowledge of detection engineering: writing, tuning, and validating detection content in a SIEM or NG-SIEM platform (e.g., CrowdStrike NG-SIEM, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel)
  • Working proficiency in hypothesis-driven threat hunting methodology, informed by threat intelligence and the MITRE ATT&CK framework
  • Deep working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and its practical application to incident response, detection gap analysis, and hunt prioritization
  • Strong scripting or automation experience (Python, PowerShell, or similar) applied to security use cases AND/OR experience using LLM coding tools such as Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or Codex
  • Solid understanding of networking, cloud infrastructure (AWS especially, but also Azure and GCP), Windows/Linux systems, and identity platforms
  • Working knowledge of PCI-DSS or a comparable compliance framework
  • Demonstrated ability to lead high-pressure, ambiguous, cross-functional incident investigations with minimal oversight



License and Certification: Relevant hands-on experience and demonstrated subject-matter expertise are weighted more heavily than certifications for this role. Any of the following are preferred.

    • GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA)
    • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
    • GIAC Network Forensic Analyst (GNFA)
    • GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI)
    • Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP)
    • Offensive Security Incident Response (OSIR)
    • CompTIA CySA+


Salary range: $150,000-$180,000


Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.

Please note: North is a US based company and no sponsorship is available for this position at this time.



Who we are:

North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. As an end-to-end payment solutions company, we provide everything business owners need to get paid, whether they serve customers in a physical storefront, online, or both. We pride ourselves on being large enough to offer customized solutions to our enterprise-level clients while remaining agile enough to take an award-winning, hands-on approach to personal service that our merchants won’t find anywhere else.


Let’s go North, together! Our most important resource is our people. Join our diverse team of innovators and do-ers and make your mark on the future of payments technology. We're proud to offer benefits that help our team members further their overall well-being through unique initiatives that are both personally and professionally fulfilling.


At North, we celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.excerpt: The client moves fast.  Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.
jobs.description:
The client moves fast. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.

About RemotePro.ph

We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.

To apply, please visit us at:

Summary

This role is focused on California insurance — personal and commercial lines. A big part of your day will be handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing. If you've worked inside a California insurance agency recently and know how personal and commercial lines operate — you'll feel right at home here. If you haven't, this role isn't the right fit.

Beyond the insurance work, you'll be supporting day-to-day operations — managing communication, keeping things organized, and making sure nothing gets missed. You'll be expected to use AI tools regularly to work faster and produce better outputs. Not occasionally. Daily.

The Mindset We’re Looking For

The best Executive Support Specialists we’ve worked with share a few traits:

  • They’re the person their friends call when they need to figure something out. Not because they always have the answer — but because they know how to think through a problem, ask the right questions, and get to a solution
  • They don’t wait to be told. If they see something that needs to happen, they handle it — then let the client know it’s done, not ask if they should do it
  • They’re honest even when it costs them. If they make a mistake, they say so immediately. If something isn’t working, they raise it. They don’t manage perception — they manage reality
  • They’re genuinely curious. It’s not enough to be smart — they actively seek out new things to learn, ask questions other people don’t think to ask, and find most topics at least a little interesting
  • They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What happens in the client’s world stays there — no exceptions, no grey areas
  • They use AI the way a sharp operator would — not as a novelty, but as a tool that makes their output faster and better than anyone who isn’t using it

Who Thrives Here

People who are quietly excellent — not flashy, but consistently sharp, reliable, and ahead of the curve. You don’t need recognition for every task you handle. You find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even if no one notices the work behind it.

We’re a growing MSP, which means priorities shift, new tasks appear, and not everything is perfectly documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a problem — it’s an environment where someone who takes initiative and uses every tool available naturally stands out.

This Role Is Not for You If:

  • You need constant direction and check-ins to stay on track
  • You treat “that’s not my job” as a reasonable response
  • You let things slip and wait for someone else to notice
  • You’d stay quiet about a mistake to avoid a difficult conversation
  • Confidentiality feels like a guideline rather than a hard rule
  • You’re uncomfortable with shifting priorities and changing plans
  • You’ve never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don’t intend to start
  • Learning new things feels like a chore rather than something you actually enjoy

There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.

Responsibilities

You'll be managing a mix of insurance operations and administrative support in a fast-moving remote environment. Your job is to keep things running, stay ahead of deadlines, and make sure nothing gets dropped.

That looks like:

  • Handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing for personal and commercial insurance lines — this is the core of the role
  • Managing inbound communication across email and phone — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs attention
  • Tracking open action items, follow-ups, and deadlines so nothing slips — and flagging anything at risk before it becomes a problem
  • Managing calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Preparing reports, summaries, and briefing materials that are clear and ready to use without further editing
  • Maintaining organized records across CRM systems and shared drives — so information is always findable and current
  • Using AI tools to draft communications, summarize threads, and eliminate repetitive manual tasks
  • Supporting market research, competitor analysis, and social media scheduling when needed

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of recent, hands-on experience working inside a California insurance agency — personal and commercial lines — handling renewals, quoting, and account servicing; this is the non-negotiable requirement for this role
  • Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, easy to listen to; clients always feel heard
  • Proven experience in a support, virtual assistant, or administrative role
  • Active, confident daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace
  • Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent)
  • Strong written English — emails are clear and professional before they're sent
  • High attention to detail — errors get caught before they leave your desk
  • Strong organizational skills — multiple priorities, nothing slips

As Higharc's first Sales Enablement hire, you'll own the enablement function end to end: the content, the training, and the systems that help our Solution Engineering, Sales, and Marketing teams close more deals, faster, with fewer resources per deal. You'll start by finding the immediate friction slowing those teams down and solving it tactically. Success in your first 90 days looks like sharper team focus and fewer self-inflicted losses, not a finished playbook.

This is a connective-tissue role between Product & Engineering (PDE) and go-to-market. You'll translate every product release into a GTM-ready story, asset, and trained team, and own the signal loop that carries prospect and customer feedback back to the people building the product. You'll drive consensus across cross-functional groups with data, prototypes, and persuasion rather than authority.

Expect to:

  • Run focused discovery across Solution Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to find the friction slowing win rate, and solve it tactically.

  • Build pre- and post-sales content, messaging, and objection handling that holds up in front of homebuilders and partners.

  • Own New Product Introduction end to end, from Product Marketing and Management through to prospects and customers.

  • Turn each PDE release into a GTM-ready story, a usable asset, and a trained, certified team.

  • Quantify and route customer and prospect feedback so the field's signal reaches the people building the product.

  • Stand up a scalable enablement function from zero, shipping what's needed now while building the systems and automation that outlast any single rep or release.

  • Remove legacy enablement scope from existing GTM teams and replace it with something repeatable.

  • Become an expert in US and Canadian residential homebuilding as you ramp, if you don’t come with that fluency already.

About You

You're a self-starter who thrives in an unstructured, pre-IPO environment. You've built enablement teams and programs before, and you're happy to roll your sleeves back up as an individual contributor. You're energized by ambiguity and by the chance to build something from scratch, and you're comfortable in small teams where shipping the solution matters as much as designing the process behind it.

You have:

  • Direct US homebuilding experience, or a proven ability to get fluent in a complex new industry fast.

  • Experience supporting SaaS GTM teams through significant scale

  • The ability to drive consensus across functions using data, prototypes, and persuasion.

  • Comfort building scalable, maintainable processes while still shipping solutions where they're needed.

A major plus if you also bring:

  • Platform-as-a-Service or consumption-based revenue experience

Working at Higharc

Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process.

Compensation and benefits: Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. We also provide a stipend to create the ideal home office and support ongoing L&D.

jobs.excerpt: 1099 Independent Contractor, Commission-Based The Role Every town has hundreds of small businesses run by people who are great at their trade and have no time for marketing.
jobs.description:
1099 Independent Contractor, Commission-Based

The Role
Every town has hundreds of small businesses run by people who are great at their trade and have no time for marketing. Omada AI gives them an AI marketing team for a fraction of what an agency costs. Territory Partners are the people who put it in their hands.

This is real field sales. You walk into local businesses, pitch the owner face to face, and get them live on Omada that same day. Your territory, your pipeline, your deals, your income.

It’s a 1099, commission-based role, built for closers who want to own what they earn. Every close raises your rate, grows a book that keeps paying you, and moves you toward running a city. We’re launching new cities every month, and the people who join now are the ones who will lead them.

If you know what it feels like to turn an empty morning into three signed customers by dinner, keep reading.

How You Get Paid

Six figures in year one is a real target here. Territory Partners who close 3 to 4 customers a week are on pace for $100K+ in their first year. What you earn comes down to what you close.

Our comp plan is called the Builder Plan. It pays you for every customer you close, and your rate only moves in one direction.

  • A first-close bonus. Cash when your first customer pays.

  • Commission on every close. Your per-close rate steps up at 10 and 25 career closes, then stays at the top rate for good. Your count never resets and you never get moved back down.

  • Milestone cash bonuses. Paid at 10, 25, 50, and 100 career closes.

  • Residuals on your book. Consistent producers earn a quarterly residual on customers who stay with Omada. The book you build keeps paying you.

  • A production guarantee in your first four weeks. While you’re getting started, weeks where you hit the close target come with a guaranteed minimum.

  • Leadership overrides. City Captains earn a share of everything their city collects.

Commissions pay once the customer’s payment clears, and there are no clawbacks on validated closes.

The Straight Deal
We want people who choose this with their eyes open, so here it is plainly.

  • You’re an independent contractor (1099), not a W2 employee. There is no salary, hourly wage, or employee benefits. You handle your own taxes and expenses.

  • You’re paid on results. Closed, paying customers. Not hours.

  • You own your schedule and your pipeline. Nobody books your meetings, and nobody caps what you earn.

The reps who do well here wouldn’t want it any other way.

What You’ll Do

  • Prospect your territory. Walk-ins, door pulls, referrals, networking groups, local events. Whatever works. The pipeline is yours.

  • Sell face to face. Pitch owners in person and start them on a live free trial on the spot. We don’t do demos or demo accounts. You build their system on their real business, with their real content, in front of them.

  • Own the full cycle. From first conversation to trial to paying customer, the deal is yours.

  • Learn the product fast. Most reps are pitching confidently within a day or two. The product isn’t the hard part. The hustle is.

  • Know your numbers. Track your activity and your accounts so you can see what’s working and close more each week.

How We Set You Up to Win

  • You start in the field with a veteran. Your first weeks are next to an experienced Territory Partner. Watch their pitches, prospect together, then close your own deals with their backup. Commission is shared on the deals you close together.

  • A product that sells. Owners need marketing help and most can’t afford an agency. Omada does the work of one for a fraction of the price. In front of the right owner, it sells.

  • Support behind your accounts. Ongoing product training and a customer success team that helps your trials turn into paying customers.

  • A real path up. TP → Vanguard → City Captain → State Director → Regional Director. We launch new cities every month, and we fill those leadership seats from the field.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Proven field or outside sales experience. You’ve sold face to face before (D2D, B2B field, territory sales, retail energy, telecom, payments, or similar) and you have the numbers to show for it.

  • You prospect for yourself. You’ve built a pipeline from zero and you’re comfortable walking into a business cold.

  • You close. You ask for the business, handle objections in the moment, and don’t leave without a next step.

  • You manage yourself. You run your day like a business owner, because as an independent contractor you are one.

  • Reliable transportation and the ability to work your territory in person.

You’ll thrive here if:

  • You’d rather be paid for what you produce than for showing up.

  • You like small business owners and can talk to a plumber, a salon owner, and a realtor in the same afternoon.

  • Rejection doesn’t slow you down.

  • You want a shot at building and leading a market, not just working one.

This is not for you if:

  • You want a salary, an hourly wage, or employee benefits.

  • You need meetings or leads handed to you to get going.

  • You’ve only sold by phone or email and aren’t sure about face to face.

About Omada AI
Omada AI is a Seattle-headquartered AI marketing platform for small businesses, backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital. We’re expanding across the US city by city and promoting our field leaders as we go.

Ready to Own a Territory?
Apply now. Our process moves fast: a short async video interview, then a conversation with a field leader. If you can sell face to face, we want to talk to you.

Compensation Range: $50K - $100K

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: Sr. Manager of Support Operations, Inspection

Location: United States

Workplace Type: Remote


Job Summary


The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as ourSenior Manager of Support Operations, Inspection.


Porch's Inspection vertical spans multiple brands and business units — including ISN, HIP, and Palmtech — serving thousands of home inspectors and the customers they work with every day. Our support organization is the front line of that relationship: a distributed team spread across time zones and geographies (including U.S.-based and international support staff), handling everything from routine account questions to complex product troubleshooting across web and mobile platforms.


We're hiring a Sr. Manager of Support Operations to own the day-to-day performance, tooling, and people-leadership of that organization. This is not a caretaker role. Support is entering an era where AI agents handle a growing share of volume, where the line between “self-service” and “human escalation” is being redrawn in real time, and where the leader who gets this right will define what best-in-class inspection-industry support looks like — not just replicate what already exists.


You'll own the metrics (SLA, CSAT, first-response time, cost-to-serve, staffing efficiency), the tools (Intercom, Intercom's FIN AI agent, Five9, and the CRM and mobile platforms our teams support), and the people (a distributed, partly remote and partly offshore workforce). And you'll be expected to bring a point of view on where AI should carry the load versus where a person needs to be in the loop — then build the roadmap to get there.


What You Will Do as a Sr. Manager of Support Operations, Inspection:

Own Support Operations Performance

  • Drive day-to-day performance across support channels (chat, email, phone) against SLA, CSAT, quality, first-response time, and resolution-time targets.
  • Build and maintain the operating rhythms and reporting that create real accountability — not just dashboards nobody acts on.
  • Use ticket data, call data, customer feedback, and direct observation of the queue to find where performance is breaking down, and fix it.
  • Balance consistency of standards with the reality that ISN, HIP, and Palmtech have different customers, workflows, and expectations.

Lead a Distributed, Remote Workforce

  • Manage a support organization that spans multiple time zones and includes both U.S.-based and international/offshore team members — with all the coverage, quality, and consistency challenges that come with that.
  • Build workforce plans, shift coverage, and staffing models that match contact volume without over- or under-resourcing any region or shift.
  • Own the quality and customer-experience gaps unique to a distributed model (connectivity, equipment, communication clarity, cultural and language fit) and drive the tools and training that close them.
  • Develop remote team leads and frontline agents into a genuinely high-performing, accountable organization — not just a monitored one.

Modernize the Tools and Systems Behind Support

  • Serve as the internal expert on Intercom — ticketing, workflows, reporting, and admin configuration — and on Five9 for phone operations.
  • Own and expand our use of Intercom's FIN AI agent: what it should resolve autonomously, where it should hand off to a human, and how we measure whether it's actually working.
  • Maintain deep working knowledge of the CRM and mobile software our support team is troubleshooting every day, so tooling decisions are grounded in what agents and customers actually experience.
  • Evaluate new support and workforce technology (automation, QA tooling, workforce management platforms) and lead adoption end-to-end — not just selection.

Shape the AI-Powered Future of Support

  • Bring a forward-thinking point of view on how AI and automation should reshape the support model over the next 12–24 months, and turn that into an actual roadmap.
  • Define where FIN AI (or other automation) should own resolution outright, where it should assist a human agent, and where human judgment remains non-negotiable.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to close feedback loops between what support sees every day and what gets built or fixed.
  • Continuously push the organization to question whether current tools, staffing models, and workflows still fit — rather than defending the status quo.

Financial and Cross-Functional Accountability

  • Own the support operations budget, including labor, tooling, and any outsourced/offshore staffing costs.
  • Track cost-per-contact and staffing efficiency, and build the business case for changes in tooling, staffing, or process.
  • Act as the voice of support operations with Customer Success, Product, and Engineering leadership — surfacing risks, trends, and improvement opportunities clearly and early.
  • Serve as an escalation point for the highest-priority customer and operational issues, bringing urgency and sound judgment.

What You Will Bring as a Sr. Manager of Support Operations, Inspection:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in support, contact center, or customer operations leadership, including direct management of managers and/or frontline teams.
  • Hands-on experience managing a distributed or remote workforce, ideally including international/offshore team members, across multiple time zones.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Intercom, including ticketing workflows, reporting, and administration.
  • Direct experience with Intercom's FIN AI (or a comparable AI support agent) — configuring, tuning, and measuring its performance in production.
  • Experience with Five9 or a comparable cloud phone/contact center platform.
  • Experience supporting CRM and mobile software products — you understand the tools your team is troubleshooting well enough to make good calls about workflows and escalation paths.
  • Proven ability to own and move support KPIs (SLA, CSAT, first-response time, quality, productivity) using data.
  • Experience managing a budget, including labor and vendor/outsourced staffing costs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate operational detail into clear priorities for leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the home inspection, real estate, or home services industry.
  • Experience across multiple brands or business units with differing operating needs.
  • Experience implementing or scaling AI-driven deflection, self-service, or automation in a support organization.
  • Familiarity with workforce management (WFM) and quality assurance tooling.
  • Experience managing offshore or outsourced support vendors/BPOs.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to work alongside Physical AI customers, shape our core infrastructure products, and test ideas for what we should build next.
You will work with enterprises, ISVs, and digital-native companies running training, simulation, synthetic data, evaluation, and model serving workloads. By understanding their systems and helping them reach production, you will uncover requirements that inform our Cloud, Serverless, and Token Factory teams. The goal is to connect needs across Physical AI industries with product decisions, including improvements that benefit enterprise customers more broadly.
You will also investigate opportunities for new Nebius products. You will develop hypotheses about unmet needs, examine demand and existing alternatives, and build prototypes to test with customers. Your findings will help determine which opportunities deserve investment and what an initial product should deliver.
The work is hands-on. You will write code, deploy and benchmark models, build agents, and troubleshoot infrastructure alongside customer engineers.

The position is part of the Physical AI go-to-market team, with close collaboration across customers, NVIDIA, Product, and Engineering.

What you will do

  • Work with customer engineers to understand their workloads, infrastructure constraints, and production requirements.
  • Translate Physical AI use cases into requirements that Cloud, Serverless, and Token Factory teams can use, backed by measurements and customer evidence.
  • Identify enterprise adoption barriers and common needs across industries. Work with Product and Engineering to assess gaps and test improvements with customers.
  • Build agents that set up, run, and debug Physical AI workloads, connecting them to clusters, schedulers, storage, and model servers.
  • Deploy and benchmark open-weight models with serving stacks such as vLLM or SGLang, then tune them for customer workloads.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Core Engineering

Collaboration & Communication

jobs.title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - St. Petersburg, FL, USA
jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Are you passionate about advancing building decarbonization? Do you enjoy analyzing complex issues, building relationships with diverse stakeholders, and translating technical information into actionable recommendations? Are you motivated by creating real-world impact through policy and market transformation? If so, RMI invites you to join our growing Buildings team.

We strongly encourage individuals from underrepresented groups to apply.

Program Overview

RMI's Carbon-Free Buildings Program works to transform residential and commercial buildings to be aligned with a zero carbon future. Our team develops and advances policies, market strategies, and technical solutions that reduce emissions while improving affordability, resilience, health, and economic outcomes.

The Energy Efficiency and Demand Management (EEDM) and Big Portfolios initiatives are aimed at catalyzing the zero-carbon building revolution for existing buildings, developing scalable approaches to retrofitting existing buildings to be efficient, electric, and grid-interactive. The team leverages building science expertise, technical analysis, R&D, demonstrations, business model innovation, stakeholder engagement and collaboration, policy development, real estate finance, and communications in our change model.

Position Overview

RMI is seeking a Senior Associate to advance building decarbonization across the United States with a primary focus in California and the Northeast. The Senior Associate will contribute to the development and implementation of solutions that accelerate the transition to clean, efficient, and all-electric buildings.

This role combines data analysis, stakeholder engagement, project management, and strategic problem-solving. The Senior Associate will lead discrete workstreams within larger initiatives, manage relationships with external partners, conduct research and analysis, and develop written products that inform the industry.

Successful candidates will be comfortable navigating complex projects, managing multiple priorities, and collaborating across multidisciplinary teams to drive meaningful market and policy change.

Core Responsibilities

  • Locate, manage, and analyze data using creative approaches that shed new light on problems and solutions.

  • Present quantitative information in a clear and concise visual format.

  • Synthesize insights and recommendations into compelling presentations and thought leadership (i.e. reports, insight briefs, and blogs)

  • Engage with external experts via phone interviews, conferences, and project collaboration.

  • Design and create quantitative models to address key questions and challenges posed by research goals and clients.

  • Coach staff on specific areas of expertise, e.g. building energy modeling.

  • Structure and manage the work of more junior team members.

  • Provide topical expertise for conference presentations, workshops, media engagements, and donor conversations.

Research and Analysis

  • Conduct research and analysis on energy efficiency, demand flexibility, building electrification, and decarbonization strategies.

  • Develop recommendations supported by quantitative and qualitative analysis.

  • Synthesize complex technical information into clear findings and actionable recommendations.

  • Contribute to reports, policy briefs, regulatory comments, presentations, and other external-facing products aimed at influencing key decision-makers in the buildings sector.

Project Management

  • Lead discrete projects or portions of projects from design through execution.

  • Support and/or lead project management tasks: Develop workplans, manage timelines, coordinate contributors, and ensure high-quality deliverables.

  • Support project budgeting, reporting, and partner communications.

  • Track project milestones and help ensure alignment with program objectives.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain relationships with industry representatives, and other partners.

  • Participate in stakeholder meetings, workshops, working groups, and conferences.

  • Represent RMI in external meetings and public forums.

Thought Leadership and Communications

  • Develop presentations, articles, webinars, and other materials for external audiences.

  • Present research findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Support media engagement and public communications efforts as appropriate.

Strategy Development

  • Identify emerging opportunities, risks, and trends in the market.

  • Support program leadership in evaluating and prioritizing strategic opportunities.

Business Development and Organizational Contribution

  • Contribute technical content and analysis for grant proposals and donor reports.

  • Support development of new project opportunities and partnerships, including RFPs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of relevant professional experience in a field related to the built environment - building energy systems, building science, architecture, engineering, behind-the-meter renewable energy and demand management, or a similar technical buildings field.

  • Strong research, modeling, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including working with large data sets.

  • Ability to translate raw data and complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Experience managing projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.

  • Comfort working with ambiguity.

  • Commitment to advancing equitable and market-based climate solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience with building energy simulation platforms and/or related coding languages, eg. EnergyPlus and Python.

  • Field experience evaluating, designing, and/or commissioning building energy systems (HVAC, solar and storage, etc.).

  • Exposure to other professions impacting the built environment, e.g. real estate finance, public policy, construction management, etc.

  • Experience with group facilitation and workshop design.

Visa Sponsorship

Please note: At this time, RMI is not able to sponsor employment visas or hire candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the United States. All candidates must have current, independent authorization to work in the U.S. without present or future sponsorship from RMI. We will update our hiring pages if this status changes.

Location

We are a remote-ready company with team members around the globe. Our beautiful and welcoming offices are available for meetings or focused work, whether you are traveling through or living nearby. Our U.S. offices are in New York City; Washington DC; Oakland, California; Boulder, Colorado, and Basalt, Colorado. Note that there are two open positions for this role. There is a location requirement for one person to be based in California, and one to be based in the Northeastern U.S.

We provide you with the essential IT equipment plus a one-time home technology payment and a monthly work from home/commuter allowance to ensure you have a comfortable home office set up and necessary supplies.

We love seeing each other in person! We occasionally gather for shared time together like retreats and learning experiences. Be ready to travel for occasional in-person meetings (and of course, we cover travel costs). Some roles may require more travel, which will be discussed during the hiring process.

Compensation

At RMI, we prioritize fairness in our pay practices. Salaries are determined based on a mix of experience, market benchmarks, and internal equity across similar roles. The salary range of this position is $84,000-$103,000. New hires typically start toward the lower end of the range, depending on experience and alignment with the role’s scope. In addition to base salary, this position includes an annual bonus target of 5% and eligibility for merit-based increases, which are tied to both individual and organizational performance.

Benefits

We offer an array of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance

  • 403b retirement match with immediate vesting

  • Group life, AD&D, and short- and long-term disability

  • Optional voluntary life, AD&D and accident plans

  • Health savings or flexible spending accounts

  • Fertility and hormonal health support

  • Mental health and wellness support

  • Comprehensive leaves of absence (including generous parental leave)

  • Generous paid time off and sick leave

  • Paid sabbatical leave

  • Regional holidays with at least one extended break in each geography

  • Work from home and home technology allowances

  • Learning & development opportunities (LinkedIn Learning and an annual individual professional development budget)

  • Potential for bonuses and merit increases

  • Discount marketplace (gym memberships, pet insurance, etc.)

  • Hybrid / remote work options

  • Team retreats and geographic meetups

  • Rewards and recognition programs

Diversity

We know that the diversity of our teams makes us stronger as an organization, and RMI is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity as outlined in U.S. federal law. We prohibit discrimination against applicants, interns, and employees on the basis of any legally recognized basis, including but not limited to: age (40 and over), race, color, sex, pregnancy (including lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), religion, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), sexual orientation, gender expression/identity, uniformed service member status, veteran status, citizenship status, or any other applicable status protected by applicable law.

RMI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Job Description:

The Monitoring Supervisor provides technical guidance, oversight, and quality assurance to a team of monitoring and compliance experts responsible for conducting monitoring reviews of grant-based programs. This role provides supervisory support to staff, ensures monitoring activities are completed in line with established standards, and contributes to quantitative and qualitative analysis of underlying monitoring data. Following the completion of monitoring activities, the Monitoring Supervisor oversees the submission of monitoring reports, and supports trend analyses activities to highlight risks, recurring compliance issues, and opportunities for improvement.

Position Duties:

Supervisory Tasks:

  • Provides direct supervision to staff, leads site assessment activities, and coordinates both pre and post monitoring activities and deployments.

  • Delivers technical guidance and oversight across the daily operation of a team delivering monitoring and program analysis support, providing expert guidance with the analysis and evaluation of processes and requirements.

  • Develops program logic and provides insight into toolkits used to evaluate performance measures regarding grantee compliance. Evaluates performance measures in complex implementation efforts.

  • Assists in developing the program monitoring schedule and facilitates updates to the plan as needed; ensuring all programs are monitored according to government requirements and within established timeframes.

  • Ensures federal staff are provided with regular, ongoing reports on the status of monitoring activities including recommendations for resolving resource gaps.

  • Assists with the training and mentoring of new staff. Provides training or guidance on selected monitoring and evaluation-related topics for team members and client staff, as needed.

  • Reviews monitoring reports, corrective actions, and other deliverables prepared by team members prior to submission.

  • Analyzes monitoring outputs to identify trends, recurring compliance issues, and operational risks across facilities; proposing data informed recommendations for improvement to federal staff as appropriate.


Performance management and onboarding: 

  • Regularly monitors and supports team members’ general professional development as well as the specific expertise and skills required to ensure compliance with requirements, apt delivery of products and services, and adherence to deadlines.  

  • Regularly provides suggestions on process improvement. 

  • Provides oversight of the quality of work and deliverables. 

  • Monitors staff performance, providing additional training and feedback as needed.  Completes Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) as necessary. 

  • Completes annual performance evaluations and monitors staff progress toward annual goals. 

  • Reviews monthly reports; approves and submits consolidated reports directly to Task Manager as needed. 

  • Reviews and approves timecards, leave requests, proposed travel, and expense reports as applicable. 


Monitoring Tasks:

  • Leads on-site and remote monitoring reviews to ascertain recipient compliance with program requirements and collect data on programmatic outcomes.

  • Conduct individual and/or group interviews with recipient staff, program participants, and external stakeholders regarding program administration, operations, quality of services, and program outcomes.

  • Review program data, including recipient program documentation, pre-monitoring questionnaires, and client case files, to determine compliance with grant requirements and government agency specific policies and procedures.

  • Identify any potential promising practices and technical assistance needs.

  • Advise recipient and client staff of preliminary monitoring findings.

  • Author monitoring reports containing in-depth analyses and assessments of findings.

  • Update monitoring tools, as needed.

  • Serves as a liaison to program staff on issues related to monitoring and data analysis.

  • Participates in meetings and assists with additional projects, as needed.


Qualifications:

  • Requires BS/BA degree with at least 7 years of monitoring and evaluation experience and 2 or more years of supervisory experience.

  • Advanced degree preferred.

    Proven experience monitoring grantees that provide services to underserved populations.

  • Exceptional analytical skills.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  • Demonstrated proficiency using MS Office.

  • Experience working with immigrants, refugees, and underserved populations is preferred, along with prior state or local refugee program experience.

  • Position is 100% remote, however frequent domestic travel up to 50% of the time may be required.

jobs.excerpt: Merge medical imaging solutions, offered by Merative, combine intelligent, scalable imaging workflow tools with deep and broad expertise to help healthcare organizations improve their confidence in patient outcomes and optimize care delivery.
jobs.description:
Merge medical imaging solutions, offered by Merative, combine intelligent, scalable imaging workflow tools with deep and broad expertise to help healthcare organizations improve their confidence in patient outcomes and optimize care delivery.

Merge is one of the most widely deployed medical imaging platforms in the world. Radiologists and cardiologists rely on us to store, move, and read imaging studies across enterprise health systems, teleradiology reading centers, and community hospitals. We are modernizing the portfolio for the cloud and building empowered product teams that own outcomes — and this role builds the operating model and design foundation those teams run on.

The opportunity

This is an enabling-function leadership role with three connected parts. Product Operations is how product gets built and run — the product development lifecycle, program management, the operating cadence, and the tooling and data that keep everyone working from one source of truth. AI enablement is how we make that lifecycle faster and sharper — using AI to accelerate funnel development, build and pressure-test business cases, and prioritize where the org spends its capacity. UX is product design, user research, and the design system that make the reading experience consistent, usable, and clinically sound. Together they are the backbone that lets empowered teams move fast without losing quality.

You will report directly to the VP, Product, and lead across all three — serving every product team rather than owning a single product.

What you’ll own

  • Operating model and cadence. Own how product is built and run: the product development lifecycle, the operating rhythm of planning, reviews, and metrics, and portfolio operations across teams.
  • Program management. Own program and release management — keeping cross-team initiatives on track and dependencies, risks, and progress visible to leadership.
  • Tooling and data. Own the product toolchain and the portfolio data and metrics, so teams and leaders share one trustworthy view of how we are doing.
  • AI enablement and AI-accelerated PDLC. Own how AI is applied to the lifecycle itself — compressing the path from opportunity to validated, scoped work; standing up business cases with AI-assisted sizing and evidence; and sharpening portfolio prioritization.
  • Design and research (UX). Lead product design, user research, and the design system — partnering with product and engineering from discovery through launch.

What you’ll do

  • Standardize the product development lifecycle and operating cadence so teams discover, build, and ship consistently — with AI embedded in how the org works.
  • Use AI to accelerate funnel development — shortening the path from raw opportunity to validated, scoped, ready-to-build work.
  • Build the business-case discipline — AI-assisted market sizing, evidence, and ROI so investment decisions are fast, consistent, and defensible.
  • Own how the portfolio gets prioritized — a transparent, evidence-backed model for ranking work and reallocating capacity as the evidence changes.
  • Lead program management across the portfolio and give leadership a clear, current view of progress and risk.
  • Own the product toolchain and portfolio metrics; resolve friction so teams work from one source of truth.
  • Lead and grow the UX team, and evolve a design system that keeps the experience coherent across products.
  • Run the early-access and customer-advisory motion that brings clinician feedback into the product early.
  • Build, coach, and retain a team spanning operations and design.

What you bring

  • 8+ years across product operations, program management, and/or design leadership, including running cross-functional operating models.
  • Experience standardizing a product development lifecycle and operating cadence for multiple teams.
  • Hands-on experience embedding AI into how product teams discover, build, and ship — and using it to speed up the funnel, business cases, and prioritization.
  • Program and release management skill — you make dependencies, risk, and progress visible and keep initiatives on track.
  • Design and research leadership — you have led or partnered closely with UX and owned or grown a design system.
  • Fluency with product tooling and metrics, and a bias toward one source of truth.
  • People leadership and clear, plain communication with product, engineering, design, and executives.

Nice to have

  • Background in healthcare, medical imaging, or another regulated domain.
  • Experience with AI-assisted research, synthesis, or evaluation tooling in a regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with quality management systems (QMS) and regulated software development.

Compensation

The salary range provided in this job posting is intended to reflect the general market value for the position. The actual salary offered may vary based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the specific requirements of the role. This range may also be subject to change as market conditions evolve. We encourage open communication throughout the interview process to discuss compensation expectations. For base-salary + commission sales roles, the range represents On-Target Earnings.

Min – Max :

$135,076.67 - $202,615.01 (USD)

Benefits

The benefits described represent the current offerings at our organization, however, benefits are subject to change and may vary by location and employment status. We strive to provide a comprehensive benefits package that supports our employees’ health, wellness, and financial goals. Please note that benefits may be discussed in more detail during the hiring process.

  • Remote first / work from home culture

  • Flexible vacation to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones

  • Paid leave benefits

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401k retirement savings plan

  • Infertility benefits

  • Tuition reimbursement, life insurance, EAP – and more!

It is the policy of Merative to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Merative will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

jobs.excerpt: About AffectAffect is transforming behavioral health care by combining mobile technology with counseling and medical services to deliver 100% virtual, evidence-based treatment.
jobs.description:
About Affect

Affect is transforming behavioral health care by combining mobile technology with counseling and medical services to deliver 100% virtual, evidence-based treatment. Our mission is to break down barriers to care—making treatment more accessible, engaging, and effective for our members.

Through our innovative model, we integrate a smartphone app with a dedicated care team to provide real-time, data-driven support, improving outcomes while reducing costs.

About the Role

As a Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) at Affect, you’ll play a key role in leading member care alongside a collaborative team of counselors, therapists, peer support specialists, and case managers.

You’ll provide evidence-based treatment for individuals navigating substance use and mental health disorders in a fully virtual environment.

Affect specializes in substance-specific care. We prescribe Suboxone for Opioid Use Disorder and do not prescribe other controlled substances. While we provide extensive training in our treatment approach, clinical decisions remain at the provider’s discretion in collaboration with the member.

For full-time roles, we are specifically seeking providers who are particularly strong on the mental health side. While experience with substance use disorder treatment and Suboxone prescribing is important, this role requires confidence in assessing and managing more complex mental health conditions.

You must hold an active, unrestricted license in New Mexico.

We are currently hiring for both full-time and part-time opportunities in New Mexico.This posting is for the full-time position ONLY.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct initial and follow-up telehealth evaluations

  • Provide care for both substance use and mental health conditions

  • Prescribe medications as appropriate and respond to member questions

  • Complete timely documentation in our EHR (Healthie)

  • Collaborate with your care team and participate in scheduled team meetings

Requirements

  • Active, unrestricted PMHNP license in New Mexico (Medicaid enrollment a plus)

  • Active license in your state of residence if different from New Mexico

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience (addiction or mental health preferred; strong candidates with less experience considered)

  • Experience prescribing Suboxone and an active DEA registration

  • Willingness to obtain additional state licenses (covered by Affect)

  • Strong empathy for individuals facing behavioral health challenges

  • Comfort using technology, including EHRs and mobile applications

Additional Information

This is a fully remote position. You’ll need a private, quiet workspace and reliable internet connection to conduct HIPAA-compliant telehealth visits. The role may include occasional internal meetings. Reasonable accommodations are available as needed.

Why Join Affect?

At Affect, we’re reimagining how behavioral health care is delivered. You’ll join amission-driven, collaborative team focused on meaningful, outcomes-based care.

We offer:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Fully remote flexibility

  • Opportunities for professional growth

  • A supportive, innovative culture

If you’re passionate about making a real impact in behavioral health, we’d love to connect.

Come be part of the Affect mission!!!

Must-Have

  • Excellent written communication and attention to detail

Strongly Preferred

Who You Are

jobs.description:
Job Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-driven Data Scrubbing Senior Analyst to join our growing Global Programming & Hosting (P&H) team. In this hands-on role, you will be responsible for safeguarding the quality and integrity of our clients' survey data through rigorous cleaning, validation, and scrubbing processes.

As a senior level analyst, you will own the technical execution of the data quality lifecycle, from live fieldwork monitoring and response validation to final scrubbing, anonymisation, and data delivery. You will work closely with Project Managers and client stakeholders to ensure our datasets are clean, compliant, and ready for confident analysis.

What You'll Do

  • Data Scrubbing & Cleaning: Lead the cleaning and scrubbing of survey data, identifying and removing duplicate, fraudulent, or low-quality responses without compromising dataset integrity.

  • Technical Consulting: Review client requirements and quality thresholds, advising on best practices for data validation, quota management, and respondent quality control.

  • Quality Assurance & Testing: Conduct rigorous QA checks on incoming data to catch straight-lining, speeding, and other fraud patterns before delivery.

  • Data Validation & Compliance: Ensure data structures are clean, properly formatted, and privacy-compliant for delivery (SPSS, Excel, CSV, etc.), scrubbing or anonymizing PII in line with regulations such as GDPR.

  • Troubleshooting & Support: Quickly diagnose and resolve data quality issues, flagging anomalies or respondent flow bottlenecks during live fieldwork.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with internal Project Managers and client-side researchers to clarify quality standards and provide updates on data delivery timelines.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on full service project management or survey programming experience within a market research, panel, or data collection environment.

  • Platform Expertise: Advanced proficiency in major survey programming platforms (such as Decipher, Qualtrics, Alchemer or similar ResTech tools).

  • Technical Skills: Strong working knowledge of web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to customize survey interfaces and design. Experience with Python or XML is a strong plus.

  • Eye for Detail: Exceptional analytical and QA skills with a track record of delivering clean, error-free survey logic and data files.

  • Client facing: strong experience collaborating with internal stakeholders (Project Managers, Commercial teams, etc) and external clients, managing expectations, resolving technical queries and ensuring timely delivery.

LI-PU1

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)

Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!
