jobs.title: Concepteur (-trice) de jeu senior, caméra et 3C / Senior Game Designer, Camera a
jobs.excerpt: À propos du posteNous recherchons un concepteur de jeu senior spécialisé dans les caméras et les 3C pour rejoindre notre équipe.
jobs.description:
À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un concepteur de jeu senior spécialisé dans les caméras et les 3C pour rejoindre notre équipe. Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec notre concepteur de caméras actuel et partagerez la responsabilité de l’expérience offerte par la caméra, qu’il s’agisse de la caméra à la troisième personne par-dessus l’épaule ou de nos séquences avec caméra sur rail.

La caméra est l’un des premiers éléments que le joueur perçoit et l’un des derniers qu’il remarque lorsqu’elle est bien réalisée. Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui accorde de l'importance à cet aspect et qui a envie de le rendre exceptionnel.

Ce poste est en télétravail: vous devrez donc être à l'aise pour travailler de manière autonome et communiquer clairement avec une équipe dispersée géographiquement. Nous recrutons partout au Canada et sommes également ouverts aux candidatures provenant des États-Unis.

Ce que vous ferez

Caméra à la troisième personne

  • Assurer la conception, l'implémentation et le réglage de la caméra à la troisième personne en vue épaule, incluant les états d'exploration, de visée, de combat et de déplacement.

  • Développer un comportement de caméra réactif aux actions du joueur, avec des transitions fluides entre les différents états, une bonne gestion de la distance et du décalage, ainsi que des tremblements de caméra et des retours visuels qui accompagnent l'action sans nuire au jeu.

  • Résoudre les problèmes de collision, d'occlusion et de cadrage dans les espaces restreints, lors des combats chargés et les environnements verticaux.

Caméras sur rail et scriptées

  • Concevez et mettez en place des séquences de caméras sur rail, telles que des séquences de jeu originales, des poursuites, des scènes de vol et des séquences clés, qui offrent un rendu cinématographique tout en garantissant une excellente expérience de jeu.

  • Créez des transitions fluides entre les caméras contrôlées par le joueur, les caméras sur rail et les caméras scriptées afin que le passage de l’une à l’autre ne soit jamais brusque.

  • Collaborez avec les équipes de conception de niveaux et de cinématiques pour planifier les besoins en matière de caméra dès le début d’un espace ou d’une séquence, plutôt que de les corriger à la fin.

3C et sensation de joueur

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'animation, de combat et d'ingénierie afin que la caméra, le personnage et les commandes donnent l'impression de ne former qu'un seul et même système..

  • Apporter des suggestions sur la réactivité des commandes, l'aide à la visée et les sensations à chaque instant, dans le cadre plus large des 3C.

    Qualité et responsabilité

  • Effectuez régulièrement des tests de jeu, recueillez les impressions des joueurs et de l'équipe, et les transformer en améliorations concrètes.

Prenez en charge les bugs liés à la caméra et travaillez à leur correction jusqu'à la sortie du jeu, en faisant des choix judicieux quant aux priorités au fur et à mesure que la production avance.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Game Designer focused on cameras and 3Cs to join our team. You'll work alongside our current camera designer and share ownership of the camera experience, covering both the third person over the shoulder camera and our rail camera sequences.

Camera is one of the first things a player feels and one of the last things they notice when it's done well. We need someone who cares about that and wants to make it great.

This is a remote role, so you'll need to be comfortable working independently and communicating clearly with a distributed team. We're hiring anywhere in Canada, and we're also open to candidates based in the US.

What you'll do

Third person camera

  • Own the design, implementation and tuning of the third person over the shoulder camera, including exploration, aiming, combat and traversal states.

  • Build camera behaviour that responds well to the player, with smooth blending between states, good distance and offset handling, and camera shake and feedback that support the action without getting in the way.

  • Solve collision, occlusion and framing problems in tight spaces, busy combat and vertical environments.

Rail and scripted cameras

  • Design and implement rail camera sequences, such as exotic gameplay, chases, flight moments and set pieces, that feel cinematic while enabling great gameplay feel.

  • Create smooth transitions between player controlled, rail and scripted cameras so moving between them never feels jarring.

3Cs and player feel

  • Work closely with animation, combat and engineering so camera, character and controls feel like one system.

  • Give input on control responsiveness, aim assist and moment to moment feel as part of the wider 3Cs.

Quality and ownership

  • Playtest regularly, gather feedback from players and the team, and turn it into clear improvements.

  • Own camera bugs and polish through to ship, making smart calls about priorities as production moves forward.

  • Work with level design and cinematics to plan camera needs early in a space or sequence, instead of fixing them at the end.

Exigences

  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la conception de jeux vidéo, avec une expertise significative en matière de caméra ou de 3C.

  • Solide expérience dans la conception et le réglage de caméras à la troisième personne, notamment pour les phases de tir, de combat et de déplacement.

  • Expérience dans la création de séquences de caméra sur rail ou scriptées, et dans leur intégration fluide avec les caméras contrôlées par le joueur.

  • Connaissance approfondie des outils de caméra, tel que le gestionnaire de caméra, le ‘spring arm’, les courbes et Sequencer.

  • Bonne maîtrise des mathématiques liées au travail de caméra, notamment les vecteurs, les angles et l'interpolation.

  • Expérience dans la résolution de problèmes liés aux collisions, à l'occlusion et au cadrage dans des environnements complexes.

  • Un sens aigu du cadrage et de la composition, allié à une bonne maîtrise des commandes du joueur et de la réactivité du jeu.

  • Aisance dans le travail à distance et en autonomie, avec une communication claire entre les différentes disciplines et malgré les décalages horaires.

Un Atout

  • Une formation en conception technique, en cinématique ou en programmation de caméra.

  • Une expérience dans la gestion des caméras de plan.

  • Un portefeuille ou une bande-démo présentant vos réalisations en matière de caméra. Nous savons qu'une grande partie de ce travail est soumise à un accord de confidentialité (NDA); ce n'est donc pas obligatoire.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in game design, with significant time on camera or 3Cs.

  • Strong experience designing and tuning third-person cameras, including aiming, combat and traversal states.

  • Experience building rail or scripted camera sequences, and blending them smoothly with player controlled cameras.

  • Deep knowledge of camera tools, such as the camera manager, spring arm, curves and Sequencer.

  • A solid grasp of the math behind camera work, including vectors, angles and interpolation.

  • Experience solving collision, occlusion and framing problems in complex environments.

  • A strong eye for framing and composition, balanced with a feel for player control and responsiveness.

  • Comfort working remotely and independently, with clear communication across disciplines and time zones.

Nice to have

  • A background in technical design, cinematics or camera programming.

  • Experience with set piece cameras.

  • A portfolio or reel of camera work. We know a lot of this work is under NDA, so it isn't required.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un ensemble d’avantages sociaux payés à 100 % par PCF
  • La compagnie d’assurance rembourse les réclamations à 100 % (jusqu’à 1000 $ de services par année, en plus d’une couverture familiale ou individuelle)
  • Une couverture dentaire complète, y compris les soins dentaires
  • La cotisation égale au REER à hauteur de 4 % avant déductions fiscales, 100 % acquis dès le premier jour
  • Une semaine de congé payé pendant les vacances d’hiver
  • 20 jours de congé payé et 5 jours de congé de maladie payé
  • Des séances gratuites de soins virtuels de santé et de bien-être mental, incluses dans le régime pour les membres et leurs personnes à charge
  • Des occasions de développement personnel et la possibilité d’œuvrer dans un environnement mondial
  • L’occasion de travailler au sein d’une équipe créative avec des personnes passionnées par ce qu’elles font

What we offer:

  • Benefit package 100% paid by PCF. Insurance company reimburses 100% of claims (Up to $500 per service a year, as well as individual family coverage).
  • Full Dental coverage, including major dental and orthodontics.
  • 4% RRSP matching before tax deductions, 100% vested on day 1.
  • Paid week off during Winter Holidays.
  • 20 paid vacation days and 5 paid sick days.
  • Free virtual health and mental wellbeing sessions included in the plan for members and their dependents.
  • Personal development opportunities and ability to work in a global environment.
  • Work in a creative team with people full of passion for what they do.

People Can Fly est l'un des principaux studios indépendants de développement de jeux AAA. Notre équipe internationale est composée de centaines de personnes talentueuses qui travaillent dans nos bureaux en Pologne, au Royaume-Uni, en Irlande, aux États-Unis et au Canada, ainsi qu'à distance dans le monde entier.

Fondée en 2002, notre société s'est imposée dans le genre des jeux de tir avec des titres tels que Painkiller, Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgement and Outriders. En tant que l'un des studios les plus chevronnés dans l'utilisation du moteur Unreal Engine, nous continuons à développer notre expertise et à dépasser les limites du possible dans le domaine du développement de jeux vidéo.

Nos équipes créatives travaillent actuellement sur plusieurs titres captivants : Gears of War: E-Day développé en collaboration avec Microsoft: projet Echo pour KRAFTON; et Lost Rift, une propriété intellectuelle originale que nous développons en interne selon notre modèle d'auto-édition. Nous explorons également de nouvelles plateformes et expériences avec la réalité virtuelle et d'autres projets non annoncés.

Fort de plus de 20 ans d'expérience, PCF continue d'explorer de nouveaux horizons. Notre objectif est de combiner notre expertise avec la créativité des talents les plus brillants et les plus avant-gardistes du secteur, afin de créer la prochaine génération de jeux d'action pour les joueurs du monde entier.

Si vous nous rejoignez dans cette aventure, vous aurez la chance de perfectionner votre art, d'élargir vos connaissances et de travailler aux côtés des meilleurs du marché afin de créer des expériences uniques et inoubliables pour les joueurs du monde entier.

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

ABOUT AVID

Avid makes technology and collaborative tools so creators can entertain, inform, educate and enlighten the world. Our customers are the visionaries behind the most inspiring feature films, television programs, news broadcasts, televised sporting events, music recording and live concerts. To learn how Avid powers greater creators or for more information, visit .

JOB SUMMARY

Avid is looking for a Legal Operations Coordinator to join our team!

This role will serve as a central coordination point within the Legal Operations team, responsible for managing legal intake, triaging and tracking requests, and maintaining visibility across all active matters and workflows. The role will ensure accurate task assignment, queue management, and reporting to support prioritization, workload distribution, and operational decision-making. This position will also take ownership of legal systems and documentation management, including maintaining contract lifecycle management (CLM) platforms, legal repositories, templates, playbooks, and SOPs with a focus on accuracy, structure, and accessibility.

In addition, the role will support invoice and billing operations by reviewing outside counsel and vendor invoices for compliance with internal billing guidelines, coordinating approvals, tracking payments, and assisting with legal spend reporting. Working closely with Legal, Finance, and cross-functional stakeholders, this role will ensure end-to-end tracking of legal work, support process consistency, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives while handling sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

This position is primarily Remote, with occasional on-site visits to our BGC Office to support document preparation, administrative activities, and other responsibilities associated with the role. Additionally, Legal Operations Coordinator will also follow a 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Schedule.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Task Intake & Tracking

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming legal requests, triaging and routing tasks to the appropriate team member or queue
  • Maintain and update matter tracking systems to ensure accurate status, ownership, and priority across all open items
  • Monitor task queues and flag overdue or at-risk items to the Legal Operations Senior Manager
  • Generate regular status reports on open matters, completed requests, and workload distribution

Legal Resource & Document Management

  • Maintain and organize the legal documentation library, including templates, policies, playbooks, and executed agreements
  • Ensure documents are version-controlled, properly tagged, and accessible to the appropriate stakeholders
  • Support the upkeep and improvement of the contract lifecycle management (CLM) system and other legal repositories
  • Assist with drafting and formatting legal process documentation and standard operating procedures (SOPs)

Invoice & Billing Management

  • Receive, review, and process legal invoices from outside counsel and vendors, ensuring compliance with billing guidelines
  • Track invoice status and coordinate with Finance to ensure timely payment and accurate accruals
  • Maintain a billing tracker and generate monthly spend summaries for Legal Department review
  • Flag billing discrepancies or guideline violations and work with the Senior Manager to resolve them
  • Support the annual outside counsel budgeting process by compiling historical spend data

General Legal Operations Support

  • Provide scheduling, logistics, and administrative support to the legal operations team as needed
  • Assist with onboarding materials, training documentation, and department communications
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives led by the Legal Operations Senior Manager
  • Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism at all times

WHAT YOU CAN DELIVER:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Legal Management, Public Administration, International Relations, or other related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in legal administration or a related role, with exposure to one or more of the following areas: contract management, legal operations, regulatory compliance, labor and employment law, or corporate legal support.
  • Strong experience in legal workflow coordination, including intake management, matter tracking, or task queue administration.
  • Hands-on experience with legal systems and tools such as contract lifecycle management (CLM) platforms, matter management systems, or document repositories.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) or Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) graduate
  • Prior experience in Legal Operations within an IT or technology-driven organization.
  • Prior experience supporting contract lifecycle management (CLM), matter management systems, or legal workflow tools.
  • Prior experience in legal invoice processing, outside counsel coordination, or legal spend tracking.
  • Prior exposure to intellectual property administration, including trademark and patent maintenance, renewals, or filings.
  • Prior experience in legal operations reporting, metrics tracking, or supporting process improvement and workflow optimization initiatives, with exposure to supporting cross-regional operations (e.g., EMEA or other global jurisdictions) is an advantage.
  • undefined

Aside from the qualifications above, the ideal candidate shall also possess the following behavioral skills:

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain accurate legal documentation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; experience with legal technology platforms, contract lifecycle management (CLM) systems, or document management tools is an advantage.
  • High attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

jobs.description:
We're looking for an InternalHead of Customer Success to own the client success function at Hire Overseas, a fast-moving offshore staffing and HR platform placing vetted global talent into U.S. companies. You will build and lead the customer success motion from the ground up, own a portfolio of client relationships, drive retention and expansion, and set the standard for how clients experience this company after the sale.

This is a small business. There is no established playbook, no large team behind you, and no committee to route decisions through. You will have a high degree of ownership and autonomy — which means you design the processes, make the calls, and are directly accountable for whether clients stay, grow, and refer others. If you are a senior customer success leader who thrives without structure being handed to them, takes full ownership of outcomes, and wants to build something real rather than maintain what someone else built, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Work directly with founders at a growing offshore staffing company with real traction and a strong client base
  • Build and own the customer success function with full autonomy over strategy, process, and outcomes

What You'll Work On

Customer Success Strategy and Function Building

  • Design and build the customer success function including onboarding, engagement cadences, health scoring, renewal processes, and expansion playbooks
  • Define what a great client experience looks like at Hire Overseas and build the systems that deliver it consistently
  • Create the processes, templates, and frameworks the team will run on as the company grows
  • Report to founders on portfolio health, retention metrics, and strategic recommendations

Client Relationship Ownership

  • Own a portfolio of client accounts as the senior point of contact from placement through long-term engagement
  • Build strong, trust-based relationships that make clients feel supported, valued, and confident in their investment
  • Conduct regular proactive check-ins and surface risks, opportunities, and insights before clients have to raise them
  • Handle escalations directly and resolve complex client situations with good judgment and minimal involvement from founders

Retention and Expansion

  • Drive client retention by delivering a consistently excellent account experience at every stage of the relationship
  • Identify and pursue expansion opportunities including additional placements, new roles, and broader scope within existing accounts
  • Track account health across the full portfolio and maintain a clear view of at-risk clients with active plans to address them
  • Build the case for renewal and expansion into every client relationship from day one, not at contract end

Team and Process Development

  • As the company grows, hire, onboard, and manage account managers and customer success team members
  • Set standards for client communication, issue resolution, and relationship management across the team
  • Build a culture of ownership and proactivity within the customer success function

What You Bring

  • Proven senior-level experience in customer success, account management, or client success leadership in a B2B environment
  • Track record of building or significantly improving a customer success function rather than just running an existing one
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills with the authority and confidence to manage senior client relationships independently
  • High ownership mindset — you design the solution, own the outcome, and do not wait to be told what to do next
  • Comfortable operating with full autonomy in a small business environment where structure is still being built and the answers are not always obvious
  • Data-driven with the ability to track portfolio health, retention metrics, and client sentiment and translate them into action
  • Able to manage a full client portfolio and build scalable processes simultaneously without losing quality in either

Nice to Have

  • Experience in staffing, recruiting, HR services, or workforce management
  • Background building a customer success function at a startup or founder-led company
  • Familiarity with offshore or global hiring and the dynamics of remote contractor placements
  • Experience hiring and managing customer success or account management teams
  • Familiarity with CRM and customer success tools for tracking account health and engagement

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your experience building or leading a customer success function, and walking through the most important thing you would do in the first 30 days to understand and improve the client experience at a company you just joined

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you want to build and own the customer success function at a fast-moving company where your decisions shape how hundreds of clients experience the product, this role gives you the autonomy, the access, and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

The Germany Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-120,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

About the role:

À propos du rôle :

Il s’agit d’une possibilité de poste de contributeur individuel, exercé en télétravail en Amérique du Nord.

Les analystes de Gartner sont des chefs de file de l’industrie qui créent des analyses incontournables, des prédictions de marché et des meilleures pratiques pour un vaste éventail d’organisations de premier plan à l’échelle mondiale. Un directeur principal agit à titre de chef de file au sein du groupe Business and Technology Insights (BTI) de Gartner, s’imposant comme une voix crédible au sein de son marché désigné aux niveaux local, régional et mondial. En s’appuyant sur des compétences exceptionnelles en recherche et en analyse, un directeur principal joue un rôle significatif dans la production d’analyses pragmatiques et stimulantes que les clients de Gartner consomment et appliquent pour propulser leur entreprise vers leurs objectifs clés. Ce poste s’inscrit au sein de la pratique d’ingénierie logicielle de Gartner et conseille les dirigeants d’organisations d’ingénierie logicielle à travers le monde. L’objectif principal est d’aider les organisations à développer et à faire évoluer la prochaine génération d’applications logicielles, en particulier les applications propulsées par l’IA et les systèmes basés sur des agents d’IA. Ce rôle fournit des conseils stratégiques sur la façon de concevoir, de gérer et d’exploiter ces applications afin de permettre aux organisations d’adopter et de tirer parti avec succès des capacités d’IA avancées.


Ce que vous ferez :

  • Développer de nouvelles perspectives et idées grâce au leadership éclairé et offrir des approches convaincantes et concrètes répondant aux besoins et demandes des clients afin d'accélérer leur capacité d’action.

The Director, Global Medical Affairs – Hematology, within Global Medical Affairs (GMA) is responsible for executing the global medical plan for sonrotoclax. This role ensures that all medical activities are patient-centered, evidence-driven, scientifically credible, and fully compliant, enabling optimal clinical understanding and use of BeOne Medicines therapies.

The Director manages medical activities throughout the product lifecycle in collaboration with GMA hematology leadership and Regional Medical Affairs. The role supports scientific exchange with external stakeholders and ensures delivery of accurate, balanced, and timely scientific information and materials to healthcare professionals.

Essential Function:

Global Medical Plan Execution

  • Execute assigned components of the integrated global medical plan for sonrotoclax, ensuring high-quality, on-time delivery of tactics and deliverables.
  • Translate global priorities into executable workstreams in partnership with regional medical teams (e.g., content packages, training toolkits, congress deliverables).
  • Track execution progress, risks, and dependencies; proactively escalate issues and propose mitigation plans to GMA leadership.

Scientific Exchange & External Engagement

  • Support scientific exchange activities with key opinion leaders, academic institutions, cooperative groups, and professional societies in alignment with global medical priorities.
  • Execute advisory boards (global and/or regional), including objectives, agendas, materials development, insight capture, and post-meeting outputs.
  • Capture, synthesize, and communicate actionable insights from external interactions to inform ongoing medical execution and cross-functional alignment.

Evidence Generation

  • Support execution of the Integrated Evidence Plan through delivery of Integrated Evidence Plans initiatives.
  • Support concept & protocol reviews and evidence gap assessment for assigned therapeutic areas.
  • Coordinate with internal and external partners (CROs, vendors, investigators) to ensure study conduct aligns with timelines, quality expectations, and compliance requirements.

Scientific Communications & Publications

  • Execute scientific tactics and deliverables for key hematology congresses (e.g., ASH, EHA, ASCO) and peer-reviewed journals.
  • Support congress planning execution including data review meetings, medical booth/medical affairs station support, scientific narrative consistency, and internal readiness.
  • Ensure scientific accuracy, balance, and consistency of messaging across global and regional scientific materials.

Cross-Functional & Regional Collaboration

Other Experience:

  • Knowledge of medical governance, compliance, and quality standards for Medical Affairs activities.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and ability to influence in a matrix without direct authority.

jobs.description:
Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.

About the Company

Our client is an AI-native software company building the operating system for mortgage servicing. It just raised a $150M Series D at a $2B+ valuation, led by Ribbit Capital with participation from Andreessen Horowitz.

The company ran its own mortgage servicer before becoming a software company, so the platform was built around real operations. Loan records, money movement, workflows, task management, and audit trails sit in one system, and native AI agents work inside its permissions and controls.

Demand is already there - $200M+ in contracted ARR within its first six months in market, and institutions behind roughly one in six U.S. mortgages are under contract to run on the platform.

The Mission

Replace the legacy systems that run American mortgages with software where AI can do real work, with the context, controls, and audit trail that regulated finance demands.

The Opportunity

The contracts are signed. Your job is to turn them into live, high-performing operations.

As a Deployment Strategist, you are the person a servicer's COO calls when a migration gets hard. You will sit with escrow, foreclosure, and cash teams, find where their process breaks, and redesign it with product and engineering. You pull the data yourself, settle the discrepancies, and stay on the hook until the numbers move.

You will also use AI and coding agents daily to investigate faster and build the tools your team needs. The deployment function is still being built, so the playbooks, tooling, and AI workflows that define how this company delivers are yours to write.

If you want the scope of a startup operator, direct access to senior executives, and the backing of a $2.3B company, this is the role.

What You'll Do

  • Own deployment workstreams from discovery through configuration, migration, launch, and adoption

  • Map client workflows, find platform gaps, and align client leadership on priorities and sequencing

  • Investigate data across the platform, client operations, and capital-partner records

  • Work onsite with specialists in escrow, foreclosure, loss mitigation, and cash operations

  • Turn operational findings into product and engineering requirements

  • Coordinate engineering, product, compliance, executives, and external partners without disrupting live operations

  • Build reusable playbooks, internal tools, and AI workflows for the whole team

  • Stay accountable after launch for adoption, performance, and business results

What You Bring

  • 3-6 years in strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, hedge funds, or high-growth startups

  • Undergraduate degree from a top university

  • Proof that you built or defined playbooks, tooling, and processes from scratch

  • Hands-on use of AI tools and coding agents

  • Hybrid in NYC (Union Square) or SF (SoMa), 3-4 days in office (relocation assistance is available)

  • Domestic travel of roughly 10-20%, might be higher during critical phases

Key Success Drivers

  • High agency: you see what needs to happen and start, without waiting for a playbook

  • Ownership: you care about the outcome, not just your deliverable

  • First-principles thinking: you break down unfamiliar problems and decide from evidence

  • Range: you can brief an executive in the morning and debug a data issue in the afternoon

  • Fast learning: you pick up complex systems and regulatory detail quickly

  • Judgment: you move fast while protecting correctness, compliance, and client trust

  • Builder instinct: you create structure where none exists

Why Join?

  • Base salary: 140K-240K plus meaningful equity, with monthly vesting after a one-year cliff

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k) plan

  • Flexible PTO, sick days, and 11 company holidays

  • Relocation assistance up to $10K

  • 12 weeks of fully paid bonding leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • Lunch and dinner on in-office days

  • Dog-friendly NYC office

  • Pre-tax commuter deductions for public transportation, rideshare, and parking

  • Company-wide onboarding, learning and development, and 360-degree reviews

  • Quarterly budgets for team and company outings

  • Real scope: you own work that changes how large financial institutions run

  • Fresh funding: the Series D is meant to scale product and teams, including deployment

Interviewing Process

  • Recruiter screen

  • Strategic thinking interview: first-principles reasoning and ambiguous problem solving

  • Executive screen with a deployment co-lead, covering executive presence, judgment, and fit

  • Final panel: take-home case presentation, a 30-minute live client strategy session, and a 15-minute recruiter wrap-up

SUPERP is een IT-consultancy partner die sinds 1999 het digitale hart van toonaangevende organisaties versterkt. Met meer dan 500 consultants bouwen we aan betrouwbare, toekomstbestendige Digital Core-systemen. We combineren de slagkracht van een grote speler met de betrokkenheid van een specialist. We denken mee, zeggen waar het op staat en doen wat werkt.

Functieomschrijving

Als SAP Supply Chain Consultant maak je deel uit van ons SAP Core-team. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende specialismen en voert opdrachten uit bij toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland. Je taken omvatten onder andere:

  • Adviseren over technische oplossingen, architectuur en innovatie.

  • Realiseren van end-to-end oplossingen voor uitdagingen zoals S/4HANA (RISE of GROW) transities, cloudmigraties en procesoptimalisatie.

Dankzij onze brede expertise vertrouwen klanten op SUPERP voor oplossingen die verder gaan dan alleen jouw eigen domein. Dit betekent dat je meedenkt op strategisch niveau en écht impact maakt.

  • Persoonlijke groei: toegang tot de nieuwste technologieën en trainingen.

Proces

In twee gesprekken maak je kennis met je toekomstige teamleider, een salescollega en een teamgenoot. Heb je specifieke wensen over wie je wilt spreken? Laat het ons weten, dan maken we dat mogelijk!

jobs.description:
Location: Bremen / Remote in Germany · Full-time

About Synera

Synera builds the AI agent platform that lets hardware engineers connect their tools and automate their workflows. We sell to the world's leading engineering organizations and we run our own company the same way we build our product: automated, data-driven, and AI-first.

About the role

Our GTM engine runs on data: Salesforce as the CRM backbone, HubSpot for Marketing, wired into enrichment and outbound tooling, and a growing layer of AI agents on top. You are the admin of record for that stack: you design it, build in it, ship changes to it, and keep every system connected to it in sync.

Sales Dev, AEs, Marketing and CS all work in the systems you own, and how well they run depends on the UI/UX, data model, automations, and processes you put there. Everything we automate on top of the CRM, from reporting to integrations to AI agents, only works if the records underneath are correct.

We believe in creating outcomes. Your work does not stop once you've implemented a new process, layout, or field. It ends, when features have adopted and retained usage, data quality is high, or correctness is 100%. Bonus if you can actually get a high CSAT by CRM users. We know the pain.

Who you are:

  • Hands-on experience administering Salesforce in a B2B sales organization (certification a plus, real flows and technical logic a must); working knowledge of HubSpot or a comparable marketing-automation platform.

  • Comfortable in the data layer: SQL is second nature; you have built ETL/data pipelines (Airflow or similar) and data models, and can debug a sync gone wrong across three tools.

  • You have built reporting and forecasting people actually use and know the difference between a dashboard and an answer.

  • An automator by instinct: scripts, APIs, workflow tools, and AI agents are how you scale yourself. You use LLMs as a daily working tool, not a novelty and the idea of building the data brain behind a company-wide AI agent excites you.

  • You work in English confidently; German is a plus. You communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues, sales reps, marketers, and executives alike.

  • Ownership mentality: you document what you build, you notice what nobody asked about, and you would rather fix the system than the symptom.

Why this role

You own the system the entire revenue organization runs on, with the mandate to shape it rather than maintain it, a modern stack, and the automation tooling to build leverage instead of backlog. You report into Business Operations with a direct line to how the company is run.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Administer Salesforce: You are the admin of record who implements, maintains, improves. Objects, fields, flows, validation rules, permission sets, lead routing, ...

  • Administer HubSpot: marketing automation, channel integrations, performance & pipeline attribution, workflows, ...

  • Ship changes like an engineer: test in sandbox, deploy in production, and enable the team

jobs.excerpt: über uns„Grenzen verschieben, disruptiv denken, die Zukunft gestalten – sei dabei, wenn wir die Talente von morgen formen.
jobs.description:
über uns

„Grenzen verschieben, disruptiv denken, die Zukunft gestalten – sei dabei, wenn wir die Talente von morgen formen.“Das Franklin Institute steht für Disruption und Innovation in der sonst so staubigen Bildungsbranche. Unser Antrieb ist es, die Online-Bildungslandschaft stetig neu zu definieren und zu gestalten. Inspiriert von visionären Unternehmen, kombinieren wir Leistung, Innovation und unternehmerischen Geist, um der Branche immer einen Schritt voraus zu sein.

deine rolle & aufgaben

Als Career Coach (Professional) begleitest du Teilnehmende aktiv in Richtung Arbeitsmarktintegration – mit klarem Fokus auf Wirksamkeit, Aktivierung und messbare Outcomes. Du coachst praxisnah, steuerst den Bewerbungsprozess über KPIs und entwickelst den Career-Prozess kontinuierlich weiter.

Coaching & Arbeitsmarktintegration (~70%)

  • Durchführung von Einzel- und Gruppencoachings (Bewerbungsstrategie, Selbstpräsentation, Interviews, Vertragsverhandlung)
  • Aktivierung der Teilnehmenden: Teilnahme an Coachings, Nutzung von Bewerbungstracker/Career Journal
  • Früherkennung anspruchsvoller Fälle und proaktives Zugehen in Abstimmung mit Dozent:innen
  • Unterstützung beim Aufbau einer konsistenten Bewerbungsroutine und Pipeline

Monitoring, Tools & Prozessentwicklung (~30%)

  • Pflege und Nutzung von HubSpot sowie Bewerbungs-/Integrations-KPIs inkl. jederzeitiger Auskunftsfähigkeit zum Kursstatus
  • Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zur Steigerung der Integrationsquote auf Kurs-Ebene
  • Proaktive Verbesserung von Curriculum und Career-Prozess (Feedback- & Marktimpulse)
  • Fachliche/organisatorische Unterstützung von Junior Coaches
  • Teilnahme an wöchentlichem Alignment und Team-Meeting (keine Coachings in dieser Zeit)
  • Weitergabe von Top-Kandidat:innen an definierte Ansprechpartner (Hiring/Partner)

dein profil

  • Sicher in Einzel- und Gruppencoaching und in der Arbeit mit heterogenen Zielgruppen
  • Starker Praxisbezug im Bewerbungsprozess: CV/LinkedIn, Interviewführung, Verhandlung
  • Daten- und KPI-orientiert: &u steuerst Outcomes über klare Signale und Maßnahmen
  • Tool-sicher in HubSpot (und idealerweise Coda) + hohe Lernagilität für neue Tools/Workflows
  • Sehr hohe Selbstorganisation, Verbindlichkeit und sauberes Erwartungsmanagement
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse

Wünschenswert:

  • Erfahrung in Bildungsprogrammen / Bildungsgutschein-Kontext
  • Erfahrung in Remote-/Hybrid-Teams oder in Recruiting/Hiring-nahen Rollen

was macht uns aus?

Wir glauben an Lehre, die mehr ist als das Vermitteln von Inhalten. Am Franklin Institute verstehen wir Lernen als Coaching, Empowerment und Leadership im Lernkontext. Unsere Dozierenden und Coaches sind keine Folien-Vortragenden, sondern echte Lernbegleiter:innen, die Menschen in ihrer Entwicklung stärken und sie zu Selbstwirksamkeit, kritischem Denken und beruflicher Handlungsfähigkeit befähigen. Dabei arbeiten wir praxisnah, kollaborativ und stärkenorientiert, sehen den Menschen als Ganzes und schaffen ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, das komplett remote möglich ist und auf Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und echte Zusammenarbeit setzt.

SUMMARY

Mentors and trains less experience staff in the execution of responsibilities, provides support in the resolution of complex issues/questions or technical points. Minimizes risk to the organization by conducting Corporate Compliance audits, investigations and training throughout all affiliates. Guides system administration and RGHS management to ensure compliance with local, state and federal laws and regulations; in addition to contract obligations. Acts as subject matter expert for building and continually optimizing the system’s EMR. Work is often confidential and sensitive; therefore requires a high level of professionalism and strong communication skills. Requires a high degree of mental and visual acuity as attention to detail, critical thinking and decision making is required. Errors greatly impact the hospital’s compliance risk, including legal fines, loss of revenue and statistics. Strong analytical skills, project management experience, and training skills to guide Physicians, staff and system Management in interpretation of rules and regulations are essential.

STATUS: Full-Time

LOCATION: Remote

DEPARTMENT: Corporate Compliance

SCHEDULE: Monday - Friday, 8:00am to 4:00pm

RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Abides by the standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association.
  • As senior member, applies mastery of skills in area of specialization, provides guidance and general oversight to less experience employees and may train new employees. The duties and tasks of this senior position reflect substantial variety and complexity. The senior serves as a resource to others in the resolution of complex issues and technical skills.
  • Manages projects independently, prepares governmental disclosures and facilitates external audits by regulatory agencies while working with RGHS Administration and Management.
  • Coordinates and conducts audits to assess compliance with payer regulations and contract obligations. Audits include, but not limited to revenue cycle (Clinical documentation, EMR work flows, registration, coding, charging, billing, payments and denials), financial statements, payments and attestations; grants, RGHS employees and contractors for governmental exclusions and payment agreements
  • Interviews key staff with professionalism and respect in order to identify cause analysis of issues identified.
  • Collaborates with health care professionals to discuss findings and offer advice and education as to how to improve compliance
  • Develops reports reflecting audit results and reports findings to Compliance Director, RGHS Administration and management
  • Develops corrective action plans with Management and assists with implementation when necessary
  • Performs follow up audits to ensure monitors are implemented and effective
  • Analyzes studies that have been prepared by government and professional associations to assess risk and opportunity for assigned departments
  • Identifies compliance benchmarks for assigned areas and performs analysis for risk assessment
  • Collaborates with System Directors and/or administration regularly to ensure awareness of any regulation changes impacting their departments.
  • Researches and assists Compliance Director, RGHS management and administration with new business growth for the system
  • Approves and collaborates with system management and administration on margin improvement initiatives, often times providing the training to staff involved in implementing, to ensure compliance
  • Acts as Subject Matter Expert in the continued building and optimization of the systems EMR in areas of clinical documentation, work flows and impacts on the revenue cycle to ensure compliance Performs presentations for clinicians on appropriate documentation in the EMR
  • Researches and assists Compliance Director, RGHS management and administration with new business growth for the system
  • Designs and implements training to ensure compliance of the revenue cycle focusing on clinical documentation, coding, charging, billing and denial appeals for physicians, health care providers, HIM coders and other applicable RGHS employees
  • Performs and manages internal investigations into reports of non compliance (fraud, waste and abuse) by RGHS employees or external sources as directed
  • Interviews system management and staff with respect and professionalism
  • Completes report and investigation in a timely manner
  • Reports findings to Compliance Director and follows through as directed; including assisting HR with information and interviews to ensure appropriate discipline of employees
  • Performs cause analysis of non compliance
  • Facilitates corrective action and monitors in affected departments with management
  • Performs follow up audits in timely manner to ensure compliance
  • Facilitates and manages under the general direction of Compliance Director external investigations into the system by agencies such as OIG, DOJ, OMIG, FBI, Medicare and Third Party payer fraud units. Represents the system in a positive and professional manner when communicating with agencies.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS


  • AAS or BS in Health Information Management, Health Care Administration, Finance, or Accounting, and experience with healthcare compliance
  • Minimum five years of healthcare experience that includes a minimum of 3 years health care compliance experience
  • A combination of healthcare work experience, credentials and/or education will be considered
  • RHIT, RHIA, CCS, or CCS-P (Compliance Board Certification a plus)
  • Relevant health care related certification with experience may be considered in lieu of above certifications

EDUCATION:

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Sedentary - Sedentary roles are primarily office-based and require prolonged sitting (67–100% of the workday) with minimal physical effort and lifting limited to under 10 lbs. Fine motor skills are necessary for computer work, writing, and telephone use, supported by clear visual and auditory ability. Cognitive and emotional demands are high due to extended concentration, frequent interruptions, independent decision-making, and information processing. Although physical exposure is low, administrative areas within healthcare environments may occasionally involve contact with infectious agents. Some roles may require flexible hours, TB screening, or a valid driver’s license.

For disease specific care programs refer to the program specific requirements of the department for further specifications on experience and educational expectations, including continuing education requirements.

Any physical requirements reported by a prospective employee and/or employee’s physician or delegate will be considered for accommodations.

14617

En Wetaca buscamos crear una categoría. Nos dedicamos a ofrecer un servicio de comida a domicilio. Pero no somos un delivery al uso. Cocinamos y enviamos tapers en un menú semanal con una única entrega, tapers de comida de verdad. Comida real, rica, y sana (sin aditivos ni conservantes, cocinado todo desde cero por cocineros expertos) para que cuando nuestrxs clientes no puedan (o no sepan, ¡o no quieran!) cocinar, no se encuentren con que su alimentación del día a día sea un problema. Nuestro objetivo es que confíen en nosotros y nos deleguen el preparar su comida, que sepan que WE TAke CAre, que nosotros nos encargamos de todo. Y con todo es todo: desde la selección de ingredientes de calidad hasta cómo impacta nuestro servicio en el medio ambiente. Y por supuesto, de que cada semana el repartidor haga magia y coman muy (MUY) bien.

Buscamos un Senior Fullstack Developer con clara vocación de crecimiento para que se una al equipo. El área de Tecnología es clave en Wetaca porque hace posible que podamos entregar más de 200.000 platos al mes a nuestros clientes a través de nuestro modelo de suscripción.

  • Escribirás código limpio para desarrollar aplicaciones web funcionales.

  • Apoyarás la entrega de valor mediante la construcción, prueba y puesta en producción de código de calidad utilizando las mejores prácticas del mercado.

  • Trabajarás para implementar las mejores prácticas del sector y desarrollar soluciones automatizadas.

  • Trabajarás de forma colaborativa con otros ingenieros, managers y otros equipos para desarrollar soluciones innovadoras.

  • Y por supuesto disfrutarás de tu trabajo. ¡Déjalo en nuestras manos!

jobs.title: Freelance Corporate Facilitator — Leadership & Management
jobs.excerpt: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities.
jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Humana is seeking a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer to design, implement, and support secure, compliant cloud and DevOps platforms across Azure and GCP. This role is responsible for enabling enterprise-scale software delivery through modern CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes platforms, GitOps practices, automation, and developer self-service capabilities.
The engineer will provide dedicated ownership of the JFrog platform ecosystem (Artifactory, Xray, and Curation) supporting both enterprise and Humana Military initiatives, with a focus on software supply chain security, artifact governance, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance. As a subject matter expert for JFrog, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly, this role will drive platform modernization, security remediation, operational excellence, and developer productivity while ensuring reliable and scalable platform services across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain secure cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes platforms (AKS, GKE, OpenShift).
  • Own and administer enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Support Humana Military and enterprise teams through software supply chain security, artifact governance, and platform operations.
  • Implement vulnerability management, dependency governance, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Design and support feature flag management and progressive delivery capabilities using LaunchDarkly.
  • Develop automation and self-service solutions using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Ensure HIPAA, SOC2, and regulatory compliance across DevOps platforms and processes.
  • Configure and support enterprise build agents and runners across Linux, Windows, and GitHub Runner environments.
  • Provide L3 support, incident response, root cause analysis, and on-call support for critical platform services.
  • Create engineering standards, documentation, reusable templates, and developer enablement resources while participating in Agile delivery practices.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, platform engineering, or operations.
  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps engineering experience.
  • Experience designing and supporting cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD platforms using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms including AKS, GKE, and OpenShift.
  • Experience administering and supporting enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly.
  • Experience implementing software supply chain security, dependency governance, vulnerability remediation, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration and Windows administration experience.
  • Advanced scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python.

jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community (Role is Remote US) The Senior Insider Threat Engineer is responsible for the configuration, tuning, and day-to-day optimization of enterprise insider threat technologies at Humana.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

(Role is Remote US)
The Senior Insider Threat Engineer is responsible for the configuration, tuning, and day-to-day optimization of enterprise insider threat technologies at Humana. Reporting to the Insider Threat Lead, this role ensures insider threat capabilities are effectively integrated into Humana's threat management ecosystem to detect, investigate, and mitigate insider risks. The position partners with Security Operations, HR, Legal, Compliance, and enterprise business partners to safeguard company assets, sensitive data, and workforce trust.

Key Responsibilities

Purview Technology Operations – Configure, tune, and maintain Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management (IRM), Communication Compliance (CC) policies to support enterprise insider threat detection.

Policy & Use Case Development – Build and refine IRM policies, CC policies, sensitive information types (SITs), trainable classifiers, and adaptive scopes that identify both negligent and malicious insider risk activities.

Alert Triage & Tuning – Investigate Purview-generated alerts, perform root-cause analysis on false positives, and execute tuning cycles to improve signal fidelity and reduce analyst fatigue.

eDiscovery & Investigative Support – Leverage Microsoft Purview eDiscovery (Standard and Premium) to support insider threat investigations, legal hold requests, and HR/Legal inquiries, including case creation, custodian management, search, review, and defensible export of evidence.

Endpoint Insider Threat Monitoring – Operate and tune Proofpoint Insider Threat Management (ITM) to capture user activity telemetry, screen captures, and file movement evidence, ensuring detection rules and policies remain aligned with current insider risk use cases.

Cross-Platform Correlation – Correlate Purview and Proofpoint ITM telemetry with SIEM, UEBA, and EDR data sources (e.g., Splunk, Defender XDR) to enrich investigations and surface higher-confidence insider risk signals.

Governance & Framework Alignment – Support the development and maintenance of policies, procedures, and technical standards for Purview- and Proofpoint-based insider threat controls aligned with industry best practices.

Automation & Tooling – Develop scripts and queries (KQL, PowerShell, Graph API) to automate policy deployment, reporting, and operational health checks across Purview workloads.

Metrics & Reporting – Track KPIs/KRIs (e.g., alert volume, MTTR, policy efficacy, false positive rate) and produce operational reporting on platform health and detection coverage.

Regulatory Support – Ensure insider threat technologies and practices meet requirements under HIPAA, HITRUST, PCI-DSS, SOC2, and related regulatory frameworks.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in cybersecurity with a focus on insider threat, data loss prevention, information protection, and/or compliance technologies.

Hands-on experience configuring and tuning Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management, Communication Compliance, and DLP, including policy design, scoping, and alert triage.

Experience supporting eDiscovery activities (Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Standard/Premium or comparable platform) in support of investigations or legal holds.

Working knowledge of endpoint insider threat monitoring platforms such as Proofpoint Insider Threat Management (ITM) or equivalent (e.g., DTEX, Teramind).

Working knowledge of insider threat tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), including data exfiltration, fraud, IP theft, and sabotage.

Proficiency with KQL and PowerShell for querying, automation, and policy management across the Microsoft 365 / Purview ecosystem.

Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into business risk language for both peers and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (SC 401)

Additional certifications in insider threat or cybersecurity (e.g., ITPM, ITVA, CISSP, CISM).

Bachelor's degree or higher in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Data Science, or related field.

Hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar agentic AI development tools to build internal utilities, automate policy/detection artifact generation, and support insider threat operations.

Familiarity with Microsoft Graph API, adaptive scopes, sensitivity labels, and trainable classifier development.

Hands-on experience administering Proofpoint Insider Threat Management (ITM), including agent deployment, rule tuning, and evidence handling.

Experience integrating Purview and Proofpoint signals with SIEM/UEBA platforms (e.g., Splunk, Defender XDR) for enriched investigations.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$97,900 - $133,500 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

This pillar is intentionally scoped: Risk Management owns the external auditor relationship, the evidence pipeline, the enterprise risk register, the POA&M lifecycle, and the ISO 27001 audit readiness and certification audit track. You own risk identification, risk quantification, audit execution, and the remediation lifecycle that closes gaps across all pillars.

You will report to the Senior Director, GRC and serve as Riot's primary relationship owner with external auditors across SOC 1, SOC 2, and ISO 27001. You will partner directly with the CFO on SOX obligations and with Internal Audit on shared ITGC methodology. In critical operations, you will engage mining site and data center leadership to ensure operational risks are captured, assessed, and reflected in the enterprise risk register.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end execution of SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II audits: scoping, control walkthroughs, evidence collection, auditor liaison, management response drafting, and remediation tracking — you are the primary point of contact for all external audit activity.
  • Lead the ISO 27001:2022 audit readiness and certification audit track — coordinating evidence, managing the certification audit relationship, and driving the program to on-schedule certification under the governance of the Sr. Director, GRC.
  • Serve as the primary liaison to Internal Audit for SOX ITGC coordination — establishing a shared control inventory, aligning testing methodologies, dividing walkthroughs to eliminate duplication, and maintaining a joint remediation cadence.
  • Build and operate the Riot enterprise risk register: define the risk taxonomy, conduct risk assessments across all business units including mining and data center operations, tier risks by likelihood and impact, and maintain a living register updated no less than quarterly.
  • Develop and maintain the KRI/KPI framework for executive and Board-level risk reporting — translating risk register outputs into leading indicators that give leadership actionable visibility into Riot's risk posture.
  • Run the POA&M (Plan of Action & Milestones) program: intake all audit findings and control gaps across all GRC pillars, assign ownership, track remediation progress, escalate stalled items, and report status to the Sr. Director on a defined cadence.
  • Build continuous audit-readiness infrastructure: design repeatable evidence pipelines, drive evidence collection automation where possible, and eliminate point-in-time audit scrambles by maintaining a year-round audit-ready posture.

What you'll bring

  • 8–12+ years of progressive GRC, IT audit, or enterprise risk management experience, with direct, hands-on ownership of SOC 1 and/or SOC 2 Type II audits — required, not supporting-role exposure.
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer certification — required. Must have credentialed implementation experience to own the audit execution and certification track.
  • Working knowledge of SOX ITGC requirements at a publicly traded company, with demonstrated experience coordinating GRC work with an Internal Audit function.
  • Proven experience building or operating an enterprise risk register, risk taxonomy, and KRI/KPI reporting framework for executive audiences.
  • Experience owning the external auditor relationship — managing audit timelines, evidence requests, walkthrough coordination, and management response drafting across multiple concurrent audit programs.
  • Strong POA&M and remediation lifecycle management: tracking, escalating, and closing audit findings across cross-functional control owners.
  • Familiarity with at least one additional security framework beyond SOC 2 — ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or NIST 800-53.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — ability to present risk posture and audit status in executive-ready formats for Board Audit Committee reporting.
  • Preferred: CISA or CRISC certification; experience in critical infrastructure, data center, energy, or digital asset environments; exposure to OT/ICS risk environments.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Base range (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

SENIOR DATA ANALYST — WORKFORCE PLANNING

CenterWell Pharmacy, a Humana company

ABOUT THE ROLE
Every prescription CenterWell Pharmacy fills depends on a chain of people being in the right place at the right time. The Workforce Planning team makes sure that capacity exists before the demand arrives. The team conducts long-term forecasts that impact hiring, mid-term capacity plans that shape staffing strategy, and short-term plans that hold service levels week to week.

If you have done demand planning or S&OP for a physical supply chain, this is the same discipline — our constrained resource is licensed, trained people instead of inventory.

We are building this function from the ground up. The architecture, the metrics, and the tooling are not decided yet, and we are hiring two Senior Data Analysts to help decide them.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Turn messy, multi-source operational data into planning inputs the business can act on

  • Partner with operations, finance, and department leaders to understand what they actually need to decide

  • Build the tooling and data products that let planners and leaders answer their own questions

  • Bring rigor to how we measure ourselves — forecast accuracy, capacity use, cost per prescription, and the drivers underneath them

TWO WAYS IN

Every analyst here shares the work above. Beyond it, you will anchor in one of two focus areas.

Focus Area 1 — Data Engineering & Architecture

You would own how planning data reaches the people who use it — the pipelines that consolidate workforce, volume, and operational data across platforms, and the models our forecasting tools run on. You have built ETL/ELT pipelines in a cloud data environment (Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar), work fluently in Python, and know dimensional modeling and data warehouse design.

Focus Area 2 — Business Intelligence & Analytics

You would own how planning insight turns into decisions — the dashboards and self-service tools operations leaders run their business on, and the KPI definitions underneath them. You have advanced Power BI skills (or Tableau/Looker and willingness to switch), have built KPI frameworks from scratch, and can decompose a metric to root cause rather than reporting variance.

You do not need to be strong in both. We would rather have two people who are excellent at one than two who are adequate at everything. Tell us in your application which one is yours.

unser angebot
