jobs.title: Payroll & Benefits Manager
jobs.excerpt: Sedron Technologies is hiring a talented Payroll & Benefits Manager!
jobs.description:
Sedron Technologies is hiring a talented Payroll & Benefits Manager!

Sedron is a leading provider of circular waste management technologies for agricultural manure and municipal biosolids processing, deploying facilities across several North American regions. Since its founding in 2014, Sedron has pioneered innovative solutions, including the patented Varcor® system, to transform waste into clean water, organic fertilizer, and carbon-negative commodities. With strong engineering expertise, Sedron’s processes reduce nutrient pollution, lower operational expenses, and promote sustainability at a fraction of traditional costs.

The Payroll & Benefits Manager owns end-to-end payroll and benefits operations for Sedron Technologies’ workforce of shift-based manufacturing and operations, as well as salaried employees. This role manages multi-state payroll compliance, the Employer of Record (EOR) relationship for Canadian employees, and administration of health, welfare, and retirement benefits, including annual open enrollment.

The Payroll & Benefits Manager serves as Sedron’s internal subject-matter resource for payroll administration and compliance, including payroll taxes, garnishments, wage deductions, and multi-state payroll requirements. The role partners closely with the Director of People Operations, accounting, and external advisors on broader wage and hour, benefits, and employment compliance matters.

While this role offers location flexibility, preference will be given to candidates located near one of our existing offices in Sedro-Woolley, WA; Bellingham, WA; or Chicago, IL. Remote employees should expect to travel to an office location approximately once per quarter.

Because we design, build, commission, and operate our technologies, this role must meet the following essential functions:  

  • Own accurate and timely multi-state payroll processing for hourly, shift-based, and salaried employees, including regular pay, overtime, shift differentials, bonuses, and other earnings.
  • Review and audit timecards each pay cycle, identifying and resolving missed punches, PTO and sick time, approvals, job coding, department allocations, and other discrepancies in partnership with employees and managers.
  • Manage payroll corrections and adjustments, including retroactive pay, final paychecks, and off-cycle or manual payrolls, ensuring changes are accurately documented and resolved.
  • Establish and maintain payroll and benefits controls, audit processes, approval workflows, procedures, and documentation to support accurate and consistent administration.
  • Monitor payroll and benefits requirements as the Company expands into new states and jurisdictions, partnering with the Director of People Operations, Accounting, and external resources to coordinate registrations, tax withholding, unemployment, paid leave, and other applicable requirements.
  • Coordinate payroll and benefits administration for Canadian employees through Sedron’s Employer of Record (EOR) partner, including pay, benefits, statutory deductions, and employee changes.
  • Administer employee benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and 401(k), and lead the operational execution of annual open enrollment and other benefit enrollment activities.
  • Partner with the Director of People Operations on benefit renewals, compliance requirements, employee communications and engagement, and opportunities to improve Sedron’s benefit programs and employee experience.
  • Manage relationships with payroll, benefits, retirement, leave, EOR, and other third-party partners, serving as the primary operational contact and escalation point and driving issues through resolution.
  • Support administration of employee leaves, with primary responsibility for coordinating payroll, benefit deductions, premium payments, and coverage impacts.
  • Administer wage garnishments, levies, child support orders, and other court-ordered deductions accurately and confidentially.
  • Manage payroll tax notices and agency correspondence, researching issues, providing supporting documentation, and tracking open matters through resolution.
  • Support employees and managers with payroll and benefit questions, researching and resolving deduction discrepancies, underpayments, overpayments, repayment arrangements, and other escalated issues. Develop guidance and training to support understanding of payroll and benefits processes.
  • Reconcile payroll and benefits accounts, support payroll tax filings, and lead payroll year-end activities, including W-2s, 1095-Cs, and other required reporting.
  • Develop and maintain payroll and benefits reporting for HR, Finance, and leadership, including payroll trends, benefit costs and participation, labor allocations, reconciliations, and other workforce-related analysis.
  • Own payroll-related HRIS configurations, coding structures, records, and system workflows, identifying opportunities to automate processes, strengthen controls, improve employee experience, and maximize system capabilities.
  • Handle payroll, benefits, and compensation information with a high level of discretion and confidentiality.

This position allows for growth and career progression to be determined by performance, certifications, and supervisor discretion.

BENEFITS

  • Multiple medical, dental, and vision insurance options to keep you feeling your best
  • 401(k) with employer matching
  • Generous paid time off and paid holidays (plus 2 floating holidays to use your way)
  • Disability, Life, and AD&D Insurance
  • FSA and HSA options with employer contributions
  • Tuition reimbursement — we invest in your growth
  • Casual work attire — no suits required (unless that’s your thing)

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.
  • 5+ years of progressive payroll and benefits administration experience, including multi-state, biweekly payroll for a hybrid hourly/salaried workforce; manufacturing or industrial operations experience strongly preferred.
  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC) preferred
  • Proficiency with Rippling or a similar payroll/HRIS platform, strong Microsoft Excel skills, and experience with multi-state payroll tax compliance tools.
  • Working knowledge of Washington State L&I requirements, garnishment/wage withholding administration, EOR/international payroll models, and multi-state wage and hour compliance; high discretion with confidential data.
  • Strong analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and accuracy under deadline pressure.
  • Ability to communicate payroll and benefits information clearly and tactfully to employees, shift supervisors, and leadership. Ability to manage highly confidential employee and compensation data with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Strong organizational skills, able to manage multiple concurrent deadlines (timecard cycles, tax notices, garnishment orders) in a fast-paced, multi-shift environment.
  • Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new payroll/HRIS systems and process improvements.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Compensation for this role is between $105,000 - $135,000 annually
  • This role may qualify for a discretionary bonus, recognizing outstanding contributions to team and company success
  • In compliance with state and local pay transparency laws, the expected compensation for this role is shared above. The range provided is Sedron’s estimate of the base compensation for this role and the final offer will be based on job-related and non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills, and geographic location. Compensation may be adjusted within this range to reflect regional cost-of-living differences in states where Sedron is hiring.

Must be a US Citizen or legal permanent resident for this position. We are unable to sponsor any employment visas.

We are committed to maintaining a drug and alcohol-free work environment, and our employees are expected to comply with all state and federal laws. This is a non-safety sensitive role and all applicants will be subject to applicable pre-employment drug testing and a background check after receiving a conditional offer of employment.

Not sure you meet all the qualifications? We encourage you to still apply! We’ll review your application and may have training opportunities or other positions available.

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role:

We are seeking highly organized and customer-focused commercial Passenger Transportation Bodily Injury Claims Adjusters to join our team, handling claims for limousine, black car, and chauffeured fleets as well as motorcoaches, charter and tour buses, shuttle buses, and school and transit-style passenger buses. The successful candidate will speak with customers on the phone, educating and helping all parties work through their claim to the best possible outcome. You'll handle an inventory of injury claims, triage critical and multi-claimant losses, and deliver best-in-class service to everyone involved, from operators and drivers to passengers, claimants, and their representatives.

The ideal candidate is proactive, curious, forward-thinking, and highly motivated, someone who shows initiative and acts. We work cross-departmentally, so collaboration is a must. You can pivot with the best of them. We're looking for a “get-it-doner.”

Who you are

  • Highly self-motivated and growth-oriented. You're excited by the prospect of being part of a tech-driven claims org.
  • Passionate claim professional who cares about the customer and their experience.
  • Empathetic. You exercise empathy and patience with everyone you interact with, including injured passengers, shaken drivers, and operators facing a serious loss.
  • Proactive daily claims handling mentality with a consistent work-life balance.
  • Creative. You find the right exit ramp (pun intended) for resolving the claim in the client's best interest.
  • Conflict-enjoyer. Conflict does not have to be adversarial, but it must be CONVERSATIONAL, including with claimants and attorneys.
  • Curious. You investigate the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and move to a prompt resolution.
  • Claims maverick, challenging the traditional way claims are executed.
  • Communicative. Engaged. Active listener.
  • Claims collaborator. You work jointly with other departments to proactively resolve claims.
  • And did we mention you have a sense of humor? Claims are hard enough as it is.

What you'll do

  • Provide prompt, courteous, and high-quality service to all involved parties by initiating investigations, responding to inquiries, and resolving claims.
  • Gather necessary information from all parties to initiate the claim and explain policy, coverage, and the appropriate course of action.
  • Manage an inventory of bodily injury claims, establish initial reserves for all potential exposures, and adjust as appropriate throughout the life of the claim.
  • Investigate liability and evaluate injuries and damages, including obtaining and reviewing medical records, bills, and other supporting documentation, and managing multi-claimant passenger losses.
  • Communicate with involved parties and negotiate appropriate settlements with claimants, insureds, and attorneys within approved payment authority.
  • Oversee and direct outside investigative service providers and work closely with the client, client counsel, and defense counsel to resolve the claim, including litigated files.
  • Recognize recovery opportunities, including contribution and subrogation, and identify claims that require escalation.
  • Ensure compliance with state and federal regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures.
  • Engage in learning opportunities to build knowledge of commercial passenger carrier claims, court decisions impacting the claims function, current claim guidelines, and policy changes and modifications.
  • Provide input for continuous improvement of claim guidelines and processes, best in class.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience on commercial transportation bodily injury claims, ideally limousine, livery, motorcoach, charter, or other passenger carrier operations, with 7 years of overall claims handling from different lines of business.
  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications).
  • Active adjuster license: resident-state license where available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license. Obtain any additional required licenses within 60 days, including state testing.
  • Knowledge of state and federal regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures, including familiarity with passenger carrier operations and coverage considerations.
  • Experience managing litigated files and working with defense counsel.
  • Ability to analyze and evaluate claims data and make sound decisions based on established guidelines, policies, and procedures. Ability to complete accurate and timely coverage analysis.

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Sr Analyst Model Risk & AI, Gen AI Model Validation

The Hartford’s Model Risk Management function seeks a Senior Analyst to join a talented and high-performing Model Risk Management team. The successful candidate will lead model validation efforts of Generative AI (GenAI) and agentic AI models used across the enterprise. The candidate will independently review, challenge, and validate models to ensure they meet internal model risk management standards, regulatory expectations, and ethical AI principles.

The Hartford utilizes advanced analytics, predictive, AI/ML, and Generative AI models as well as traditional actuarial models in a variety of important and critical business functions. The Model Risk Management team manages model risk across The Hartford by validating these models, implementing consistent policies and standards, and maintaining appropriate model oversight. jobs.title: Bilingual VA Medical Admin - Personal Injury / MedPay - ID48691941406
jobs.excerpt: Position OverviewWe are seeking a Bilingual English/Spanish Virtual Medical Administrative Assistant to support a busy chiropractic practice specializing in Personal Injury (PI), MedPay, attorney liens, insurance coordination, and DOT examinations.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Bilingual English/Spanish Virtual Medical Administrative Assistant to support a busy chiropractic practice specializing in Personal Injury (PI), MedPay, attorney liens, insurance coordination, and DOT examinations.

This position is highly focused on Personal Injury administrative workflows, patient communication, insurance/MedPay follow-up, attorney coordination, and new-patient lead conversion.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience working with Personal Injury patients and insurance-related cases, understand how MedPay and attorney liens are handled, and be comfortable communicating with patients, attorneys, law offices, insurance adjusters, and medical providers.

Strong phone skills are essential. The VA will be responsible for helping move a case from the initial inquiry through scheduling and ongoing administrative follow-up.

Top Responsibilities

1. Personal Injury, MedPay & Attorney Lien Coordination

This is the primary area of focus for the position.

The VA should understand the basic administrative workflow of Personal Injury cases and be comfortable coordinating information between patients, attorneys, insurance companies, and medical providers.

Responsibilities include:

  • Assist with the intake and coordination of new Personal Injury patients.
  • Collect accident, attorney, insurance, and claim information.
  • Determine whether a patient has MedPay coverage, when applicable.
  • Obtain and document available MedPay information, including insurance carrier, claim information, policy details, and available case/claim numbers.
  • Follow up with insurance companies and adjusters regarding MedPay-related information.
  • Communicate with attorneys and law offices regarding patient cases.
  • Obtain and document attorney contact information and case details.
  • Understand and work with attorney liens / lien-based treatment according to the practice's procedures.
  • Request, track, and follow up on Letters of Protection (LOPs), attorney liens, or related documentation, when applicable.
  • Confirm whether the attorney is representing the patient and obtain the appropriate law-office contact information.
  • Communicate with attorneys regarding treatment status, records, billing, and case-related administrative questions.
  • Track outstanding information required to move a PI case forward.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of insurance, attorney, claim, and case information in the appropriate system.
  • Follow up on incomplete PI files and missing documentation.
  • Escalate issues involving coverage, authorization, liability, or billing to the appropriate member of the practice.
  • Maintain strict HIPAA compliance when handling patient and case information.

2. Obtaining Case Numbers & Information From Providers, Attorneys and Insurance Companies

The VA should be comfortable making outbound calls to obtain information needed to process and coordinate Personal Injury cases.

This may include contacting:

Attorneys / Law Offices

  • Request the attorney's name and contact information.
  • Obtain the patient's case number/file number, when applicable.
  • Confirm representation of the patient.
  • Request lien/LOP documentation when required.
  • Confirm where medical records and billing should be sent.
  • Follow up on missing or incomplete case information.

Insurance Companies / Adjusters

  • Obtain the claim number.
  • Identify the assigned adjuster.
  • Obtain adjuster contact information.
  • Confirm available MedPay coverage and relevant policy information.
  • Document insurance information accurately.
  • Follow up when information is missing or pending.

Medical Providers / Referral Sources

  • Obtain referral information.
  • Request the appropriate case/reference number when applicable.
  • Confirm where records or documentation should be sent.
  • Coordinate patient information between providers.
  • Follow up on missing records or referral documentation.

The candidate must be comfortable saying, in professional terms, "I need to obtain the case/claim information for this patient" and confidently navigating the conversation until the required information is obtained.

3. Phone & Patient Support

Phone communication will be a major component of this role.

Responsibilities include:

  • Handle inbound and outbound calls.
  • Provide phone coverage during regular business hours.
  • Provide Saturday morning phone coverage.
  • Respond promptly to new-patient inquiries.
  • Schedule new patients.
  • Prioritize and schedule Personal Injury referrals.
  • Follow up on missed calls and new leads.
  • Collect patient demographics and referral information.
  • Explain basic administrative processes to patients.
  • Communicate professionally with patients in English and Spanish.
  • Follow up with patients who have not yet scheduled.
  • Maintain a professional, empathetic, and confident phone presence.
  • Identify opportunities to convert inquiries into scheduled appointments.

The candidate should be comfortable handling calls from patients who may be calling immediately after an accident and should be able to collect the necessary information while keeping the conversation organized and professional.

4. Insurance & Medical Administrative Support

Responsibilities may include:

  • Insurance verification and information gathering.
  • MedPay information gathering and follow-up.
  • Personal Injury insurance coordination.
  • Workers' Compensation-related administrative support.
  • Communicating with insurance adjusters.
  • Communicating with attorneys and law offices.
  • Tracking outstanding insurance information.
  • Requesting and following up on medical records.
  • Maintaining accurate patient and insurance documentation.
  • Coordinating referrals.
  • Following HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.
  • Escalating coverage or billing questions when appropriate.

The candidate does not need to make insurance coverage or legal decisions. They must know how to gather the correct information, document it accurately, follow up, and escalate issues appropriately.

5. Marketing, Lead Generation & Business Development

The practice also wants the VA to help generate and convert new business, particularly for DOT examinations.

Responsibilities include:

  • Conduct outbound calls to prospective patients and leads.
  • Follow up with DOT examination inquiries.
  • Convert inquiries into scheduled appointments.
  • Re-engage leads who have not scheduled.
  • Maintain organized lead follow-up.
  • Follow up consistently until a lead has a clear outcome.
  • Identify potential referral opportunities.
  • Assist with outreach to potential referral sources.
  • Support business-development initiatives.
  • Help increase appointment volume for DOT examinations.
  • Maintain accurate lead and contact information.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a bilingual medical administrative professional with strong Personal Injury and insurance experience who is highly confident on the phone.

They should be able to:

Answer the phone → Understand the patient's situation → Collect the correct PI/insurance information → Identify the attorney and case details → Obtain MedPay/claim information → Contact providers or attorneys for missing information → Schedule the patient → Document everything → Follow up until the case moves forward.

They should also be comfortable switching between patient support, insurance/PI coordination, attorney communication, and outbound business development throughout the day.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bilingual English/Spanish – required
  • 2+ years of experience supporting a U.S.-based medical practice.
  • Strong inbound and outbound phone experience.
  • Excellent English and Spanish communication skills.
  • Medical appointment scheduling experience.
  • Strong patient/customer service skills.
  • Experience communicating with patients by phone.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to handle confidential patient information.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality.
  • Comfortable making outbound calls to patients, attorneys, providers, and insurance companies.

Strongly Preferred Experience

  • Personal Injury (PI) medical office experience
  • MedPay experience
  • Attorney lien / LOP experience
  • Insurance verification or insurance coordination
  • Workers' Compensation experience
  • Experience obtaining claim numbers
  • Experience obtaining case numbers from attorneys or law firms
  • Experience communicating with insurance adjusters
  • Experience communicating with personal injury attorneys
  • Chiropractic office experience
  • Medical records experience
  • Referral coordination
  • DOT examination experience
  • Lead generation and conversion
  • Business development
  • ChiroTouch Cloud
  • RingCentral

Benefits

Schedule & Compensation

  • Employment Type: Full-Time – 40 hours per week
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, plus Saturday morning coverage
  • Hours: 10:00 AM–7:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday
  • Saturday: Morning shift; specific hours to be determined by the practice
  • Compensation: Hourly rate is negotiable and will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, professional background, and relevant expertise, particularly in Personal Injury, MedPay, insurance coordination, attorney communication, and medical administration.

Category: Nonprofit Charitable Organizations

Lucas James Talent Partners is recruiting on behalf of UL Research Institutes.We have an exciting opportunity for aLead AI Research Scientist II atUL Research Institutes. This is a remote based opportunity.

The Lead AI Research Scientist II directs advanced research across specializedareas including natural language processing (NLP); computer vision (CV), signal processing (SP), and AI reasoning.

This role leads AI safety research including literature surveys, AI safety experimental design, AI/software engineering, data acquisition, data analysis, and documentation necessary to execute comprehensive experimental studies. The Lead AI Research Scientist II defines concepts and criteria to resolve major problems in current programs or approaches. Projects require substantial knowledge of state-of-the-art AI and software engineering principles and theories and use professional concepts and procedures to solve a wide range of research-based problems.

UL Research Institutes:

AtUL Research Institutes (ULRI), we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Digital Safety teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice.

Digital Safety Research Institute:

The Digital Safety Research Institute (DSRI) addresses unresolved safety risks and emerging dangers in the world’s digital ecosystem. We aim to help protect people from unwanted access to personal devices and privacy, algorithm, and disinformation threats by working to create a new digital safety ecosystem.

DSRI is committed to sharing digital safety insights, collaborating with key stakeholders, and offering extensive outreach and education to help support safer digital environments for people everywhere.

What you’ll learn and achieve:
As theLead AI Research Scientist II,you will play a key role in the rapid growth ofULas you:

  • Formulate, design, and manage independent test and evaluation research programs to protect the public from AI systems harms – focusing on testing systems enabling the most public harm.
  • Lead and contribute to the development of competitive research proposals, including using the Heilmeier criteria to define scope, methodology, and deliverables, to secure funding for independent AI test and evaluation research programs.
  • Serve as a principal investigator for Digital Safety’s’ independent test and evaluation research programs in their specialty area.

  • Propose and host workshops at leading research conferences in AI safety where research challenge winning methods and their comparative results are discussed to move the field forward in producing results that can have impact in public safety.
  • Stay ahead of changing technologies in the field by reading papers and scientific publications and attending academic conferences.
  • ​Contribute to and/or lead other department specific and cross-functional initiatives.

What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes:We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do.

  • People: Our people make us special. You’ll work with a diverse team of experts respected for their independence and transparency and build a network, because our approach is collaborative. We collaborate across disciplines, organizations, and geographies to build the global scientific response that today’s global challenges require.
  • Interesting work: Every day is different for us here. We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good.
  • Grow and achieve: We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs.
  • Values. Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive.
  • Total Rewards: All employees atUL Research Institutesare eligible for bonus compensation. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days.

What makes you a great fit:

While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes:

  • Demonstrated general knowledge of AI and software engineering disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience securing research funding through competitive proposal development.
  • Demonstrated ability to write and win proposals for leading research workshops.
  • Demonstrated ability to attract invitations to give keynote presentations.
  • Excellent communication skills required.
  • Advanced AI engineering, software engineering, and data analysis skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with research scientists, engineers, team members, and external partners to deliver research outcomes.
  • Ability to publish research results at leading academic conferences.

Professional education and experience requirements for the role include:

  • PhD in Computer Science with a focus in the applicable AI area of specialty plus 8 or more years of directly related research experience.

About UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement

UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagementare nonprofit organizations dedicated to advancing safety science research through the discovery and application of scientific knowledge. We conduct rigorous independent research and analyze safety data, convene experts worldwide to address risks, share knowledge through safety education and public outreach initiatives, and develop standards to guide safe commercialization of evolving technologies. We foster communities of safety, from grassroots initiatives for neighborhoods to summits of world leaders. Our organization employs collaborative and scientific approaches with partners and stakeholders to drive innovation and progress toward improving safety, security, and sustainability, ultimately enhancing societal well-being.

jobs.description:
We're looking for an Internal Account Manager to own client relationships at Hire Overseas, a fast-moving offshore staffing and HR platform placing vetted global talent into U.S. companies. This is a small business. There is no large team behind you and no playbook for every situation. You will have a high degree of ownership and autonomy, which means you make real decisions, handle real problems, and have a direct impact on whether clients stay and grow. If you are a confident communicator who takes ownership instinctively, moves fast when something needs attention, and wants a role where your judgment actually matters, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Work directly with founders at a growing offshore staffing company with real traction and a strong client base
  • High-ownership role with full autonomy over how you manage and grow your client portfolio

Client Relationship Management

What You Bring

  • High ownership mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes rather than passing problems up or sideways

jobs.title: Enterprise Deployment Lead
jobs.excerpt: About MenloMenlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it.
jobs.description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role

We are looking for an Enterprise Deployments Lead to own Menlo's enterprise customer engagements, from first discovery through a working robotics deployment and the follow-on purchase that comes after it. Every engagement you run has a committed buyer, a clear definition of success, and an implementation plan that keeps moving. This is a hands-on role combining commercial qualification, customer relationship management, and technical project leadership. You own the customer engagement and delivery plan; engineering owns technical feasibility, design, and implementation, and you make commitments and deliver against them together.

What You'll Do

  • Qualify opportunities by understanding customer workflows and business needs, and identifying the champion, budget owner, operational stakeholders, and purchasing process

  • Define scope and success with customers and engineering: feasible deliverables, measurable acceptance criteria, budgets, timelines, responsibilities, and exclusions

  • Lead implementation across Menlo's engineering and implementation teams, partners, and customer teams

  • Set owners and milestones, track progress, resolve blockers, manage scope changes, and escalate risks early

  • Demonstrate results against agreed criteria and secure customer sign-off

  • Turn successful deployments into production purchases and broader adoption

  • Bring field learnings back to product and engineering so every next deployment is faster to scope and deliver

What We Look For

  • Experience leading complex, customer-facing technical projects in robotics or an adjacent field

  • Ability to navigate customer organizations and get to the real buyer, budget, and decision process

  • Technical fluency to discuss tradeoffs credibly with engineers; hands-on robotics development is not required

  • Commercial judgment to build credible business cases and qualify out projects that are not funded or feasible

  • Comfort holding cross-functional teams accountable to scope, milestones, and budget

  • A track record of well-qualified, funded projects delivered within scope and converted into production or follow-on purchases

Nice to Have

  • Experience deploying robots, automation, or physical systems in live environments such as warehouses, factories, or logistics

  • Background in solutions engineering, technical account management, or professional services at a hardware or deep tech company

  • Familiarity with pilot-to-production commercial models and milestone-based acceptance

  • Experience running joint deployments with system integrators or channel partners

Why Join Menlo

You will be the person who takes humanoid robots out of the lab and into real customer operations. Every deployment you land proves the economics of humanoid labor and shapes what Menlo builds next. If you want to be measured on robots doing real work rather than slideware, this is the place.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:
About the role

Isos Technology is looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead our most complex, multi-client delivery within the professional services practice. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a PM who can own our highest-stakes engagements, set the standard for how we deliver, and raise the capability of the PMs around them.

At Isos, seniority isn’t about time in seat. We level on scope, complexity, influence, and sustained impact — not tenure. A Senior PM consistently operates at a higher level of complexity, carries our most demanding client relationships, and can be trusted to deliver in ambiguity without a playbook handed to them.

What you’ll do

  • Lead delivery across multiple concurrent client engagements, owning scope, schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholders on each.
  • Take on the toughest, highest-visibility projects in the portfolio — the ones with the most moving parts, the most senior client stakeholders, or the most delivery risk.
  • Act as a consultative partner to clients, not just a coordinator — anticipating problems, guiding decisions, and protecting the outcome.
  • Set and hold delivery standards: consistent use of our internal processes, tooling, and artifacts (backlogs, schedules, status, governance) so quality doesn’t depend on who’s assigned.
  • Mentor and level up other PMs and delivery team members; serve as an SME and a model for how the role is done well.
  • Manage to your [billable/utilization target] while balancing the demands of several clients at once.

What sets a Senior PM apart (how we level)

Because we don’t level on tenure, these are the differentiators we look for:

  • Scope & complexity — you regularly run engagements of significant size, complexity, and stakeholder difficulty, and you’ve done it across a meaningful number of projects, not just once.
  • Multi-client capability (required) — you handle multiple clients simultaneously, with the context-switching, prioritization, and range that demands. Deeply dedicated single-client portfolio leadership is the Program Manager lane, not Senior PM.
  • Influence — you shape how we deliver, not just what gets delivered; other PMs and consultants are better because of how you work.
  • Consultative judgment — clients trust you with decisions, not just task tracking.
  • Order under ambiguity — you bring structure without needing everything pre-built for you.

Requirements

  • 6 years of project management experience in professional services or consulting delivery, including 6 years running multiple concurrent client engagements.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, high-risk, or high-visibility projects to successful outcomes.
  • Strong command of both traditional and agile delivery (backlog management, iteration planning, product-owner collaboration).
  • Fluency in our delivery tooling ([Jira, Confluence]) and a track record of following and enforcing standard delivery processes.
  • Comfort in a lean, fast-changing environment — building what isn’t there rather than waiting for structure.

Preferred certifications & accreditations

  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe, or comparable agile credential
  • Atlassian accreditations ([Jira, Confluence, relevant technical accreditations])
  • Relevant AI-delivery or tooling accreditations

Who thrives here

Isos is a lean, fast-evolving practice. The people who do best embrace ambiguity, treat gaps as a chance to put their mark on something rather than a problem handed to them, and can hold structure and flexibility in the same hand. If you need every process defined before you can move, this won’t be the right fit. If you like bringing order to a little healthy chaos, you’ll do well here.

About Isos Technology

Isos Technology is a premier consulting services provider dedicated to empowering organizations through technology, people, and best practices. Founded in 2005, we began by creating Enterprise Java solutions and quickly embraced Jira and Confluence to enhance our consulting practice. Recognizing the power of these tools, we transitioned to become an Atlassian Partner in 2014 and attained Platinum Solution Partner status in 2016. Today, we're focused solely on Atlassian, with a mission to excel as the top Atlassian consulting firm in the US. In 2022, Isos joined The Acacia Group and expanded its reach by acquiring MajorKey Technologies, HyperVelocity Consulting, and Stack Intelligence's Atlassian practices. This strategic growth solidifies our position as one of the largest Platinum Solution Partners in the Atlassian ecosystem!

This position is primarily a work from home position and we consider applicants throughout the United States. We support pay transparency and the On-Target Earnings range for this position is between $120,000 - 130,000 (this role is eligible for incentive compensation based on company performance) combined plus a suite of employee benefits, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan with an employer contribution. Actual compensation can vary based on qualifications, experience, additional incentive opportunities, and geographic pay differentials.

Isos Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, color, age, physical or mental disability, spousal affiliation, marital status, a serious medical condition, genetic information, veteran status or any other basis prohibited by federal, state, or local law. Candidates must be willing to participate in and successfully pass a background check and pre-employment drug testing and be authorized to work in the United States. You'll design most of what Cambridge Spark publishes on social, with LinkedIn as the main channel. That covers the company page and the profiles of our senior people. It's a hands-on making job, and you'll use AI tools every day to get more done and try things a small team couldn't otherwise manage. It suits someone early in their design career who's ready for a big step up. As the team grows there's plenty of room to grow with it.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design LinkedIn content, including single-image posts, infographics, carousels, motion graphics and event promotion

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

jobs.excerpt: Meet the Moment with AlteryxWe're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done.
jobs.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Title: Software Engineer - Orchestration & Job Execution (Cloud Platform)

Alteryx is looking for a Software Engineer to join our cloud platform engineering team, with a focus on orchestration, job execution, workflow runtime services, and shared control-plane/data-plane capabilities. In this role, you will help design, build, operate, and evolve backend services that coordinate how work moves through Alteryx Cloud. You will work on platform capabilities related to orchestration, job execution, workflow runtime services, and reliable service-to-service coordination. The role is backend-heavy and involves building APIs, services, workers, libraries, and runtime infrastructure. You will work with modern cloud-native systems and technologies such as TypeScript/Node.js, relational databases, messaging or queueing systems, event-driven architecture, containers, Kubernetes, and observability tooling. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who writes modular, readable, and performant code, understands trade-offs in time, complexity, and maintainability, and leverages AI to improve productivity. You should be comfortable learning existing systems, designing small features, writing clear tests, and debugging behavior across services with guidance from experienced engineers. You will partner with platform, product, security, quality, and application teams to make orchestration and job execution capabilities reliable, understandable, and secure.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and deliver backend services, APIs, workers, and shared libraries that power cloud platform capabilities.
  • Build and improve systems for orchestrating work across services, including job submission, execution tracking, status propagation, retries, cancellation, results, and operational visibility.
  • Develop reliable asynchronous and event-driven systems using queues, messaging, background workers, and durable state.
  • Work on distributed execution flows across platform services, including service-to-service communication, routing, acknowledgements, and failure recovery.
  • Build and maintain cloud-native runtime infrastructure using containers, Kubernetes, deployment automation, and related platform tooling.
  • Integrate platform services with persistence layers, event streams, REST APIs, and internal service contracts.
  • Improve production reliability through metrics, tracing, structured logging, health checks, dashboards, alerting, runbooks, and incident follow-up.
  • Participate constructively in code reviews, identify common bugs and style issues, and apply feedback to improve the quality of your work.
  • Collaborate with partner teams to turn product requirements into incremental, testable, and operable platform capabilities.
  • Use AI and modern development tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and delivery speed.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining production software, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience building backend services, APIs, or background workers and writing modular, readable, and performant code independently, preferably using TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Experience owning feature-level work with moderate ambiguity, including basic design of small-to-medium systems or APIs and independent decisions within feature scope.
  • Understanding of asynchronous and distributed processing concepts such as task dependencies, state transitions, retries, cancellation, idempotency, concurrency, and timeouts.

Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

jobs.description:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Manager, Editorial & Content is responsible for developing and producing clear, effective content across Empower Pharmacy's corporate communications, website, newsroom, and marketing channels. Reporting to the VP of Corporate Communications, this role serves as a lead writer and editor, supporting business priorities through audience-focused content that strengthens awareness, understanding, and trust in Empower's personalized, compounded medications.

This is a hands-on storytelling role for a strong writer; someone with a journalist’s instincts who can tell a great story in any format, producing a steady stream of articles, bylines, whitepapers, website copy, social posts, short-form stories, and marketing content. Success in this position requires strong writing and editing skills, comfort managing multiple stakeholders and review cycles, and the ability to translate complex healthcare and pharmacy topics into clear, compelling stories that audiences actually want to read.

The role partners closely with communications, marketing, digital, legal, and clinical teams to plan, develop, and optimize content within a highly regulated environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Content Creation and Storytelling

  • Content Creation: Serve as Empower’s lead storyteller and writer for corporate communications, website content, and other marketing collateral.
  • Volume Production: Write, edit, and publish a steady stream of content in every format — from long-form articles and whitepapers to quick-turn posts and short-form stories — across digital and marketing channels while managing multiple stakeholders and competing deadlines.
  • Narrative Development: Shape executive, corporate, and thought-leadership narratives that advance business priorities and strengthen stakeholder trust, applying strong news judgment to identify and develop story angles across the business, from patient impact to scientific innovation.

Editorial Standards and Collaboration

  • Editorial Standards: Help maintain editorial standards, content review processes, and quality controls to ensure brand consistency, accuracy, compliance, and reputational integrity.
  • Content Planning: Lead cross-functional content planning and execution in partnership with digital, marketing, clinical, legal, and freelance contributors.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Build alignment, resolve tradeoffs, and support complex work across functions and levels.

Content Innovation and Optimization

  • Format Innovation: Take an innovative approach to content, stretching a single piece of content across multiple formats and channels, including video, and using AI and analytics to build, shape, and scale content efficiently.
  • Technology Adoption: Advance responsible use of SEO, generative engine optimization, and emerging content technologies to improve discoverability, efficiency, and quality.
  • Insight Application: Use audience, search, social listening, competitive, and performance insights to prioritize opportunities, manage narrative risk, and optimize the content portfolio.

Performance and Accountability

  • Content Performance: Track content performance, including audience growth, site traffic, and contribution to marketing-qualified leads, and adjust the editorial plan based on performance against those targets.
  • Performance Reporting: Define success measures, report insights and recommendations to leadership, and adjust investments based on business and reputation impact.
  • Speed Precision: Balance speed and precision, moving quickly on time-sensitive content without sacrificing accuracy or compliance.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Exceptional writing, editing, and editorial judgment, supported by a portfolio that includes journalism-style writing and storytelling across long- and short-form content, executive and corporate communications, website copy and page development, B2B marketing campaigns, and long-form content.
  • Ability to translate complex healthcare, pharmacy, and business topics into engaging, easy-to-understand content that supports business and communications objectives.
  • Working knowledge of content analytics, SEO, social listening, content management systems, and responsible AI-enabled tools.
  • Skilled at managing multiple projects, deadlines, review cycles, and competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and delivering consistently high-quality work.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Seven or more years of progressive experience in journalism, editorial, corporate communications, content strategy, or content marketing, including leadership of complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to build scalable editorial operations, influence senior stakeholders, and lead through others without direct authority.
  • Track record of driving measurable content outcomes, such as site traffic growth or MQLs, and working at speed on tight turnarounds without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience; experience in healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, or another highly regulated industry strongly preferred. Background in journalism, a newsroom, or an agency editorial team is a strong plus.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

Values:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

Employee Benefits, Health and Wellness:

We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more:

Physical Requirements:

While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. The employee is often required to remain in a stationary position for a significant amount of the workday and frequently use their hands and fingers to handle or feel in order to access, input, and retrieve information from the computer and other office productivity devices. Employees are regularly required to move about the office and around the corporate campus. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

Better Impact has strong fundamentals: a large market, a proven demo-to-close motion, and leadership actively investing in the tools, training, and pricing structure that help our sales team succeed.   • Run discovery and demos from the volunteer’s perspective first, not just the administrator’s, using Better Impact’s established demo methodology and closing process.

  • Maintain accurate and current HubSpot data, including deal stage, next steps, key decision-makers, budget holders, and expected close dates, so forecasts can be trusted.
  • Partner with SDR/BDR team members and Customer Success on clean handoffs so new customers begin onboarding with clear expectations and the right contacts.
  • Stay current on Better Impact’s products, pricing, and competitive positioning, and bring customer and market feedback back to the broader team.

Requirements

What you bring

  • 2+ years of full-cycle sales experience, ideally in SaaS or software, with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Experience building and running your own outbound sequences using Apollo, Sales Navigator, or similar tools, alongside working inbound opportunities.
  • Comfort working in a demo-driven sales environment with a relatively high level of activity and deal velocity, rather than a long, low-volume enterprise sales cycle.
  • Strong discovery and objection-handling skills, with the ability to sell value and outcomes to buyers who aren't evaluating technology for technology's sake.
  • Experience or genuine comfort selling to mission-driven, budget-conscious organisations such as not-for-profits, government, healthcare, or education, including the ability to establish urgency and demonstrate value without becoming transactional.
  • Disciplined pipeline and CRM management, including accurate and current data, reliable forecasting, and consistent follow-through on next steps.
  • A demonstrated ability to take on feedback and coaching — including call reviews, scorecards, or scripting — and apply it to your work.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present comfortably to everyone from an individual volunteer coordinator to a broader buying committee.

  • Experience with volunteer management, case management, CSR/ESG, or other mission-driven or compliance-adjacent SaaS categories.

  • Experience with a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC, Sandler, or similar, and comfort working from an established sales process and closing checklist.

Benefits

This is a full-time position with Better Impact’s Australian business.

The position also includes applicable Australian employment entitlements, including annual and personal leave, long service leave, and workers’ compensation coverage.
