jobs.description:
About the Role

Keep the science moving. As a Purchasing Assistant III, you are the person who gets researchers and staff the supplies and services they need, on time, on budget, and in line with Laboratory procurement policy.

This is a fully remote position at the most experienced level of the Purchasing Assistant career ladder. You will work with a high degree of independence, solve complex problems, take on special projects, and help train colleagues. You will work with a wide mix of internal customers and outside suppliers, so strong relationships and clear communication matter as much as attention to detail.


This role is fully remote

Salary Range: $25.34– $36.75 based on years of related experience and internal equity considerations


What You Will Do

  • Place and manage orders. Review purchase requests for completeness and accuracy, prioritize them, and choose the best way to process each one based on cost, timing, and competitive bidding. Place orders with vendors, including orders for controlled substances, prescription drugs, and radioactive items, and confirm prices, availability, and delivery. All work follows Laboratory procurement policies and local, state, and federal guidelines.
  • Keep accurate records. Update purchase orders in the computer system with a high degree of accuracy. Maintain records of supplies, amounts ordered and received, and actual sales for items and vendors.
  • Follow through on delivery. Track orders so materials and services arrive on the promised dates.
  • Work with vendors and end users. Coordinate, facilitate, and resolve day-to-day procurement issues. Coordinate on-campus vendor shows.
  • Support and advise colleagues. Give routine advice and support to end users on the procurement process and documentation. Help with user training and problem resolution as needed.
  • Find better sources. Seek new sources of supplies and services and secure favorable terms for the Laboratory.
  • Support daily operations. Perform other duties as required, such as scheduling equipment maintenance and services, adjusting grant encumbrances and rolling them into the next year, maintaining the catalog library, and filing. Assist in the operation of a maintenance stock room and receiving dock.

Requirements

  • Education: High school diploma or GED. A combination of education and experience may be considered. Associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Experience: 5 + years in the same or a similar role.
  • Ability to draw solutions from a wider range of experience, adapt methods to solve complex problems, and resolve them in a timely manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to guide and train others.
  • Ability to negotiate the best price and service while working within Laboratory procurement policies and procedures.
  • Proven ability to organize time, work under time constraints, meet deadlines, and prioritize work.
  • Demonstrated ability to take over special projects and follow through to completion.
  • Ability to perform basic information research, gather and compile data, and prepare reports.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and accurate data entry.
  • Effective interpersonal skills for working with a wide variety of people and personalities, including internal customers and external suppliers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to operate computer hardware and software applications normally found in a business setting.
  • Team player with positive and professional behavior, and the judgment to recognize the limits of your responsibility and direct issues to the appropriate people.
  • Ability to lift a minimum of 50 pounds when assisting in the maintenance stock room or receiving dock.

About JAX:

The Jackson Laboratory is an independent, nonprofit biomedical research institution with a National Cancer Institute-designated Cancer Center and nearly 3,000 employees in locations across the United States (Maine, Connecticut, California, New York, Florida), Japan and China. Its mission is to discover precise genomic solutions for disease and empower the global biomedical community in the shared quest to improve human health.


Founded in 1929, JAX applies over nine decades of expertise in genetics to increase understanding of human disease, advancing treatments and cures for cancer, neurological and immune disorders, diabetes, aging and heart disease. It models and interprets genomic complexity, integrates basic research with clinical application, educates current and future scientists, and provides critical data, tools and services to the global biomedical community. For more information, please visit www.jax.org​​​​​​​.

By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at .

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Social & Integrated Campaigns to develop and bring to life differentiated, platform-native campaigns across organic social, influencer, and CTV.

This is a senior, hands-on creative role for someone who can move seamlessly from insight to idea to execution. You’ll develop campaign concepts, write scripts, build storyboards, and partner closely with social, influencer, production, account, and strategy teams to ensure every idea is elevated, ownable, and uniquely suited to the brand.

The ideal candidate understands how to build ideas that work across channels without creating the same content everywhere. They have a strong understanding of social culture, creator-led storytelling, and premium video—and know how to turn a product, audience insight, or cultural moment into a compelling creative platform.

Retail experience is strongly preferred, particularly experience developing campaigns around products, promotions, seasonal moments, and fast-moving cultural trends.

What you’ll do

  • Lead creative concepting for integrated campaigns spanning organic social, influencer, and CTV.
  • Translate brand objectives, audience insights, social trends, and cultural moments into distinctive creative platforms and campaign ideas.
  • Develop campaign narratives, creative territories, scripts, storyboards, treatments, shot lists, and other materials needed to bring ideas to life.
  • Adapt ideas thoughtfully across platforms, formats, audiences, and stages of the customer journey.
  • Partner with social Leads, influencer marketers, producers, account teams, designers, editors, and external production partners throughout the creative process.
  • Provide clear creative direction and feedback from initial concepting through production and post-production.
  • Ensure creative work feels native to each platform while remaining cohesive and recognizable as part of a larger campaign.
  • Identify opportunities to use creators as more than distribution partners, including as talent, storytellers, and collaborators in the creative development process.
  • Present and defend creative recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.
  • Balance ambitious creative thinking with budgets, timelines, production realities, brand guidelines, and platform requirements.
  • Stay close to emerging formats, creator behaviors, platform trends, and shifts in how audiences consume content.
  • Use performance insights and audience response to strengthen future creative recommendations.
  • Raise the creative bar across teams by sharing inspiration, developing best practices, and helping others push ideas further.

What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in creative strategy, content strategy, copywriting, art direction, or integrated campaign development.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong campaign ideas and storytelling across social, influencer, digital video, and/or CTV.
  • Experience taking work from initial insight and concept through production and final delivery.
  • Strong scriptwriting, storytelling, presentation, and visual communication skills.
  • Experience creating storyboards, treatments, creative decks, or other materials that clearly communicate an idea.
  • Deep understanding of social platforms, creator culture, and platform-native content.
  • Ability to develop ideas that are both creatively ambitious and executable.
  • Strong creative judgment and the ability to provide clear, constructive feedback across disciplines.
  • Confidence presenting creative work and articulating the strategic thinking behind it.
  • Highly collaborative, with experience partnering across creative, strategy, account, influencer, social, and production teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns and move effectively within fast-paced timelines.

Preferred experience

  • Experience working with retail, consumer, lifestyle, food and beverage, beauty, or CPG brands.
  • Understanding of retail campaign rhythms, including seasonal moments, product launches, promotional periods, and high-volume content needs.
  • Experience developing creator-led campaigns and working directly with influencers or talent.
  • Experience concepting and scripting for CTV, streaming, YouTube, or other long-form and premium video formats.
  • Agency or in-house brand experience working across multiple channels and stakeholders.

What success looks like

    • Campaign ideas are distinctive, ownable, and rooted in a clear audience or brand insight.
    • Creative feels native to each channel while connecting back to one cohesive idea.
    • Teams have a clear creative vision that carries consistently from concept through execution.
    • Clients view this person as a trusted creative partner who brings fresh, actionable thinking.
    • The work raises the creative standard across organic social, influencer, and CTV.

How you work:

  • Driven by Impact: You deliver results that matter—prioritizing high-value work, meeting deadlines, and adapting quickly while keeping outcomes clear.
  • Strategic & Customer-Centric: You anticipate risks and opportunities, connect decisions to long-term growth, and build trust through proactive insights.
  • Curious & Growth-Oriented: You seek knowledge, ask sharp questions, and apply learnings fast—challenging the status quo with a mindset of improvement.
  • Collaborative & Resilient: You thrive in change by staying resourceful, solution-focused, and positive—removing roadblocks, sharing insights, and keeping morale high.
  • Accountable & Honest: You own your work, hold yourself and others to a high bar, and use transparent feedback to drive growth.
  • Emotionally Intelligent: You build trust through empathy and collaboration, foster inclusion, and inspire others with grit, optimism, and integrity.

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Salary Range:

$130,000 - $145,000 OTE

*Co-op team members, independent contractors, and freelancers are not eligible for company benefits.

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or age. Please let us know if you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process.

Soft Skills:

Demonstrated ability to balance strategic vision with hands-on operational execution.

Job title:Strategic Partnerships Manager

Reports to:VP, Priority Commerce - Revenue Management

Department:Central Services

Location:Remote

Grade:18

About Priority:

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people tobe known for results- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

About the Role:

The Strategic Partnerships Manager is responsible for advancing high-value commercial opportunities from initial executive or partner sponsorship through contract execution and transition to implementation.

The Strategic Partnerships Manager serves as the commercial owner once a qualified opportunity has been introduced through executive leadership, strategic partners, or other relationship-driven channels. The role creates structure and momentum around the deal, coordinates internal and external stakeholders, works through commercial and contractual requirements, and ensures prospects have a clear understanding of Priority’s operating model, responsibilities, and expectations before implementation begins.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Deal Execution

  • Take ownership of qualified strategic opportunities once they have been sourced by executive leadership, external partners, Business Development, or other internal channels.

  • Establish and manage the deal plan, including key milestones, outstanding decisions, dependencies, stakeholders, and target close dates.

  • Maintain consistent momentum throughout the closing process and proactively identify issues that could delay execution.

  • Coordinate follow-up across internal teams and the prospective client to ensure commitments, decisions, and deliverables are completed on time.

  • Serve as a primary point of coordination for the prospect during the commercial closing phase.

Commercial & Contract Coordination

  • Lead discussions regarding commercial terms and conditions within established deal parameters.

  • Coordinate contract review and redline resolution between the prospect, Legal, Sales, Revenue Management, Risk & Compliance, and other internal stakeholders.

  • Help translate contractual or operational requirements into clear business terms for prospective clients.

  • Escalate non-standard commercial terms, pricing exceptions, contractual risks, or other deal considerations to the appropriate decision-makers.

  • Ensure final commercial structures are consistent with approved pricing, economics, and deal frameworks.

Banking, Treasury & Regulatory Expectations

  • Help prospects understand Priority Commerces’ operating model and their respective responsibilities within the relationship.

  • Clearly communicate client obligations associated with money movement, including applicable operational, compliance, and licensing considerations.

  • Partner with Risk & Compliance, Legal, Treasury, and Operations when additional guidance or clarification is required.

  • Ensure material responsibilities, dependencies, and requirements are understood before contractual commitments are finalized.

  • Identify potential operational or regulatory concerns early in the process and engage appropriate subject-matter experts.

Deal Coordination & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Bring together the appropriate internal stakeholders to resolve open commercial, contractual, operational, technical, or compliance-related issues.

  • Facilitate deal meetings and maintain clear documentation of decisions, owners, and next steps.

  • Create visibility into deal status and escalate unresolved issues that may jeopardize timing or execution.

  • Partner closely with executive sponsors while increasingly assuming responsibility for the day-to-day progression of the opportunity.

  • Maintain accurate deal status, notes, milestones, and next steps within the CRM or applicable sales management tools.

Client Transition & Onboarding Readiness

  • Prepare clients for a successful transition from the sales process into implementation.

  • Introduce the appropriate onboarding and implementation resources at the right stage of the deal.

  • Ensure onboarding teams receive clear documentation regarding the agreed commercial structure, client expectations, commitments, requirements, and known complexities.

  • Facilitate a formal handoff between the client, executive or sales sponsor, and onboarding team.

  • Stay engaged through the transition period when necessary to resolve commitments or questions originating during the sales process.

Sales & Executive Opportunity Support

  • Support executive leadership and senior sales resources on strategically important or complex opportunities.

  • Develop a strong understanding of Priority’s capabilities across payments, banking, treasury, and related financial technology solutions.

  • Participate in client conversations and help translate the executive-level vision into a defined commercial path forward.

  • Provide structure and follow-through that allows senior executives and relationship owners to focus on relationship development and strategic selling.

  • Support strategic opportunities originating through referral partners and other externally sourced relationships.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Strategic opportunities maintain momentum from executive introduction through contract execution.

  • Deals have clearly documented next steps, owners, dependencies, and timelines.

  • Contract redlines and commercial questions are actively managed rather than waiting on individual stakeholders.

  • Prospects understand key commercial, operational, compliance, and money-movement responsibilities before signing.

  • Internal stakeholders are engaged early enough to prevent avoidable surprises late in the sales process.

  • Executive sponsors spend less time managing administrative deal progression and more time focused on strategic relationships.

  • Onboarding teams receive complete, accurate handoffs with minimal need to revisit commitments made during the sales process.

  • Strategic deals move from qualified opportunity to signed agreement efficiently without sacrificing appropriate commercial or risk discipline.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • 2–5 years of experience in banking, treasury management, payments, fintech, commercial banking, business development, sales, or a related client-facing financial services role.

  • Working knowledge of treasury services, payment flows, commercial banking products, or money movement.

  • Experience supporting client negotiations, commercial agreements, implementations, or complex relationship management.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple active opportunities simultaneously.

  • Ability to coordinate across Legal, Compliance, Operations, Product, Finance, and Sales.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfortable working directly with clients and senior internal leaders.

  • Ability to understand complex issues and translate them into clear decisions, responsibilities, and next steps.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within fintech, payments, treasury management, commercial banking, or embedded finance.

  • Exposure to contract negotiation and commercial agreement redlines.

  • Familiarity with money transmission, sponsored banking models, payment processing, ACH, wires, or related regulatory considerations.

  • Experience supporting enterprise or strategic client opportunities

Work Environment & Culture:

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand -an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

Compensation and Benefits:

Compensation range:$96k-$118k

We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

Financial Wellness

  • Bonus programs

  • 401(k) match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • HSA and FSA options

  • Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs

Health & Well-being

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health

  • Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot

  • Gym membership reimbursement and virtual wellness programs (including yoga)

Time Off

  • 3 weeks PTO to start, with unlimited PTO after year one

Growth & Development

  • Education expense reimbursement

  • Leadership development programs

  • Certified Payments Professional (CPP) certification support

We believe great performance starts with feeling supported - and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind.

Traditional Physical Requirements:

  • Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending, stooping and stretching.

  • Requires the ability to lift 10 pounds.

  • Requires eye-hand coordination, manual dexterity and a normal range of hearing and vision (with or without correction).

Join our team at Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. and be part of a dynamic and innovative company that is transforming the financial technology landscape. Together, we can shape the future of payments and banking solutions while providing unmatched value to our clients.

jobs.description:
About World Business Lenders

  • At World Business Lenders (WBL), we provide flexible, short-term commercial loans backed by real estate to help small and medium-sized businesses across the United States — particularly those facing difficulties with traditional financing. We're a fast-moving, results-driven organization that takes security seriously as we continue to grow.
  • This is a Full-Time Independent Contractor role with working hours from 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Standard Time, Monday through Friday. We request that all CVs be submitted in English.

About the Role

  • The Senior Credit Underwriter is responsible for leading complex credit underwriting activities while serving as a trusted advisor to the Chief Lending Officer. This role provides expertise in Non-QM mortgage lending, evaluates complex borrower scenarios, structures credit solutions, and supports sound lending decisions that balance risk and business objectives.
  • In addition to underwriting, the role oversees underwriting teams, mentors junior underwriters, drives process improvements, and collaborates cross-functionally to improve credit quality, operational efficiency, and funded loan volume..

What You'll Be Doing (Key Responsibilities)

  • Act as the Chief Lending Officer's 'right hand' trusted advisor.
  • Perform early credit assessments ("shift-left") before processing is complete.
  • Rework denied loans into approvable structures where possible.
  • Recommend counteroffers that reduce risk while preserving profitability.
  • Identify compensating factors to strengthen borderline files.
  • Consult with Sales on structuring loans before submission.
  • Participate in daily pipeline review meetings.
  • Assist in developing underwriting guidelines and SOPs.
  • Analyze trends in denials and fallout to recommend policy or process changes.
  • Support automation efforts by documenting underwriting decision logic.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for complex borrower scenarios.

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Associate's degree.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of progressive underwriting experience in non-QM mortgage lending.

Must-Have Requirements

Please ensure you meet all of the following before applying:

  • 10+ yearsof progressive underwriting experience in Non-QM residential mortgage lending.
  • Proven expertise in credit analysis, risk assessment, and loan structuring, with the ability to evaluate complex borrower scenarios and develop viable lending solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of Non-QM loan products, including DSCR, Bank Statement, Asset Depletion, Foreign National, ITIN, and other alternative documentation programs.
  • Experience interpreting credit policies, underwriting guidelines, and applicable mortgage regulations (e.g., ATR/QM, TRID, RESPA, TILA), with the ability to make sound, consistent credit decisions..

Remote Work Requirements

  • Stable, reliable internet connection.
  • Professional and dedicated remote working setup.

Preferred Background / Industry Experience:

  • Non QM residential mortgage lending / MCA lending.

Key Soft Skills:

  • Critical Thinking – Evaluates complex borrower scenarios, weighs risk objectively, and makes sound credit decisions based on facts rather than assumptions.
  • Analytical Mindset – Identifies trends, assesses layered risk, and connects multiple data points to determine overall creditworthiness.
  • Sound Judgment – Balances prudent risk management with business objectives, knowing when to approve, restructure, or decline a loan.
  • Problem Solving – Finds creative, policy-compliant solutions to structure challenging loans instead of defaulting to denial.
  • Attention to Detail – Thoroughly reviews financials, documentation, and loan files to identify inconsistencies, omissions, or potential risks.
  • Communication – Clearly explains underwriting decisions, credit rationale, and conditions to Sales, Processing, and leadership.
  • Collaboration – Partners effectively with Sales, Processing, Valuation, Legal, and Closing to move loans efficiently while maintaining credit quality.
  • Decision Making Under Pressure – Makes timely, confident decisions in a fast-paced environment without sacrificing accuracy or consistency.
  • Coaching & Mentorship – Develops junior underwriters by sharing expertise, reinforcing best practices, and promoting consistent credit decisions.
  • Integrity & Accountability – Demonstrates strong ethical standards, takes ownership of decisions, and consistently applies credit policy with fairness and discipline.

Specific Technical Skills Needed:

  • Credit Analysis & Risk Assessment – Expertise in evaluating borrower creditworthiness, repayment capacity, collateral, and layered risk.
  • Non-QM Underwriting – Deep knowledge of Non-QM products, including DSCR, Bank Statement, Asset Depletion, Foreign National, ITIN, and other alternative documentation programs.
  • Income, Asset & Cash Flow Analysis – Ability to analyze tax returns, business financials, bank statements, P&Ls, CPA letters, and asset documentation.
  • Collateral & Valuation Review – Experience reviewing appraisals, BPOs, AVMs/IVDs, title reports, LTV/CLTV calculations, and collateral risk.
  • Loan Structuring – Ability to restructure marginal loans, evaluate compensating factors, and develop counteroffers that meet credit policy while maximizing approvals.
  • Credit Policy & Guideline Interpretation – Strong understanding of internal credit policies, investor overlays, and regulatory requirements, with the ability to consistently apply judgment.
  • Regulatory Compliance – Working knowledge of ATR/QM, TRID, RESPA, TILA, Fair Lending, and applicable federal and state lending regulations.
  • Financial & Data Analysis – Advanced proficiency in Excel and the ability to analyze underwriting metrics, portfolio trends, and credit performance.
  • Exception & Portfolio Management – Experience evaluating policy exceptions, monitoring portfolio credit quality, and supporting quality control and audit reviews.
  • Loan Origination Systems (LOS) – Hands-on experience with Encompass, Byte, LendingPad, or similar LOS platforms, including underwriting workflow and condition management.

Benefits

What We Offer

💰 Compensation includes a base salary at $65,000-$85,000.

🏖️ Benefits include medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage; a 401(k) with company match; and paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).

🌍 Work Environment: Fully remote work environment, with occasional travel as needed for leadership off-sites and corporate events.

Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you - submit your CV in English and hit Apply!

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

    3. High-cost care management
    4. Emergency department utilization reduction
    5. Advance care planning
    6. Reduction in readmission
  11. Monitor daily reports and EHR-based alerts to identify patients in need of outreach or follow-up based on clinical risk or recent utilization.
  12. Maintain timely, complete, and compliant documentation of all patient interactions, care coordination activities, lab orders, charges, and communications within the EHR.
  13. Coordinate patient documentation needs, including requesting and organizing medical records in compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
  14. Promote effective communication across care teams, ensuring awareness of care plans, follow-up needs, and changes in clinical status.

  25. Perform other duties as assigned, which may include additional responsibilities that are essential to the operation of the department or company. Education

Experience

  2. Preferred:

    2. Prior involvement in quality improvement initiatives, population health programs, or patient navigation

The Praxis family approach is dynamically different from other healthcare companies in Oregon. The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Manager, Finance - Operations to join our team!

The Manager, Finance - Operations leads the day-to-day operations of an assigned finance unit and is accountable for execution of financial processes and team performance. The role directs planning, reporting, and control activities and coordinates cross-functional efforts to support accurate, timely financial operations and compliance.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Manage day-to-day operations of assigned Finance unit and supervise staff responsible for financial processes.
  • Lead execution of financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and reporting activities.
  • Oversee preparation and review of financial statements.
  • Monitor financial performance and identify risks, variances, and areas requiring corrective action compared to budgets and forecasts.
  • Manage performance, development, and accountability of assigned team members.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Associate's degree in a Business field and three (3) years of experience in Accounting, Finance, and/or developing and preparing financial reports; OR
  • Bachelor's degree in a Business field and one (1) year of experience in Accounting, Finance, and/or developing and preparing financial reports; OR
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within North Carolina.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • Experience with claims payments and/or purchasing
  • Experience with D365 Financial System and/or Conduent Meditract system
  • Supervision of two (2) or more employees

Deadline for Application:Thursday, October 15, 2026 @ 11:59PM

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior CSV/ CSA Specialist

Department: Information Technology

Location: Remote, East Coast Preferred

Hours Per Week: 40

Schedule: Days, Monday – Friday

SUMMARY

The Lead CSV/CSA Specialist serves as the primary validation lead for complex GxP computerized system projects, overseeing validation planning, execution, documentation, and lifecycle activities. The role partners closely with IT and Quality Assurance, mentors junior team members, and ensures systems comply with internal procedures and regulatory expectations. The position translates CSV/CSA governance requirements into practical, risk-based, and inspection-ready project execution.

RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Validation Leadership and Oversight: Lead validation and assurance planning for assigned new systems, upgrades, integrations, infrastructure changes, software changes, configuration changes, and system retirements, Serve as lead validator or CSV/CSA project lead throughout the system lifecycle and coordinate validation activities across project teams, IT system owners, Quality Assurance, vendors, and business stakeholders, Apply risk-based validation and CSA principles to determine appropriate deliverables, testing rigor, supplier reliance, evidence expectations, and approval strategy. 
  • CSV/CSA Deliverables and Review: Author, review, approve, or oversee validation lifecycle deliverables, including system risk assessments, validation plans or assurance plans, URS, functional/configuration/design specifications, test protocols, traceability matrices, validation summary reports, periodic reviews, and change impact assessments, Ensure documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, reviewable, properly approved, and inspection-ready. Oversee defect management, issue resolution, testing evidence compilation, and validation summary documentation. 
  • Regulatory, Quality, and Audit Support: Ensure assigned systems and changes meet applicable GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, data integrity, electronic records/electronic signatures, internal procedure, and quality expectations, Support internal audits, client audits, supplier audits, regulatory inspections, audit responses, deviations, CAPAs, and remediation plans related to validated computerized systems, Provide SME-level guidance to project teams and stakeholders on validation documentation, evidence expectations, and inspection-readiness practices. 
  • Lifecycle Management and Change Support: Ensure validated systems remain in a state of control through change impact assessments, regression testing, periodic reviews, access/security reviews, backup/restore reviews, data integrity reviews, and lifecycle documentation maintenance, Support proper integration of validation, change control, release readiness, configuration management, supplier management, and SDLC quality expectations, Lead validation impact assessment and test strategy decisions for assigned GxP IT changes.
  • Mentoring and Continuous Improvement: Mentor CSV/CSA Specialists and other project contributors on validation principles, documentation quality, evidence expectations, and risk-based decision-making, Support improvement of SOPs, forms, templates, guidance, training materials, metrics, operating rhythms, and portfolio practices, Facilitate cross-functional meetings and communication related to validation strategy, compliance expectations, lifecycle responsibilities, and audit readiness.

This job description is not intended to be exhaustive. The employee may be required to undertake any other duties that are reasonably required and are commensurate with the skills, experience and level of responsibility of the role.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, or related field
  • OR Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
  • 7+ years experience in , CSV/CSA, GxP IT quality, validation, quality systems, software assurance, or regulated system lifecycle experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong knowledge of CSV, CSA, GAMP 5, SDLC, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, data integrity, e-records/e-signatures, validation lifecycle deliverables, and risk-based validation practices. 
  • Experience leading validation strategy and deliverable execution for complex laboratory, quality, clinical, enterprise, infrastructure, integration, cloud/SaaS, or data systems.
  • Experience supporting audits, inspections, deviations, CAPAs, remediation activities, supplier assessments, and change control processes. 
  • Ability to lead complex validation work across multiple stakeholders and coordinate review, approval, testing, evidence, and delivery activities. 
  • Strong technical writing, documentation review, facilitation, mentoring, stakeholder engagement, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing assignments, and escalate risks, blockers, resource constraints, or unclear ownership.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Sedentary - Sedentary roles are primarily office-based and require prolonged sitting (67–100% of the workday) with minimal physical effort and lifting limited to under 10 lbs. Fine motor skills are necessary for computer work, writing, and telephone use, supported by clear visual and auditory ability. Cognitive and emotional demands are high due to extended concentration, frequent interruptions, independent decision-making, and information processing. Although physical exposure is low, administrative areas within healthcare environments may occasionally involve contact with infectious agents. This individual will conduct patient outreaches per existing protocols and assist patients with navigating the medication use aspects, including reviewing components of their plan benefits.   • Collaborate with other pharmacy staff, providers, and their care teams as needed to resolve any issues or discrepancies related to medication use
  • Ensure that all tasks are completed timely, documented accurately, and in accordance with regulations (including HIPAA) and organizational standards

  • Excellent customer service, including telephone etiquette skills, active listening skills, and the ability to follow-through with patients or staff members
  • Ability to work effectively and respectfully with various seniorities and diverse populations including members, staff, providers, and family members
  • High degree of emotional intelligence and integrity, resilient and focused work ethic, with adaptability to handle frequent changes with a positive attitude
  • Self-starter with the ability to think creatively and work effectively
  • Strong attention to detail and possessing good alpha/numeric data entry skills with minimal errors
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite products including Word, Outlook and Excel plus a variety of other word-processing, spreadsheet, database, e-mail and presentation software

Education and Experience:

  • Experience working with geriatric patients or a medication adherence program is a plus
  • Bilingual in English/Spanish highly desired

• Job Type: Full-time, long-term contractor
  • Workplace: Remote
  • Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday - CT hours aligned
  • Compensation: $1,300 - $1,400 (Negotiable)
  • Location: Mexico Only

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies, helping businesses build high-performing remote teams without limiting talent by geography. We value ownership, clear communication, and people who care about getting the details right, while providing structured onboarding and support for professionals working remotely.

About the Role

As a Customer Operations Coordinator, you’ll support the day-to-day operations of a New York-based business, making sure sales orders, pricing, costs, and customer information are processed accurately and efficiently. You’ll start with a strong focus on back-end operational work, then take on more direct customer communication as you learn the business and demonstrate proficiency.

This is a role for someone who thinks rather than simply processes. When a number, price, margin, or order does not make sense, you’ll be expected to investigate it, double-check the information, and confidently raise questions before moving forward.

Responsibilities

  • Enter and review sales orders accurately, ensuring customer, product, pricing, and order information is complete before processing.
  • Validate customer pricing against price sheets, product costs, freight charges, warehouse costs, and other relevant information.
  • Identify pricing, cost, margin, and order discrepancies before they create downstream operational or customer issues.
  • Perform basic business calculations involving percentages, costs, margins, multiplication, and division to verify order accuracy.
  • Investigate information that appears incorrect or inconsistent rather than processing it without question.
  • Escalate discrepancies and proactively communicate with the appropriate team members to reach a resolution.
  • Maintain a high level of accuracy while efficiently handling significant volumes of order and operational data.
  • Support customer inquiries professionally through email as your knowledge of the business grows.
  • Gradually handle occasional inbound and outbound customer calls once you are comfortable with the company’s products and processes.
  • Learn the company’s logistics, order management, pricing, and operational workflows well enough to recognize when something does not look right.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • Previous customer service, customer-facing, or operational support experience.
  • Advanced English proficiency across speaking, writing, and reading.
  • Strong numerical skills and confidence working with percentages, costs, margins, multiplication, division, and basic business calculations.
  • Excellent accuracy and attention to detail when comparing orders, prices, costs, spreadsheets, and other business data.
  • Ability to recognize unusual or incorrect figures and investigate them before proceeding.
  • Professional written communication skills and confidence asking questions or raising concerns when information is unclear.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in accounting, banking, finance, order processing, or another numbers- and data-intensive environment.
  • Experience entering or reviewing high volumes of sales orders or transactional information.
  • Previous exposure to logistics, warehousing, freight, or supply chain operations.
  • Experience working with spreadsheets, order management platforms, ERP systems, or similar business software.
  • Previous experience communicating with U.S.-based customers or teams.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President of Engineering
jobs.excerpt: At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold.
jobs.description:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Vice President of Engineering to lead Koalafi’s entire engineering organization, including our Consumer and Merchant Experience, Core Engineering, and Application Experience groups, as well as our Data & AI Platform and Architecture functions.

Reporting to the Chief Product and Technology Officer, you will partner closely with the CPTO and Head of Product to set engineering direction, translate company priorities into execution, and build an organization that delivers meaningful business results. Your scope spans the platforms, applications, services, and data infrastructure that power our customer experiences, merchant relationships, and internal operations.

This is a company leadership role, not solely an engineering leadership role. You will help shape business decisions, influence across functions, and bring a clear perspective on how technology can support growth, improve efficiency, and strengthen the customer experience. You must be equally credible in a technical discussion with engineers and a strategic discussion with the executive team or the board—and move comfortably between those two modes.

We’re also looking for an active AI practitioner who will help evolve how Koalafi works. You should be building and experimenting with AI tools yourself, with a thoughtful perspective on how to apply them across engineering and the broader business. The goal is not simply to increase adoption of tools or token usage, but to drive real, measurable business outcomes by embracing a willingness to fundamentally change how the business operates. You will lead this transformation through practical application, sound judgment, and measurable results.

What You’ll Do

Set engineering direction and own execution

Partner with the CPTO, Head of Product, and cross-functional leaders to translate company objectives into a clear engineering strategy, investment priorities, and execution plans. Ensure teams understand the outcomes they are accountable for, make realistic commitments, and surface risks and tradeoffs early. Own the engineering response when delivery is at risk, aligning leaders on corrective action and following through.

Lead as a business executive

Build strong partnerships across Product, Risk, Operations, Finance, Sales, and other functions. Contribute to company decisions beyond engineering, connecting technical choices to growth, customer experience, operating efficiency, and risk. Communicate complex topics clearly and bring well-vetted recommendations – not simply issues or requests – to executive discussions.

Apply technical depth with sound leadership judgment

Earn the team’s trust through technical expertise, thoughtful questions, and the ability to engage deeply in consequential architectural and engineering decisions. Recognize when an initiative, technical risk, or team challenge needs your direct involvement, and engage early enough to make a difference. Balance that involvement with clear delegation, strengthening your leaders’ ownership rather than becoming a bottleneck or doing their jobs for them.

Build and develop a strong leadership team

Lead, coach, and hold accountable engineering leaders and managers across the organization. Set clear expectations for their technical judgment, business understanding, people leadership, and execution. Invest in succession planning, leadership development, and hiring, while addressing performance gaps directly. Continually evaluate team structure, responsibilities, and leadership capacity so the organization can operate effectively as priorities evolve.

Own architecture, data foundations, and pragmatic modernization

Guide the evolution of our applications, core services, and data platforms, balancing near-term delivery with long-term maintainability, reliability, and scale. Modernize the tech stack where it creates clear business value and be able to defend the ROI. Partner with Risk, Analytics, and Data Science to ensure our data engineering and AI foundations support reliable access, clear ownership, and effective use of data across the company.

Drive engineering excellence and responsible investment

Strengthen quality, test automation, delivery practices, observability, and operational readiness. Establish useful measures of delivery effectiveness, reliability, cost, and business impact, and use them to guide improvement. Own engineering budget and capacity planning in partnership with the CPTO and Finance, challenging staffing and technology proposals against business needs and credible alternatives. Partner closely with IT and Information Security to build and operate secure, resilient systems.

Lead AI adoption through hands-on practice

Maintain an active practice of building, prototyping, and experimenting with AI tools yourself. Use that experience to help teams improve how they design, build, test, deploy, and operate software—not just how they write code. Stay current with emerging capabilities, distinguish useful advances from hype, and turn promising experiments into repeatable practices with measurable improvements in speed, quality, or capacity, with the ultimate goal being to drive better business outcomes for the company.

Help the broader company work more effectively through AI

Partner with business leaders to identify where generative AI, automation, and better internal tools can improve workflows and outcomes. Help teams move from ideas and pilots to solutions people actually use. Ensure adoption is supported by appropriate data access, technical foundations, training, and safeguards, in partnership with Information Security, Risk, and Legal and Compliance.

About You

  • An experienced engineering executive. You bring 15+ years of progressive engineering experience, including substantial experience leading managers and senior engineering leaders across multiple teams. You have owned organization-wide strategy, delivery, talent, and investment decisions, not just an individual product or technical function.

  • Technically credible and comfortable going deep. You have strong architectural judgment across complex applications, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and data platforms. You can challenge assumptions, assess tradeoffs, and help teams work through difficult technical decisions without needing to be the expert in every technology.

  • Business-minded and influential across functions. You understand how engineering decisions affect revenue, cost, customer experience, and risk. You can earn the confidence of executive peers, navigate competing priorities, and build alignment without relying on reporting lines or authority.

  • A leader with strong situational judgment. You know when to delegate, when to coach, when to challenge, and when to get directly involved. You maintain enough visibility to recognize emerging problems and take ownership before they become escalations, without micromanaging your team.

  • A committed developer of leaders. You have a track record of building inclusive, high-performing organizations and helping managers become stronger leaders. You set a high bar, provide candid feedback, address difficult people decisions, and create clear accountability.

  • An active AI practitioner. You can point to things you have personally built, workflows you have redesigned, or experiments you have run using AI tools. You have informed views on their capabilities and limitations, and experience helping others apply them effectively. Your interest extends beyond coding productivity to how AI can improve the way an entire company operates.

  • Pragmatic and accountable for outcomes. You can balance modernization with delivery, speed with reliability, and ambition with available capacity. You communicate clearly, make decisions with imperfect information, and follow through on commitments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or other regulated, transaction-intensive environments is a plus, as is experience with customer- and merchant-facing products, servicing platforms, and internal business systems such as Salesforce.

  • Familiarity with technologies in our environment—including Go, Node.js, React, AWS, Kubernetes, and native iOS and Android development—is helpful. We value strong engineering fundamentals and architectural judgment over expertise in any single stack.

  • Fluency in the modern AI stack and in how it is changing the way software is built. That includes frontier models, coding agents, and the harnesses, evaluations, and guardrails that make them reliable in production. You should understand how the developer workflow is shifting from writing code to designing and supervising agentic loops, where agents plan, build, test, and verify work against clear specifications. We standardize on Claude, but regularly evaluate new frontier models and tools, and knowing which advances actually matter, is a core part of the job.

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Location: Richmond, VA; Arlington, VA; or Remote (U.S.). Associates near one of our office locations may work in-office, hybrid, or remotely. Remote opportunities are available to candidates throughout the United States.

Salary Range: $275,000-$325,000 per year (depending on experience and location)

Additional Compensation: This position will be eligible to participate in company bonus plan.

The final salary offer will depend on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and geographic location. The actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

Applications will be accepted until position is filled.

Why choose Koalafi: A career at Koalafi means opportunities to tackle exciting challenges every single day. We take pride in a culture of innovation, trust, and ownership. You'll get outside your comfort zone, build meaningful relationships, and most of all, take charge of projects that ultimately help people get the things they need most.

Benefits:

At Koalafi, you will have a direct impact on our products and help shape the company’s success. We offer competitive compensation & benefits packages to keep you at your best:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 20 PTO days + 11 paid holidays
  • 401(k) retirement with company matching

Who we are & what we value:

  • We focus on what’s most important
  • We set clear expectations and deliver
  • We embrace challenges to reach our full potential
  • We ask, “How can this be better?”
  • We move fast together
