These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

Position Title:

This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations. The Specialist will ensure adherence to company policy and procedures and will assist in maintaining quality control processes. This position will help the organization maximize the number of patients served while maintaining a high level of quality and safety through the support of the business functions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides regulatory support to product development and business teams including preparation of regulatory opinion documents, coordination of labeling activities, and review/approval of design control documentation, risk management reports, technical protocols/reports, clinical documentation and other outputs of product development.
  • Prepares/writes, submits, and manages global regulatory applications (including MDSAP markets, EU, and UK) as well as internal regulatory file documentation. Supports distributors and business partners in securing and maintaining regulatory clearances.
  • Maintains systems for tracking current projects and for projection of future activity loads.
  • Acts as company representative, developing and maintaining positive relationships with global regulatory agencies and business partners through oral and written communications.
  • Works professionally and cooperatively with cross-functional teams such as research and development, operations, quality, microbiology, packaging, medical affairs, and clinical affairs to ensure project success.
  • Assesses product design, labeling, quality system, manufacturing, and material changes for regulatory impact. Communicates changes effectively throughout the organization. Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.
  • Develops, processes, and maintains assigned departmental procedures, work instructions, and forms, and facilities training. Reviews and supports creation/updates of labeling procedures.
  • Supports the design, development, review, and approval of product labels, label items, advertising/promotional materials and product claims to assure accuracy, consistency and compliance to global regulatory requirements, as well as company and customer requirements. This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.
  • Monitors and assesses changes to global regulatory regulations, directives, standards and guidance requirements (regulatory intelligence assessment). Manage project teams for completion of required activities to ensure compliance.
  • Supports regulatory aspects of the quality system and product non-conformities and leads assigned corrective and preventive action activities.

jobs.description:
Senior Key Account Manager

Department:

Commercial Operations & Global Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning

Reports To:

Director, Commercial Operations & Global Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning

Location:

Remote option or onsite in either Marquette, MI or Bethlehem, PA (travel to sites and customers quarterly, approx. 20%)

FLSA Status:

Exempt

MAIN FUNCTION

The Senior Key Account Manager holds primary ownership of Exalta's most strategically significant original equipment manufacturer (OEM) accounts, serving as the senior customer-facing leader within the Commercial Operations team. This role requires substantial prior customer-facing experience within the OEM industry — medical device OEM experience strongly preferred — combined with demonstrated judgment managing complex, multi-site customer relationships at the executive level. The Senior Key Account Manager owns the customer Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) cadence for assigned strategic accounts, serves as the senior escalation point for customer-impacting issues, and partners directly with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP to translate customer demand into the SIOP process. The role also carries responsibility for mentoring and developing Key Account Managers, strengthening the team's account strategy and execution. This position is designed to build the next generation of commercial leadership within a vertically integrated medical device manufacturing environment.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Account Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end commercial relationship for Exalta's most strategically significant OEM accounts, serving as the senior point of contact across multiple product lines, programs, and sites.
  • Lead the customer S&OP cadence for assigned strategic accounts, driving rollout, phased maturity, and ongoing governance in partnership with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP.
  • Develop account-level strategic plans that align customer growth expectations with Exalta's capacity and operational constraints.
  • Represent Commercial Operations in executive-level customer business reviews, contract discussions, and new program launch conversations.

SIOP Integration & Demand Ownership

  • Serve as the senior demand data owner for assigned strategic accounts within the SIOP process; validate and reconcile the highest-exposure forecast inputs ahead of the monthly demand review gate.
  • Own forecast accuracy performance for the largest accounts in the portfolio, identify variance drivers, and present trends into the SIOP executive alignment as needed.
  • Partner with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP to ensure customer demand inputs are reflected accurately in the SIOP demand plan, surfacing capacity risk early.
  • Support new product introduction onboarding for strategic account programs, coordinating across quality, planning, and operations at the program level.

Escalation & Customer Experience Ownership

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for customer-impacting issues across assigned strategic accounts, providing strategic direction rather than case-level handling.
  • Own root-cause resolution for significant service disruptions, partnering with planning, supply chain, and quality to protect delivery commitments.
  • Drive proactive, executive-level communication with customers on constraint impacts, delays, or substitutions.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Mentor and coach Key Account Managers on account strategy, escalation handling, and demand data ownership.
  • Provide the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP with structured input on Key Account Manager performance, account coverage, and development needs.
  • Support onboarding and knowledge transfer for new Key Account Management team members.

Analytics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Own KPI reporting for the Key Account Management team, consolidating on-time delivery, backorder, and fill rate performance across the portfolio.
  • Identify systemic trends across accounts and lead continuous improvement initiatives in customer operations, demand management, and order fulfillment workflows.
  • Contribute to ERP (Epicor) and Power BI reporting enhancements supporting Commercial Operations and SIOP objectives.
  • Ensure all customer-facing operations comply with FDA, ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and company quality standards.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Customer Focus — advanced ability to build and sustain executive-level relationships with OEM customers.
  • Leadership and Mentorship — proven ability to guide and develop Key Account Managers.
  • Business Acumen — strong understanding of OEM contract manufacturing economics, capacity constraints, and account profitability drivers.
  • Conflict Resolution and Negotiation — expertise managing complex, high-stakes customer issues to resolution.
  • Analytical and Critical Thinking — ability to translate order, forecast, and fulfillment data into account strategy.
  • Communication — executive-level written and verbal communication skills, able to represent Exalta credibly with customer Director- and Vice President-level stakeholders.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of large, complex OEM accounts simultaneously, balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day delivery commitments.
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent Exalta professionally in high-visibility customer settings.
  • Advanced analytical ability to translate order, forecast, and fulfillment data into account-level strategy and risk mitigation.
  • Proven skill mentoring and developing less experienced team members.
  • Collaborative working style with a demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional follow-through at senior levels.
  • Deep familiarity with demand planning, Sales and Operations Planning processes, and customer order management.
  • Proficiency in enterprise resource planning systems (Epicor preferred), Microsoft Excel (advanced), and Power BI or equivalent reporting tools.

REQUIRED / PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field required; Master's degree a plus.
  • Minimum of five years of direct, customer-facing experience within the OEM industry required; medical device OEM or contract manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or supporting a formal Sales and Operations Planning or Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning cadence with strategic accounts.
  • Prior experience mentoring, coaching, or informally leading account management team members preferred.
  • Experience navigating FDA-regulated or ISO 13485 quality environments strongly preferred.
  • Epicor enterprise resource planning experience preferred; exposure to order management or demand planning modules is an advantage.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This position operates in a professional office environment with periodic interaction with manufacturing and warehouse functions. Travel to customer sites and offices may be required (approximately 20%, generally on a quarterly cadence). Must be able to maintain composure and professionalism in high-visibility, executive-level customer escalation scenarios.

jobs.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Job Description Summary

Are you a critical thinker who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to hear from you!

Our Excess & Surplus/Specialty (E&S/S) lines allow us to provide insurance that other carriers may not offer. It’s a fast-paced environment in a collaborative, team-oriented culture, working in an always-changing, growing industry.

As an Underwriting Consultant in Brokerage Casualty you will underwrite individual risks for acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions, by developing, analyzing and evaluating information and exposures on risks of an increasing complex technical nature with a high level of authority for the Primary Casualty line of business. In addition, you achieve production and loss ratio goals with assigned brokers and program managers by reviewing and analyzing claims, loss history and taking appropriate action on accounts. Broker assignments are the most complex in terms of coverage and broker relationships. You’ll need to exercise a high level of authority and judgment with minimal direction. Determining appropriate reinsurance placement, if any, on individual accounts is important in this role. We’ll count on you to foster positive business relationships with co-workers, brokers, and reinsurers. You’ll also be responsible for research, development and presentation of new classes of business including market viability forms development, manuals, available reinsurance and will assist the manager with department strategies, employee coaching and development, and mentoring underwriters at all levels. You’ll have authority to approve referrals that exceed the authority of lower level underwriters as well.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Researches and develops new classes of business as directed. Researches market trends and competition. Assesses market viability, creates forms & endorsements, and develops rates with actuarial support. On large, complex accounts, partners with Actuarial team to develop rates/pricing, Finance team to review potential insureds profitability profile and claims team to review SIR viability and potential frequency and severity of losses.

  • Reviews individual risks with assigned brokers and either declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. The underwriter analyzes, with the highest level of technical expertise and accuracy, exposures to loss, develops an adequate premium charge for the exposure, determines endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract, including developing manuscript wording appropriate to the risk. Within department guidelines places reinsurance, if any, for the account.

  • Achieves team/individual production and loss ratio goals with assigned brokers through sound broker management and marketing. Works with the most complex issues concerning coverage, terms and conditions, etc. brokers. The underwriter continually analyzes premium and loss results of assigned brokers; by state, major classes of business, etc. Continually assesses quality of broker submissions and makes corrective action recommendations.

  • Oversees or handles policy maintenance items and other mid-term requests. Reviews endorsement requests and authorizes necessary changes to the policy. Reviews Loss Control reports and recommendations and partners with the broker to ensure loss control compliance. Follows up on outstanding information as required. Reviews claim activity and takes appropriate action.

  • Fosters positive business relationships with brokers, through frequent contact. Develops and maintains good rapport and resolves broker conflicts. Travels to broker offices as required for training or marketing visits. Entertains brokers visiting the Company as required. Assists with development of marketing ideas and strategies for Underwriting events and other marketing campaigns.

  • Demonstrates a thorough understanding of facultative reinsurance and places reinsurance per department guidelines based upon the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty, semiautomatic and facultative reinsurance. Maintains good working relationship with reinsurers.

  • Resolves technical questions of the greatest complexity.

  • Proactively develops technical and business knowledge through internal and external venues. Teaches classes to build technical underwriting knowledge to brokers, SSU students and other underwriters. Mentors new and existing underwriting talent.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned. ​

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Underwriting Manager. May have up to three direct reports. Indirect reports not typically assigned.

Education: Undergraduate degree preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

License/Certification/Designation: Completion of general insurance courses such as CPCU, CIC, AU, ARM, CPIW, CWIS, or ASLI is preferred.

Experience: Eight years CL underwriting experience handling large or complex accounts, excess & surplus lines experience preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Knowledge of complex CL underwriting policies, practices and procedures, insurance law and underwriting/marketing principles and techniques. Knowledge of Standard Bureau Rating plans and concepts such as catastrophe management. Knowledge of Alternative rating methods and plans and pricing theory. Knowledge of Treaty & Facultative reinsurance. Knowledge of regulatory issues, the wholesale broker system, market conditions and company operations.

Job Family

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for a Sr. Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AIDR Engineering Team. You will provide engineering support and solutions to a data science group focused on high-throughput, low-latency LLM inferencing. In conjunction with the other engineers and data scientists on the team, you will support LLM post-training, data engineering aligned to rigorous evaluations, and broadly supporting a mission that requires close engineering collaboration with applied data scientists. Substantively, the team has a big mission: allowing Enterprise users to interact safely and securely with AI applications. This is a front-seat role in designing for the AI age. CrowdStrike is a computer security company, but we do not require candidates for this role to have prior security industry experience. We will mentor and train in security topics as needed. We do expect a strong interest in CrowdStrike's mission and a willingness to engage with the needs of our product teams and customers.

What You'll Do:

  • Innovate with the state of the art machine learning technology to accelerate data science.

  • Focus on pragmatic support for fast-moving research and development teams.

  • Implement high-quality solutions in support of customer-facing applications at scale.

  • Providing in-depth analysis to identify potential vulnerabilities or gaps.

  • Construct and maintain data pipelines,and contribute to the training and implementation of custom models.

  • Collaborate across various teams to brainstorm, define, and devise solutions.

  • Commit to ongoing learning and self-improvement.

  • Constantly explore ways to refine product architecture, knowledge models, user experience, performance, and reliability.

  • Own your work with autonomy, end to end: develop, test, deploy and monitor your changes.

  • Thrive in an environment that highly values trust.

Tech Stack (not mandatory to know everything; a robust learning capacity is essential):

  • Docker

  • Kubernetes

  • AWS, GCP, or MaaS

  • Kafka, Cassandra, and Spark

  • ElasticSearch

  • Terraform, Chef, or Ansible

  • Experience with scaling inference across GPUs or GPU-clusters

What You'll Need:

  • Prior work experience doing data engineering and architecture in support of advanced data science use cases.

  • A deep understanding of LLM post-training methods and computational architectures.

  • Understanding scalability and distributed systems e.g. sharding, partitioning, and concurrency.

  • Be a team player.

  • A thorough understanding of engineering best practices from appropriate testing paradigms to effective peer code reviews and resilient architecture.

  • The ability to thrive in a test-driven, collaborative, and iterative programming environment.

  • The skills to meet your commitments on time and produce high-quality software that is unit tested, code reviewed, and checked in regularly for continuous integration.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Existing, demonstrable applied work in scalable architectures for LLM post-training or fine-tuning.

  • Prior experience in the cybersecurity or intelligence fields.

The Compliance and Governance Manager role is a key component of the Harris UK Compliance function, providing governance, compliance, assurance, and regulatory support across Harris UK Business Units.

  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and risk awareness.

  • Provide expert guidance on governance, privacy, information security, AI governance, quality management, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Governance and Compliance

  • Develop, implement, and maintain governance frameworks, policies, standards, and procedures across Harris UK Business Units.

  • Monitor compliance with applicable legislation, regulations, contractual commitments, and internal policies.

  • Provide guidance and support on compliance-related matters to Business Unit leadership teams.

  • Identify compliance risks and support the development of mitigation actions and improvement plans.

  • Ensure governance processes remain effective, proportionate, and aligned with corporate objectives.

Information Security, Privacy and Risk Management

  • Support compliance with UK GDPR and wider privacy obligations.

  • Assist Business Units in implementing and maintaining appropriate information security controls.

  • Facilitate risk assessments and support ongoing risk management activities.

  • NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSPT)

  • Risk Management and Enterprise Risk Frameworks

  • Supplier Assurance and Third-Party Risk Management

  • Health, Safety and Environmental Compliance

  • Export Controls, ITAR and EAR requirements

  • Physical and Personnel Security

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Proven experience in a compliance, governance, risk, information security, privacy, quality, or regulatory role.

  • Strong understanding of governance frameworks and management systems.

  • Experience conducting internal audits and managing compliance programmes.

  • Knowledge of UK GDPR and broader regulatory compliance obligations.

  • Experience supporting ISO management systems, particularly ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001.

  • Experience supporting ISO/IEC 42001, NHS DSPT, DCB0129, DCB0160, UKCA, or MHRA compliance.

  • Experience within SaaS, software, healthcare technology, or regulated technology environments.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Experience developing and maintaining policies, procedures, and governance documentation.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver outcomes independently.

Desirable

  • Knowledge of AI governance and emerging regulatory frameworks.

  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, or multi-business group environments.

  • Professional certifications in compliance, governance, auditing, information security, privacy, risk management, or quality management.

Success Measures

  • Maintain and improve compliance maturity across Harris UK Business Units.

  • Deliver a risk-based internal audit programme and assurance framework.

  • Support successful certification and regulatory outcomes.

  • Drive standardisation and best practice across the UK portfolio.

  • Enhance stakeholder confidence through effective governance, reporting, and compliance oversight.

  • Contribute to the continual improvement of compliance, governance, security, quality, and risk management practices across Harris UK.

Benefits

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

Agiloft is building its Product GTM team and needs a dedicated owner to close the gap between the teams that build our product and the teams that bring it to market. The Product Launch and Enablement Manager will be the connective tissue between Product and every GTM-facing function — Sales, Product Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success — ensuring that new capabilities, releases, and roadmap developments don’t just ship, but land with full organizational readiness.

This role is equal parts program operator and internal translator. You will build and run the systems that keep GTM teams informed, trained, and equipped to speak confidently about what Agiloft does and where it’s going. The broad mission is ensuring nothing leaves the product org without a clear path to understanding and adoption inside the commercial organization.

Job Responsibilities

    Product-to-GTM Communication & Internal Readiness

  • Serve as the primary owner of internal product communication to GTM teams — ensuring that release notes, capability updates, and roadmap developments are delivered as clear, actionable content that Sales teams, Product Marketing, CS, and Account Management, can use
  • Define and operate a release communication cadence so that no new feature, capability, or product change reaches a customer-facing team without prior structured awareness
  • Maintain a central internal knowledge hub — positioning summaries, product FAQs, feature overviews, demo guidance — and keep it current across every product release in partnership with the relevant subject matter experts
  • Partner with Product Operations to develop roadmap communication frameworks that give GTM teams appropriate visibility into what is coming, when, and why

    • Launch Program Management

  • Own the product-side (internal) launch readiness program across all product releases, tiering launches by scope and assigning the corresponding level of cross-functional preparation required
  • Define and track the bill of materials needed for launch, including feature scope, use case guidance, documentation, demo readiness, and inputs for internal enablement. Hold cross-functional owners accountable to timelines.
  • Lead product readiness reviews to identify gaps, dependencies, and decisions before release. Share launch timing and product updates with Product Marketing and other GTM partners so they can plan their activities.
  • Lead post-launch retrospectives to capture what worked, what didn’t, and what should be incorporated into the next launch cycle

    • Sales & Field Enablement

  • Work in tandem with the GTM Enablement and Product Marketing teams to ensure Sales orgs are trained and demo-ready for every meaningful product release — including talk tracks, objection handling, competitive positioning, and feature walk-throughs
  • Run regular product update sessions (live or async) so the field is never behind on what Agiloft has shipped or is shipping soon
  • Track field readiness and confidence as a measurable output — survey the team, close knowledge gaps, and report on readiness ahead of launch dates

    • Use Case Program

  • Partner with Product Operations to help build and operate the program that creates standards for how use cases are developed by product managers and delivered alongside product launches
  • Ensure use cases are coherent, GTM-ready, and accessible across Sales teams, Marketing, and CS as functional tools, not just internal documentation
  • Partner with Product Operations on the technical infrastructure required to support use case creation, storage, and distribution
  • Establish a feedback loop so field input on use case quality and coverage is systematically captured and routed back to the product team

    • Cross-Functional Alignment & Roadmap Governance

  • Run a regular Product-GTM sync cadence — bringing Product, Product Marketing, Sales leadership, and CS together around launch calendars, roadmap updates, and in-flight priorities
  • Maintain a shared GTM launch calendar visible to all stakeholders, with status, ownership, and readiness signals for every active initiative
  • Act as the escalation point when GTM teams lack the product knowledge or materials they need to execute — diagnosing the gap and driving resolution
  • Prepare executive-level readouts on launch health, field readiness, and program performance for senior leadership

    • Strategic Reference Customer Program Management

  • Assist with the design and lead the operation of a product-focused engagement program that accelerates product discovery and customer value delivery for product growth initiatives by creating customer specific engagements for a limited cohort of strategic reference customers
  • Build the feedback infrastructure that captures what reference customers are validating, questioning, and rejecting, and routes those signals back to Product and GTM in a structured, actionable form
  • Work with product managers to identify product growth targets that align with reference customers needs and develop projects that align customer roadmaps to deliver accelerated learning for product development and value focused outcomes for customer
  • Partner with professional services, customer success, account management, and product managers to identify and resource customer value projects and define clear success criteria for each engagement
  • Document and distribute outcomes to relevant internal stakeholders, including validated use cases, customer proof points, and lessons learned, as usable GTM assets
  • Other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in program management, product marketing, sales enablement, or a GTM operations role within B2B SaaS or enterprise software
  • Demonstrated experience owning launch programs or GTM readiness initiatives
  • Strong understanding of how Sales teams, Marketing, Account Management, Professional Services, and Customer Success consume and act on product information
  • Exceptional written communication skills; able to take complex product concepts and write crisp, usable content for a non-technical commercial audience
  • Proven ability to build and maintain repeatable programs, processes, and content systems across a fast-moving product release cycle
  • Comfortable influencing without authority across multiple senior stakeholders simultaneously
  • Highly organized with strong project management instincts

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background working with or alongside a technical product team — able to read a release brief and translate it into commercial language quickly

M-Files is redefining how work gets done. Our context-first document management system offers purpose-built business use cases—spanning universal and industry-specific workflows—to enable secure collaboration, automate processes, and ensure governance.

Unlike traditional systems, M-Files organizes content around the context of your business, connecting documents to related people, projects, and transactions. With our unique metadata-driven architecture, organizations can model content in line with their business processes, unify information across silos, and apply AI at scale. The result is greater productivity, reduced risk, and smarter, faster decisions for over 6,000 customers in 100+ countries.

At M-Files, our Guiding Principles unite us across diverse cultures and personalities:

  1. Make It Happen – We set bold goals, take ownership, learn from mistakes, and relentlessly pursue results.
  2. Help Others – We lead with kindness, assume good intentions, hold one another accountable, and celebrate wins together.
  3. Love Customers – We put customers and partners at the heart of everything, delivering value with respect, fairness, and speed.

To learn more about us we encourage you to visit .
Learn more about what earned us the Great Place to Work

About M-Files Advisory Services

M-Files Advisory Services is a newly established practice within M-Files' Global Services organization, built to help customers move beyond deployment and get measurable business value from the M-Files platform. The practice is launching with three foundational offerings: Health Check, AI Readiness, and Organizational Change Management and the portfolio is expected to expand quickly as the practice matures, including into higher-end advisory and management-consulting-style engagements. This is a founding hire: you'll deliver from day one and help shape how the practice is run at scale as it grows.

Role Summary

The OCM Consultant delivers M-Files Advisory Services' longest and most structured engagement — a multi-week, certified change management program that drives adoption as M-Files expands across departments. It's one of the practice's three founding service lines, and building credibility with customers, and internally, is a central part of standing it up. This is a founding hire for the practice. As a founding hire, you'll deliver the service from day one, help build the delivery methodology and collateral behind it from the ground up, and grow with the role as the Advisory portfolio expands into new and higher-end offerings.


What You'll Do

Delivery

  • Design and lead a structured, multi-phase change management program for customers implementing and/or expanding M-Files across departments — from initial discovery through reinforcement and coaching after go-live. The service will be delivered for both new logos and existing customers.
  • Establish and run a recurring governance cadence with the customer to track change readiness, adoption signals, resistance, and dependencies throughout the engagement.
  • Apply the practice's own persona-based adoption framework to plan differentiated engagement for different stakeholder populations, rather than a single uniform approach.
  • Conduct a training needs analysis to define what each affected role needs to be able to do, and by when, for training that M-Files Professional Services designs and delivers. This role scopes training needs — it does not design or deliver training content.
  • Identify, build, and enable a customer-side change network to sustain adoption after the engagement ends.
  • Coach the customer's executive sponsor and key designees to reinforce the change and address resistance as it surfaces.
  • Establish an adoption baseline at the start of the engagement and track progress against it through close-out.
  • Read a room of mixed adoption-readiness levels in real time and adjust facilitation approach accordingly.
  • Partner with account teams to align engagement scope and timing with the broader account plan.
  • Identify and escalate, to management and/or sales, additional service and subscription (platform expansion) opportunities surfaced during a customer engagement — this role sits closest to the affected user population and is well placed to spot them.

Practice Building

  • Build the delivery workbooks, templates, and project plans the practice needs — most don't exist yet, and this role will help create them from the ground up.
  • Take increasing ownership of the OCM enablement program — training curriculum and certification/readiness pathway guidance for future hires.
  • As the team scales, take on mentoring for incoming associates in your service area — informally at first, without requiring formal management authority.
  • Proactively identify friction in delivery process, tooling, or methodology, and drive it to resolution rather than working around it quietly.
  • Contribute to identifying and shaping new service offerings as the Advisory portfolio expands.

Requirements

  • 5–8 years of experience specifically in organizational change management, ideally within enterprise software adoption or digital transformation.
  • Formal change management certification required — Prosci, ACMP (CCMP), APMG International, Kotter, Lean Six Sigma, or a validated university certification or degree in a relevant discipline — completed, not in progress.
  • M-Files or comparable enterprise document/content management platform experience — required.
  • Strong business acumen, with demonstrated ability to identify and resolve business process and workflow impediments.
  • Comfortable and effective operating across all levels of a client organization, from end users to C-suite executives.
  • Skilled facilitator with experience designing and delivering change communication and coaching programs.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with experience producing executive-ready plans and reports.
  • Comfortable working within AI-assisted delivery workflows.
  • Comfortable building delivery collateral — workbooks, templates, scoring tools, and project plans — from a blank page, not just executing against an existing playbook. Much of what this role will use day-to-day doesn't exist yet.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Management consulting background — strategy, operations, or business transformation — even outside change management specifically.
  • Business process expertise: experience redesigning how an organization works, not only helping it adopt a new system.
  • Experience helping a customer apply a platform strategically to a business problem, rather than only supporting its adoption.

  • Prior experience building training or enablement materials, or certification/readiness pathways, for a team.

Overview

POSITION TITLE: Florida Gulf Coast Community Manager

REPORTS TO: Regional Director, ADL Florida

SUPERVISION EXERCISED: May take on future supervision responsibilities

LOCATION: Tampa Bay area

Grade/Class: Grade G, Exempt, PSA-Eligible

ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION:

ADL is the leading anti-hate organization in the world. Founded in 1913, its timeless mission is “to stop the defamation of the Jewish people and to secure justice and fair treatment to all.” Today, ADL continues to fight all forms of antisemitism and bias, using innovation and partnerships to drive impact. A global leader in combating antisemitism, countering extremism and battling bigotry wherever and whenever it happens, ADL works to protect democracy and ensure a just and inclusive society for all.

PRIMARY FUNCTION:

Serve as the Tampa Bay area’s on-the-ground in-community representative and primary point of contact with volunteers, law enforcement, government officials, religious and community leaders. Engage current supporters and cultivate new relationships to increase awareness of ADL’s work and identify programmatic and partnership/coalition-building opportunities. 

Responsibilities

Primary:

  • Serve as the spokesperson for ADL Florida during interactions with community partners and coalitions, with media, and promoting public awareness of ADL’s mission and work.
  • Build relationships with Jewish and non-Jewish community organizations to further establish ADL's voice in the region on antisemitism and combatting hate on all fronts.
  • Identify and promote programming opportunities and events to or in collaboration with current or prospective community-based partners.
  • Promote, facilitate, and execute nationwide ADL programs, events, and policies tailored to local community needs and issues, including facilitating workshops for law enforcement partners.
  • Ensure that reports of antisemitic incidents are received and addressed within the region with appropriate consultation with Division support and other appropriate subject matter experts at ADL.
  • Recruit, engage, and work with volunteer leadership. Identify community leaders for involvement and recruitment to ADL.
  • Participate in government affairs activities, maintaining regular contact with state, local and national officials. Advocate for ADL issues in state and local legislature.
  • Manage tailored community-focused communications, including an area specific newsletter and event and program marketing, to ADL supporters and stakeholders in the Tampa Bay area.
  • Manage the region’s leadership group in the area including its local ADL Advisory Council.
  • Track relevant issues and provide regular updates to regional (and divisional) staff. Identify opportunities for the region to strategically engage. 
  • Partner with regional development staff to grow the region’s fundraising base in the Tampa Bay area, including stewarding relationships with current supporters, identifying prospective donors, and developing opportunities to engage the community in meeting regional fundraising goals.

Secondary:

  • Support Region-wide efforts and collaborate with full regional team to achieve statewide goals.
  • Be a bridgebuilder between the Tampa Bay and Gulf Coast communities and other parts of the Region.

This job description provides a general overview of the role and its key responsibilities. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, and ADL reserves the right to assign additional tasks as needed.

Qualifications

Skills:

  • Strong verbal/written communication and presentation skills, including an ability to effectively communicate ADL’s mission, programs, and engagement opportunities with various stakeholders essential.
  • Highly organized and detail- and goal-oriented required.  
  • Problem-solving, thoughtful decision-making, and the ability to take initiative, be assertive and prioritize are needed for success. 
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of staff and work both independently and as part of a team. 
  • Comfort in working with colleagues remotely across the country is essential.  
  • Comfort with being the public face of ADL in the community, including engaging with diverse audiences.
  • Technical competence required. Working familiarity and comfort in database systems, reporting, and analysis essential.  

Attributes:

  • Committed to contributing to a culture where everyone thrives.
  • Collaborative team-player.
  • Creative and innovative; takes initiative.
  • Results-oriented – a problem solver (versus a problem identifier).
  • Excels in dynamic environments that require adaptability.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Energized by ADL’s mission and work.

Work Experience:

  • The ideal candidate has several years’ experience in community engagement and relationship cultivation and is able to demonstrate progressive increases in skill development, leadership, and responsibility in convening groups, setting goals, and keeping groups on task.
  • Previous work in a non-profit environment a plus. 
  • Knowledge of the Tampa Bay area, non-profit, faith-based, and/or corporate communities a plus.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree or equivalent work experience preferred.

Work Environment:

  • This role is remote (no specific in-office requirement), with an expectation to spend significant time in the community.
  • Some work outside business hours is expected.

Compensation:

  • This position has a salary range of $75,000 to $90,000. This salary range is reflective of a position based in Tampa Bay, Florida. Please note that actual salaries are commensurate with experience and reflect the budget for a given position, and since ADL has a location-based compensation structure, there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. For an overview of our total rewards package, please visit

jobs.description:
At PMAT, we work on mission critical systems that directly support the warfighter, designing, building, and securing modern digital capabilities across cloud, data, and software environments. Our teams tackle complex, real-world challenges where delivery matters more than theory, and innovation is driven by curiosity, collaboration, and purpose.

In this role, you’ll contribute to enterprise data, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and advanced technology capabilities, working alongside engineers and operators to deliver resilient, forward-leaning solutions in support of national defense.

About the role: PMAT is seeking a technically accomplished and commercially oriented Vice President of Technology AI and ML to lead the company’s enterprise-wide data, AI, and ML strategy. Reporting directly to the Chief Operations Officer (COO), the VP of Technology will serve as PMAT’s senior executive responsible for transforming data and AI capabilities into strategic business assets. You’ll establish scalable data and AI architectures, integrate AI/ML into PMAT’s products, platforms, and operations, and help translate emerging technologies into practical, mission-focused capabilities for Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), and other federal customers. Working across executive leadership, Growth, Engineering, Program Management, SBIR, and Advanced Technology, you’ll help identify new market opportunities, develop differentiated technical capabilities, transition innovations from research and prototyping into operational deployments, and connect technology investments to measurable business and mission outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute PMAT’s enterprise-wide data, AI, and ML strategy, including a long-term technology roadmap encompassing generative and agentic AI, predictive analytics, computer vision, natural language processing, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies. Advise the COO and executive leadership on technology trends, market opportunities, investment priorities, and the strategic implications of AI and data-driven capabilities.
  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and modular AI/ML architectures and establish technical standards for data ingestion and integration, model development, deployment, orchestration, monitoring, and lifecycle management. Direct solutions involving large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), autonomous and agentic systems, predictive analytics, advanced decision support, MLOps, LLMOps, and DataOps.
  • Guide development of cloud-native, hybrid-cloud, edge, disconnected, classified, and tactical AI architectures; evaluate and integrate commercial, open-source, and government-developed technologies; oversee prototyping and proof-of-concept development; and ensure architectural alignment across PMAT’s technology portfolio, including Overmatch and Tactical Edge Node capabilities.
  • Establish PMAT’s enterprise data strategy, including data architecture, governance, quality, integration, security, interoperability, and lifecycle management. Lead development of scalable data infrastructure, pipelines, data lakes/lakehouses, streaming architectures, and enterprise data platforms while establishing governance standards for ownership, classification, access, lineage, quality, retention, and interoperability.
  • Partner with the COO, Chief Growth Officer, and executive leadership to develop growth strategies leveraging PMAT’s AI/ML, data, and advanced analytics capabilities. Identify and support federal business opportunities, develop differentiated technical solutions and value propositions, participate in customer engagements and strategic partnerships, and support captures and proposals through technical strategy, solution architecture, innovation roadmaps, and differentiated AI/ML approaches.
  • Partner with PMAT’s SBIR and Advanced Technology teams to translate customer mission requirements into technical architectures, development roadmaps, prototypes, demonstrations, and operational solutions. Leverage SBIR/STTR and other technology-development programs to mature innovative capabilities, develop reusable AI/ML components, frameworks, models, platforms, and intellectual property, and transition successful innovations into operational capabilities, Phase III opportunities, and production programs.
  • Establish and oversee PMAT’s enterprise AI governance framework, ensuring AI/ML solutions align with applicable federal requirements, relevant NIST AI Risk Management Framework principles, cybersecurity standards, and agency-specific requirements. Integrate security, privacy, explainability, model validation, human oversight, and risk management into AI/ML development and address model vulnerabilities, data poisoning, adversarial threats, model drift, and third-party technology risk.
  • Build and lead high-performing teams across data science, AI/ML engineering, data engineering, AI architecture, and advanced analytics. Establish organizational structure, talent strategy, development standards, operating budgets, investment priorities, and performance measures while driving technical excellence, innovation, accountability, knowledge sharing, operational efficiency, and scalable delivery across programs and customers. Establish and achieve measurable outcomes across AI/ML strategy execution; revenue growth and qualified pipeline; capture participation and contract awards; product and technology development; enterprise AI/ML adoption; operational efficiency; technical performance and scalability; talent acquisition, retention, and development; financial performance and return on technology investments; AI governance and security; strategic customer engagement; SBIR/STTR support; Advanced Technology collaboration; and the transition of AI/ML innovations into funded initiatives, Phase III awards, operational deployments, and production programs.

About Us: PMAT is an innovative small business founded with a passion for developing forward-leaning solutions from exceptional people that increase the mission's capability. We focus on designing and building impactful digital solutions that utilize modern cloud, data, and software concepts. Our passion is working on complex and progressive challenges such as edge platform computing, containerizing legacy platforms, distributed data platforms, or heterogeneous data analysis.

We recruit, retain, and foster a team motivated to pursue passions, investigate new ways of doing things, and embody an innovative and entrepreneurial spirit. We believe in being curious about every element of a problem and experiment relentlessly. We foster continuous learning in an environment that encourages positive collaboration and expands our capabilities. We tap into collective intelligence, acknowledging that the most brilliant people may not be in the room. Above all else, we believe that delivering and demonstrating is more potent than a sheet of paper. We are passionate about mission-centric design and delivering effective capabilities to and for the warfighter.

Whether you’re an experienced engineer or just beginning your career, you’ll work alongside experts who are committed to solving mission-critical problems. If you’re passionate about using your skills to make a real difference, apply today and become part of a team that’s shaping the future of defense technology!

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, AI/ML, software engineering, advanced analytics, or related technology disciplines, including significant leadership experience.
  • A Senior Director at a large organization.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing enterprise data, AI, or ML strategies and translating them into operational capabilities.
  • Deep understanding of modern AI/ML architectures, including generative AI, large language models, predictive analytics, machine learning, and intelligent automation.
  • Experience designing and implementing enterprise data platforms, scalable AI architectures, and production-grade AI/ML solutions.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and complex technology-development initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technologies into business strategies, customer solutions, and measurable financial or mission outcomes.
  • Experience supporting federal customers, preferably within the Department of Defense, Intelligence Community, or national security sectors.
  • Experience contributing to business development, capture, technical proposals, or commercialization of technology capabilities.
  • Strong executive communication, strategic planning, organizational leadership, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and measure organizational and technology performance across strategy execution, business growth, technology development and transition, technology adoption, operational efficiency, technical excellence, organizational development, governance, security, and customer impact.
  • Ability to operate as a member of executive leadership and connect technology strategy to business growth, operational performance, customer mission outcomes, and long-term enterprise value.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Previous experience as a VP of Technology, CTO, VP of Engineering, or comparable senior executive responsible for enterprise AI/ML or data strategy.
  • Experience implementing AI/ML solutions in classified, air-gapped, edge, tactical, or other highly constrained environments.
  • Experience with DoD and IC technology environments, including cybersecurity, accreditation, deployment, rapid capability development, and technology transition requirements.
  • Familiarity with SBIR/STTR programs and DoD technology transition pathways.
  • Experience with major cloud and AI ecosystems such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, and NVIDIA.
  • Experience with modern AI development frameworks and technologies such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, vector databases, and model orchestration platforms.
  • Experience developing reusable AI-enabled products, software platforms, or intellectual property for application across multiple federal customers.
  • Demonstrated success building strategic technology partnerships and differentiated solutions for competitive federal procurements.

Education and Certification Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related discipline preferred.

Citizenship and Clearance requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship required
  • No dual citizenship
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an active DoD TS/SCI security clearance

Location/Address:

  • Remote - Washington, D.C.

Travel & Passport:

  • Under 35% travel
  • CONUS

Work Environment: PMAT offices as needed. In some cases, work in a government facility may be required. Travel may be required for customer engagement, team coordination, and potentially for business development.

PMAT is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe in hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive, people-first culture. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, such as disability and veteran status, or any other basis covered under applicable law.

For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.

We are excited to announce an opportunity to join our healthcare claims team as a Major Case Consultant Specialized Claims. This full time, exempt position offers the flexibility of working remotely while contributing to a high impact, collaborative team.

Position Overview:

The Major Case Consultant Specialized Claims role is a senior-level claims position responsible for the full lifecycle management of highly complex and high-value medical professional liability claims. This includes the investigation, evaluation, negotiation, and resolution of claims that represent the company’s largest damage exposures and often involve intricate coverage issues.

The position requires a high level of technical expertise and collaboration with professionals across various disciplines. Specialized claims handled in this role primarily focused on elder care facilities, medical negligence and additional medical malpractice.

In this role you will:

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Marketing
jobs.excerpt: The AutoVitals suite of SaaS products is designed to solve many of the current hurdles faced by auto repair shops.
jobs.description:
The AutoVitals suite of SaaS products is designed to solve many of the current hurdles faced by auto repair shops. Our mission is to help auto repair shops drive profitable growth by attracting new customers, delivering superior communication and customer service, increasing shop efficiency, and raising average repair orders.

We are building product marketing as a dedicated function for the first time and looking for someone to own it and build it. This role takes our products to market: positioning and messaging across the suite, who each product is for by shop size and by role, the launch plans that turn a release into revenue, and our competitive picture. This is a hands-on role. You will write the messaging, build the plan, and sit with sales to make sure it lands. Over time you will build the function, hire and develop product marketers, and put in place the standards and playbooks it runs on. The scope of this role grows with the function you build.

Product marketing works across product, sales, and marketing. You take what is coming from Product and turn it into something Sales can sell. Before a campaign goes out, this role provides the air cover: segmented messaging and content that warms up a market so a prospect is already primed when sales makes contact. You will coordinate with demand generation and content so one message reaches each segment through one plan, not several.

Responsibilities

  • Own positioning, messaging, and value proposition for every product in the AutoVitals suite, grounded in buyer needs and differentiated by shop size and by buyer role
  • Define who we sell to by revenue band, location count, and role, and keep that segmentation and their pain points current as the product catalog and market evolve
  • Partner with Product on what is coming and translate the roadmap into market-facing language before it ships
  • Partner with Brand on product naming and identity so the product story and the company story line up
  • Own the go-to-market plan for every launch on the product roadmap, including audience, message, sequence, channels, internal readiness across sales, support, training, and shop success, and the measures of whether it worked
  • Own the launch communication plan across clients, prospects, and internal teams, including FAQs so everyone answers questions the same way
  • Own adoption of features already in market, not just what is new, so existing shops know what they have and use it
  • Own the competitive picture end to end, including who we win against, who we lose to, and why, with battlecards, win and loss themes, and positioning against the platforms shops evaluate alongside us
  • Bring the competitive read into pricing, packaging, and roadmap conversations, and keep leadership current on what is changing in the market
  • Build the material sales actually uses: decks, one-pagers, talk tracks, objection handling, and FAQs tied to the problems shops are trying to solve
  • Own the customer proof points and reference stories sales relies on, and work with content to get them produced
  • Give campaigns air cover with segmented messaging and content that runs ahead of outreach, coordinating with demand generation and content so one consistent message reaches each segment
  • Measure what you build against sales adoption and pipeline, and improve it based on what closes
  • Build product marketing into a function with defined standards, process, and an operating cadence with product, sales, and the rest of marketing so launches are planned, not reactive
  • Hire, onboard, and develop product marketers as the team grows, and define how they align to areas of the product and their product management counterparts

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product marketing at a B2B SaaS or technology company
  • Experience conducting market discovery through customer, prospect, and win and loss interviews, then translating those insights into validated market problems, buyer personas, positioning, and go-to-market decisions
  • Experience managing or developing product marketers and building the process, standards, and playbooks a function runs on, not only doing the work yourself
  • Track record owning product launches end to end, from positioning through sales readiness and results
  • Strong writer and clear communicator who can take a technical product and say plainly what it does and who it is for, across all levels of an organization
  • Experience building competitive intelligence from scratch, including research, battlecards, and win and loss analysis
  • Experience segmenting a market and building differentiated messaging by segment and by buyer role
  • Comfortable working directly with sales reps, sitting in on calls, and building what they will actually use
  • Data-literate, able to connect messaging and launch work to pipeline and bookings
  • Comfortable building from scratch in a fast-moving environment where not everything is defined yet
  • Bonus
    • Pragmatic Marketing or Product Marketing Alliance certification
    • Experience taking a multi-product platform to market
    • Experience marketing to small and medium-sized businesses, particularly in automotive, home services, or a similar vertical
    • Familiarity with Salesforce and HubSpot
    • Background or knowledge of the automotive repair industry

Salary Range Transparency

Annual Total Compensation Range: $135,000 – $155,000 OTE (includes base salary up to $140,909 + 10% target bonus).

Individual compensation offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, applicable skills, educational background, relevant experience
