jobs.excerpt: Vous joindre à AbbVie signifie que vous ferez partie d’une équipe de professionnels exceptionnels qui se sont engagés à avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des patients.
jobs.description:
Vous joindre à AbbVie signifie que vous ferez partie d’une équipe de professionnels exceptionnels qui se sont engagés à avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des patients. À AbbVie, nous effectuons des recherches scientifiques révolutionnaires à l’échelle mondiale au quotidien. AbbVie Canada est l’un des meilleurs lieux de travail au Canada.

En choisissant votre cheminement de carrière, choisissez d’être remarquable.

AbbVie a pour mission de découvrir et d’offrir des médicaments novateurs pour répondre à des besoins importants en matière de santé aujourd’hui et relever les défis médicaux de demain. AbbVie met tout en œuvre afin d’avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des gens dans divers secteurs thérapeutiques clés, dont l’immunologie, l’oncologie, les neurosciences, les soins de la vue, la virologie, la santé des femmes et la gastroentérologie, de même que dans le domaine de l’esthétique par le truchement des produits et services d’Allergan Aesthetics.

We have an opportunity for Senior Manager, Market Access & Government Affairs to join our Market Access and Government Affairs (MA & GA) team. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing public payer reimbursement of AbbVie products in Oncology as well as supporting the government affairs / regional policy initiatives for Quebec and all the provinces in Atlantic Canada. The incumbent will report to the Lead, Market Access and Government Affairs- Oncology.

Position Summary

Lead AbbVie’s government affairs and market access strategy for Oncology products across Quebec and Atlantic Canada. This role will build trusted relationships with government decision-makers, public and private payers, and key healthcare stakeholders to advance policy, strengthen market access, and support optimal reimbursement conditions.

The ideal candidate will bring 10+ years of experience in government affairs, market access, health policy, or a related field. Pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical experience and candidates with strong policy expertise from other sectors. Exceptional government affairs, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills are essential. Ideal candidate will be located in Quebec, we may consider Atlantic based candidates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute regional government affairs, health policy, and market access strategies for Quebec and Atlantic Canada.
  • Secure and maintain market access and optimal reimbursement for oncology products with provincial payers and cancer agencies.
  • Build and manage productive relationships with the offices of ministers and premiers, deputy ministers, senior civil servants, other policy makers public and private payers, drug plan managers, and other health policy influencers.
  • Monitor legislation, regulations, and policy developments; identify barriers and opportunities; and develop timely responses, and policy recommendations.
  • Influence provincial legislation, regulation and policy by translating AbbVie’s clinical, policy positions and economic, and patient value propositions into compelling stakeholder engagement strategies.
  • Develop annual regional customer plans, track execution and impact, and ensure alignment with national market access and government affairs priorities.
  • Collaborate with Market Access, HEOR, Medical, patient engagement, communications, Commercial, and cross-functional brand teams to deliver integrated engagement plans.
  • Support provincial patient evidence submissions and advocacy initiatives in partnership with the cross functional team
  • Lead multi-stakeholder projects that address policymaker and public payer priorities and position AbbVie as a trusted, expert partner.
  • In collaboration with cross-functional colleagues, Provide policymakers and drug plan managers with relevant clinical, health economic, outcomes research, and real-world evidence.
  • Represent AbbVie on relevant provincial and regional biopharmaceutical industry committees, including Innovative Medicines Canada, and provincial life sciences organizations.
  • Manage regional brand and corporate budgets and support financial planning cycles.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, science, public policy, health administration, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in government affairs, market access, public or health policy, consulting or working within the public sector or government. Those with experience in Pharmaceutical and other regulated industries are encouraged to apply.
  • Demonstrated track record of success influencing legislation, regulation, health policy, or public reimbursement decisions.
  • Strong policy analysis skills, including the ability to assess proposed legislation and health policies and respond quickly and effectively in writing.
  • Deep understanding of the Canadian healthcare and reimbursement landscape, including provincial governments, public drug plans, private payers, Canada’s Drug Agency, INESSS, and related drug approval and funding processes.
  • Experience engaging senior stakeholders and payers in Quebec and Atlantic Canada.
  • Understanding of health economics, pharmacoeconomics, outcomes research, and real-world evidence principles.
  • Ability to foster strategic partnerships with external stakeholders

Essential Skills and Capabilities

  • Exceptional government and stakeholder relationship management skills.
  • Strong policy judgment and the ability to anticipate and shape the external environment.
  • Ability to convert business and brand priorities into practical, strategic government affairs and market access plans.
  • Ability to develop compelling value propositions tailored to policymakers, payers, and public healthcare stakeholders.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and strategic planning skills.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and influencing capabilities.
  • Strong story telling and communication skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-paced, and highly regulated environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfortable using AI tools
  • Valid driver’s license and passport required.
  • AbbVie aims to offer a French-speaking workplace in Quebec and has made efforts to limit English requirements. However, advanced English skills are essential for this role because the position involves working with English-speaking employees, clients, and regions outside Quebec. French is also required as the role will communicate with French speaking stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to work within a matrix environment with strong collaboration skills.

Travel approximately 25% within Canada and 5% internationally.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community.  Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

About NetDocuments

At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

  • Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies
  • Five-time Top Workplace USA winner
  • Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace
  • Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

NetDocuments is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to help shape the next generation of our document management platform. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who brings deep expertise building production-grade full stack applications and a strong track record of leading technical direction within their team.

You’ll operate as a hands-on technical leader, helping drive the architecture and delivery of scalable, event-driven systems across React, TypeScript, Node.js, C#/.NET, and AWS. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Platform Services, and engineering leadership to solve complex technical challenges, integrate emerging technologies including AI-powered services, and ensure our platform continues to scale with the performance, reliability, and security our customers expect.

You will:

Technical Leadership & Team Impact

  • Lead architectural discussions and make technical decisions across frontend, backend, and distributed systems.

Design & Build

System Performance & Operational Excellence

Continuous Learning & Innovation

jobs.excerpt: Founding Sales Development Representative (SDR) — AI & Zero Trust Security Remote (US) · ET or CT time zone · [$60,000 base / $90,000 OTE] + equity The short version: NetFoundry, the company behind OpenZiti, the world’s most used open source Zero Trust networking software, is hiring two founding SDRs to build NetFoundry's outbound engine.
jobs.description:
Founding Sales Development Representative (SDR) — AI & Zero Trust Security

Remote (US) · ET or CT time zone · [$60,000 base / $90,000 OTE] + equity

The short version: NetFoundry, the company behind OpenZiti, the world’s most used open source Zero Trust networking software, is hiring two founding SDRs to build NetFoundry's outbound engine. This is a hunter role selling Zero Trust connectivity into cybersecurity, cloud, and AI infrastructure teams. If you want to build the playbook instead of inheriting one and have ambition to become an AE, keep reading.

Why this matters now:

AI broke the network security model.

Agents, models, and APIs now need to reach data and systems scattered across clouds, data centers, edge sites, and customer environments. Every one of those connections is a new attack surface. VPNs, open inbound ports, and firewall rules were never designed for a world where the thing requesting access is a non-human identity that spun up four seconds ago.

NetFoundry replaces that model. Our Identity-First Connectivity™ platform delivers Zero Trust connectivity with no VPNs, no open inbound ports, and no firewall changes enabling enterprises to connect AI agents, APIs, and distributed workloads without exposing anything to the internet.

Enterprises use us to secure access to their APIs and agentic AI services, to run microsegmentation, and to simplify hybrid IT/OT segmentation. Software and IoT providers use us to reach workloads inside their customers' networks.

We were founded by the inventors and maintainers of OpenZiti, the world's most-used open source Zero Trust networking software. We're Series A, backed by SYN Ventures and Cisco Investments, headquartered in Charlotte, NC, and remote-first since day one.

The role:

We have one SDR today. We're hiring two more, and we're building the enterprise go-to-market motion around you.

That means the target account strategy, the sequences, the call openers, the objection handling, the way we mine our open source community for enterprise signal - isn't fully developed yet. You'll contribute to it working directly with our AEs, our marketing team, and GTM leadership that has built and exited multiple startups.

This is the right role if you want to be early. It's the wrong role if you want a machine that already runs.

A note on leads: This is an outbound focused role. Marketing supports you with content, campaigns, and intent data. Pieline starts with you, on the phone.

What you'll do:

  • Own outbound pipeline generation into a defined set of enterprise accounts — you build the list, you work the list
  • Cold call. Daily. This is the core of the job, not a footnote
  • Run multi-channel outbound across phone, email, and LinkedIn, with real personalization rather than merge fields
  • Run discovery that surfaces real pain: firewall and VPN sprawl, exposed APIs, OT segmentation projects, AI agents that need access to sensitive systems
  • Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and hit monthly and quarterly pipeline targets
  • Build account plans with AEs and multi-thread into security, networking, cloud, and platform teams
  • Act as our fastest feedback loop since you'll hear what the market says before anyone else. Leadership will change the messaging based on what you report.

What we're looking for:

  • Ambition to become an AE
  • 1–3 years in outbound SDR/BDR or inside sales, ideally in cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise technology
  • A track record you can put numbers to - activity, meetings booked, pipeline sourced, quota attainment
  • Genuine willingness to cold call, and the resilience to do it on the days it isn't working
  • Strong written communication; you can write an email a CISO would actually reply to
  • Comfort with technical buyers, and curiosity to learn what a firewall rule, a service mesh, and an AI agent actually are
  • Experience with CRM and sales engagement platforms (we run HubSpot)
  • Organized, coachable, and hard to discourage

Nice to have: Familiarity with Zero Trust or secure connectivity concepts; experience with open source or developer communities; account-based selling.

What you get:

  • A founding seat. You're among the first three SDRs at a company building a category, with direct access to GTM leadership and founders
  • A clear path to AE. Our SDR→AE path is 12-18 months for performers, and we'd rather promote you than hire around you
  • Competitive base with uncapped commission, plus meaningful equity — $60,000 base / $90,000 OTE (uncapped)
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision, plus expanded well-being benefits
  • Employer-paid life, AD&D, and short- and long-term disability
  • 401k with company match
  • Unlimited PTO and paid holidays
  • Learning & development budget, technology stipend, internet stipend, SWAG stipend
  • Remote-first with flexible hours, as a globally distributed team
Salary: $60,000 base/ $90,000 OTE (uncapped) + equity

jobs.title: Head of Psychiatric Practice
jobs.excerpt: At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs.
jobs.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.


ROLE OVERVIEW


This role is responsible for advancing enterprise psychiatric practice excellence by developing standards, evidence-based frameworks, provider excellence programs, and quality improvement initiatives to support psychiatric clinicians, patients, and clinical operations. Success looks like psychiatric standards, reduced unwarranted variation, improved quality and safety, and measurable improvement in psychiatric outcomes. This role will help to design and implement psychiatric Centers of Excellence, establish measurable quality frameworks, and build sustainable pipelines for clinician recruitment, retention, education, and wellbeing at a national organization.


This role is part of a team who will be assisting with implementing the and guiding the directives of the CMO team. We are seeking a highly collaborative, mission-driven professional with strong emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and exceptional executive functioning. The ideal candidate is a mature and efficient team player who communicates thoughtfully, remains solutions-oriented under pressure, and consistently puts shared goals above personal agenda. This person should be energized by the opportunity to help shape the future of mental healthcare and thrive in a high-accountability environment built on trust, focus, and mutual respect.

Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.


KEY RESPONSIBILITES

  • Establish and maintain organizational psychiatric practice standards, treatment frameworks, and clinical expectations across markets and service lines.
  • Lead development and implementation of evidence-based psychiatric guidelines, tools, protocols, and practice resources.
  • Partner with Medical Leadership, Clinical Operations, Quality, Clinical Excellence, Learning & Development, and Measurement-Based Care teams to improve psychiatric care quality, safety, consistency, and outcomes.
  • Identify and address psychiatric practice variation through data review, education, and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Build and oversee a comprehensive clinician education and professional development curriculum across specialties and practice settings
  • Design and oversee psychiatric provider excellence programs, including onboarding support, competency frameworks, mentoring structures, and ongoing professional development.
  • Assist with transition to uniform and singular EHR use across the organization and developing efficient EHR workflows and policies that support the clinical user.
  • Support development and review of psychiatric clinical policies, protocols, and standards that align with applicable laws, regulations, and professional expectations.
  • Monitor psychiatric quality metrics, patient safety trends, outcomes, and clinical effectiveness measures to inform improvement priorities.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor and subject matter expert regarding psychiatric practice trends, provider enablement, clinical risk, and standards of care.
  • Lead initiatives supporting physician wellbeing, joy in medicine, and burnout prevention across the enterprise.
  • Report on quality metrics, program outcomes, and workforce key performance
  • indicators to the Vice President and C-suite stakeholders

Scope / Decision-Making / Impact


This role receives strategic direction from the Senior Leader, Psychiatric Excellence & Emerging Therapeutics and independently translates enterprise priorities into psychiatric practice standards, implementation plans, quality improvement priorities, and provider enablement strategies. The role makes day-to-day decisions regarding clinical framework development, education priorities, practice variation assessment, and quality improvement recommendations. Input or escalation is required when decisions involve enterprise-wide policy changes, regulatory or legal implications, significant operational impact, patient safety risk, or new areas of clinical practice standardization.


Supervisory Responsibilities


This role may supervise direct reports as the psychiatric practice function scales and may provide functional leadership to physician leaders, psychiatric advanced practice provider stakeholders, and cross-functional workstreams. The role influences performance through standards, coaching, education, clinical guidance, and accountability for quality and outcomes improvement across the psychiatric provider population.

REQUIREMENTS

  • MD or DO with board certification in Psychiatry.
  • Active, unrestricted medical license and ability to maintain appropriate licensure requirements.
  • 10+ years of psychiatric clinical experience, including progressive leadership experience within healthcare or behavioral health organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience developing clinical standards, treatment frameworks, quality improvement initiatives, or provider excellence programs.
  • Strong understanding of psychiatric standards of care, patient safety, clinical governance, regulatory expectations, and evidence-based practice.
  • Familiar with value-based care frameworks
  • Ability to influence senior clinical and operational stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Sportsbook (Backend)
jobs.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
jobs.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a deeply curious team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're customer-obsessed — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What's the position?

We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead our Sportsbook Experience backend team within the Sportsbook unit at Hard Rock Digital. You will own people leadership, team health, and engineering excellence for the pod that builds and operates the Java/Spring services behind Hard Rock Bet — event and market data, pricing and odds delivery, betslip and bet placement, cash out, and the high-throughput APIs and streaming feeds that power our web, native, and retail clients.

You will partner closely with Product Owners, the Director of Sportsbook, Technical Delivery Leads and other Engineering Managers to deliver high-quality software in alignment with product priorities, while fostering a culture where engineers do their best work. You will also be a key voice in our push to become an AI-first organization: we expect you to champion the use of AI-augmented development, responsible AI practices, and continuous learning so your team and our products benefit from AI-led innovation.

This is an opportunity to have real impact on how we work, how we build, and how we leverage AI—every day.

How we work at HRD

  • Product-driven: Product sets the north star; Engineering Managers ensure their teams can execute with clarity and quality. We balance delivery with technical health and support Technical Leads on cross-pod coordination and delivery.

  • Clear roles: EMs own people (performance, career growth, hiring), team health, and working with the team on technology decisions. Technical Leads own delivery across pods, project coordination, and vendor/architecture alignment. You will work in lockstep with your TL and Product Owner.

  • Collaboration: We work across pods and with Product, Design, QA, and Platform. We value transparency, backlog refinement, and early alignment so we can deliver predictably and improve continuously.

  • Excellence and ownership: We hold ourselves to high standards. Compliance, security, and documentation are part of how we design and build—especially in a real-money, in-play sportsbook, where reliability, latency, and regulation matter every day.

AI-first organization

Hard Rock Digital is committed to becoming an AI-first organization. Our AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) exists to empower AI-led innovation by orchestrating partnerships, democratizing knowledge and tools, and building capabilities that deliver value through safe and responsible use of AI.

What this means for you and your team

  • AI-augmented development is essential. We allow and support AI-generated code from approved tools (e.g. Cody, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude). All such code must be understood, reviewed, and tested before merge—you own what you check in. We have clear AI Code Check-In Best Practices and expect EMs to reinforce them.

  • We invest in AI across the stack. Tech is actively deploying AI in requirements gathering and planning, PR/code review (e.g. Derpbot), alert investigation (e.g. Alerti), API and E2E testing acceleration, and exploration of agentic workflows and MCPs. We want leaders who will adopt these tools and advocate for their responsible use.

  • We build and govern responsibly. We have an AI Charter, Policy, and governance so we innovate with appropriate guardrails. Your role includes helping your team use AI effectively while adhering to our standards and compliance expectations—especially in a regulated domain like sports betting.

  • We learn and share. We have an AI focus group, recommended learning paths, and initiatives that span from code to operations to product. We are looking for an EM who will keep the Sportsbook Experience pod engaged with AI initiatives and who sees AI as a force multiplier for the team and the product.

  • We want a leader who is excited to operate in this environment and to help shape how Sportsbook and HRD work in an AI-first way.

  • People & team: Run regular 1:1s, stand-ups, and ad-hoc support. Address impediments, clarify priorities, and ensure the team has the resources and context to deliver. Own performance feedback, career development, and workforce planning so the team stays motivated and high-performing.

  • Delivery & process: Monitor sprint progress, adjust priorities when needed, and keep work well scoped and estimated. Work with Product to break down requirements into clear features and user stories. Use backlog grooming, sprint planning, and retrospectives to improve predictability and quality.

  • Stakeholder alignment: Partner with Product Owners, Technical Leads, other EMs, and leadership to align on objectives, dependencies, and risks. Represent the team in cross-team and Sportsbook-wide discussions.

  • Technical partnership (hands-on): Stay close to the code. Review pull requests on merit, contribute to design and architecture for our Java/Spring services, help debug production issues, and prototype where it unblocks the team. Ensure solutions follow our standards and best practices, and support the TL on vendor and technical stakeholder management where it affects your team.

  • Platform health & operations: Own the reliability, latency, and correctness of the services your team runs. Support in-play peaks and major sporting events with strong observability, sensible on-call practices, and genuine learning from incidents.

  • Hiring & composition: Assess workload and skills, identify hiring needs, and participate in recruiting and hiring. Help shape a team that can meet delivery commitments and grow over time.

  • Culture & AI: Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment. Champion our values and our AI-first direction: encourage use of approved AI tools, reinforce "you own what you check in," and keep the team connected to AI initiatives and learning.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • Leadership experience: Several years in technology with a meaningful portion in leadership or management—driving technical excellence, mentoring engineers, and delivering through others.

  • Backend engineering background (essential): You come from backend engineering and have built and run production systems in Java with Spring / Spring Boot. Strong grounding in microservices, REST APIs, event-driven architecture (e.g. Kafka), relational and NoSQL data stores, and operating services on AWS/Kubernetes.

  • Hands-on capability: You still read and write code. You can assess a pull request on its merits, reason about a thread dump, a slow query, or a latency spike, and pair with an engineer on a hard problem. This is not a purely process-focused management role.

  • Self-motivated and autonomous: You set your own agenda, spot problems before they are escalated to you, and drive them to resolution without being asked. You are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership, and you set the same expectation for your team.

  • Sportsbook domain fit: Experience or strong interest in sportsbook, trading, real-time/high-throughput systems, or other low-latency regulated platforms. Comfort with compliance, security, and operational rigour is important.

  • AI mindset: Curiosity and openness to AI-augmented development and AI initiatives. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you should be eager to learn, to adopt approved tools, and to help your team work in an AI-first way responsibly.

  • Collaboration and communication: Strong communication (written and verbal), experience working with Product and other engineering leaders, and a track record of building trust and resolving ambiguity.

  • Values alignment: You champion inclusion, growth, and a culture where people take ownership and learn from setbacks. You're comfortable promoting both delivery and technical excellence within a product-driven framework.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Proven ability to foster innovation, continuous improvement, and collaboration within a team or technology line.

  • Experience with agile development and with managing or contributing to backlogs, planning, and delivery metrics.

  • Demonstrable production experience with Java (17+) and the Spring ecosystem at scale.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreThe Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI) is a non-partisan, non-profit dedicated to equipping the next generation of Americans with the skills to communicate and collaborate across lines of difference.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

The Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI) is a non-partisan, non-profit dedicated to equipping the next generation of Americans with the skills to communicate and collaborate across lines of difference. We work with U.S. colleges and universities by providing co-curricular programming for students, professional development for faculty and staff, and strategic guidance to leadership. Our goal is to foster constructive dialogue at every level of the institution and to create the conditions for lasting organizational change. CDI was co-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of The Righteous Mind and The Anxious Generation.

The Role

CDI is seeking a rigorous, disciplined, and analytically sharp Senior Manager to serve as the qualitative expert behind our campus consulting work. Reporting to the Senior Director of Campus Culture Change, you will collect and code the interview, focus group, and survey data our engagements run on, and turn it into the findings our university partners act on.

This is a hands-on analysis role. You will run qualitative data collection across a portfolio of campus engagements, code consistently against CDI's shared frameworks, and hold the line on coding quality across projects. You will draft reports, memos, and client-facing narratives, and build the materials that carry findings to internal and external audiences. You will also partner with other team members to build qualitative case studies and institutional spotlights.

What You’ll Do

Research Design and Delivery

  • Collect and code interview, focus group, and open-ended survey data across a portfolio of campus consulting engagements, applying CDI's coding frameworks consistently from project to project.

  • Serve as lead liaison with the Research team and contribute to codeframe updates

  • Coordinate data collection logistics with campus partners, sequencing fieldwork around the academic calendar.

Measurement and Evaluation

  • Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to identify the themes, patterns, and findings that inform engagement recommendations and deliverables.

  • Own engagement deliverables: reports, memos, presentations, client-facing narratives

  • Present findings and recommendations to external stakeholders

Research Partnership & Thought Leadership

  • Build CDI's approach to assessing campus and Institutional Change Model consulting initiatives.

  • Conduct interviews and draft case studies that surface what is working across our campus partnerships.

  • Identify institutional spotlights for Culture Change projects, partnering with Communications.

  • Advise colleagues and partners on measuring organizational culture and the conditions for dialogue and open inquiry

Requirements

Who You Are

Required

  • A trained qualitative researcher. You bring 5+ years of applied qualitative research experience, or a graduate degree with substantial fieldwork, and you've run interviews and focus groups yourself.

  • Disciplined with a codebook. You code high volumes of data consistently and know which discrepancies to escalate and which to resolve on the spot. Experience with multi-coder QA or inter-rater reliability is a strong plus.

  • A clear analytic writer. You move from coded data to findings without overstating them, separate what participants said from what you infer, and integrate survey results with qualitative data.

  • Organized across a portfolio. You keep several engagements moving without losing track of which campus, which codebook version, and which deadline.

  • Grounded in organizational culture measurement. You assess culture beyond a single survey score, design approaches that combine interviews, documents, and survey data, and can explain what a given measure can and cannot tell us.

  • A steady partner to campus contacts. You coordinate with institutional research, academic leadership, and student affairs, and you plan around the academic calendar, not against it.

  • Credible across perspectives. You work with judgment across ideological lines, understand why nonpartisan restraint matters, and are motivated by CDI's mission.

  • Fluent with tools and AI. You're comfortable in qualitative analysis software (Dovetail preferred; Dedoose, NVivo, , or MAXQDA welcome) and use AI to speed up coding and drafting, while keeping interpretation in human hands.

What We Offer

  • A Mission-Driven Culture — our work culture genuinely reflects our mission, characterized by intellectual humility, continuous improvement, and open-mindedness

  • Unlimited PTO — recharge on your own schedule with unlimited paid time off, in addition to 13 company holidays

  • Health, Vision & Dental — health, vision, and dental plans, with CDI contributing toward your premiums each month

  • 401(k) Match — invest in your future with a 100% match on your contributions, up to 3% of your pay

  • Professional Development — a generous annual budget to invest in your growth: build new skills, deepen existing ones, and stay inspired in your work

  • Remote Work Support — up to $500 reimbursed for home office equipment and up to $50/month reimbursed for home internet or cell phone expenses

The Details

  • Compensation: $101,000-$113,000

  • Location: Remote, must be based in the U.S.

  • Schedule: Full-time, flexible within U.S. time zones

  • Reports to:Senior Director of Campus Culture Change

  • Target start date: Jan 1, 2027

Highlights

CDI seeks a Senior Manager, Qualitative Insights & Evaluation to lead qualitative research and evaluation with colleges and universities, turning findings into guidance campus partners act on.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP System Administrator
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking a seasoned SAP System Administrator responsible for the architecture, installation, configuration, performance tuning, and day-to-day operation of complex SAP landscapes that may span on-premises, hybrid, and cloud-hosted environments. This role is critical to keeping mission-critical SAP systems available, performant, secure, and compliant. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise across SAP NetWeaver, S/4HANA, HANA database administration, system copies, upgrades, and migrations, and will partner with infrastructure, security, and SAP functional teams to deliver a stable, well-governed SAP platform.



Key Responsibilities
  • Architect, install, configure, and operate SAP landscapes including S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Solution Manager, and other NetWeaver-based systems across on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Administer SAP HANA databases — including installation, sizing, replication, backup, recovery, and performance tuning — to meet demanding availability and performance SLAs.
  • Plan and execute SAP system copies, refreshes, and post-copy automation activities to support development, testing, training, and migration scenarios.
  • Lead SAP upgrades, EHP installations, Support Package application, kernel upgrades, and S/4HANA conversions with minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Design and implement SAP migrations to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SAP RISE/Grow environments, including network and identity integration.
  • Configure and operate high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions for SAP, including HANA System Replication, cluster-based failover, and validated DR runbooks.
  • Implement and maintain SAP transport management strategies, including Solution Manager ChaRM and CTS+ workflows.
  • Manage SAP user provisioning, role management, and audit support in close collaboration with the SAP Security/GRC team.
  • Monitor SAP system performance, capacity, and health using Solution Manager, Focused Run, native HANA tools, and external APM platforms.
  • Develop automation scripts and runbooks using Ansible, PowerShell, or Python to reduce operational toil and accelerate routine tasks.
  • Manage and remediate SAP security notes, kernel patches, and database patches in accordance with internal security and compliance policies.
  • Provide 24x7 on-call support for production SAP systems and lead structured incident response and post-incident reviews.
  • Document SAP architecture, operations procedures, and standard operating processes to support knowledge sharing and team scalability.
  • Mentor junior Basis engineers and contribute to the broader SAP platform roadmap.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP Basis / platform engineering experience in large enterprise environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering SAP HANA databases in production.
  • Experience operating S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Solution Manager, and other NetWeaver systems.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP migrations to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong experience with SAP upgrades, EHP/SP application, and system conversions.
  • Solid experience with SAP HA/DR strategies, including HANA System Replication and clustering.
  • Working knowledge of SAP transport management and Solution Manager ChaRM.
  • Scripting skills in Bash, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • SAP certifications in HANA, S/4HANA, or Basis administration.
  • Experience with SAP RISE / Grow and SAP Cloud ALM.
  • Familiarity with SAP BTP and integration with hyperscaler-native services.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code for SAP landscapes (Ansible, Terraform).
  • Experience operating regulated SAP workloads (SOX, GxP, PCI).

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Site Reliability Engineer (FedRAMP / AWS GovCloud)
jobs.excerpt: BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.
jobs.description:
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

The SRE Manager is the operating leader of a new cross-product SRE team at BeyondTrust, standing up and running the AWS GovCloud environments that bring additional BeyondTrust products into our FedRAMP authorization. Reporting to the VP of Application Engineering, this role owns the reliability, change control, and continuous-compliance machinery for those environments so that product feature teams can stay focused on product delivery.

This is a player-coach role. The right person has staff-level technical depth: they can critically review Terraform, pipeline definitions, and architecture proposals, have personally built and operated this machinery, and can carry context in an incident. That depth is combined with real people-management experience: they have hired, grown, and run a small SRE or DevOps team, and they own the team's delivery, not just its architecture. The engineering execution sits with the team; the manager stays close enough to the keyboard to lead it credibly.

The first-year mission is concrete: build and operate the AWS GovCloud environments that bring the covered products into our FedRAMP authorization, with the automation to keep them continuously compliant under FedRAMP 20x, where evidence is machine-readable, re-verified every few days, and reported monthly.

Our feature teams own product delivery. This role exists so they can focus on it. The SRE Manager takes permanent ownership of the shared operational work that would otherwise fall on feature teams as toil: the GovCloud environments, production operations, release and update machinery, and the compliance evidence pipeline for the covered products.

The team this role leads is an engineering team that owns operations, not an operations team. Its product is automation; operations is the input. Every manual procedure performed twice is a candidate for elimination, and the team's success is measured by the operational work it has made unnecessary, not the tickets it has closed. Hands-on operational work is capped at roughly half of team capacity; the rest goes to engineering the work away. Defending that split against day-to-day pressure is the manager's job.

What You’ll Do

GovCloud build and FedRAMP delivery

  • Own the AWS GovCloud landing zone for the new product environments: multi-account structure, SCPs and guardrails, logging and security-tooling accounts, IaC-native provisioning
  • Own the continuous-compliance evidence pipeline: collection, normalization, and reporting of FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators, built to the FedRAMP standard schema
  • Own FedRAMP continuous monitoring obligations for the covered environments, keeping that operational load off feature team engineers; broader compliance obligation tracking and audit coordination are owned by central teams
  • Own the CI/CD pipelines the GovCloud environments require (build, signing, artifact management, quality and security gates) and cloud cost visibility for the covered accounts

Production and change operations

  • Own the production change process, including change request governance, access controls, and approval standards, with auditable separation of duties between development and production
  • Own release and update machinery for cloud fleets: mandatory security updates, staged and jittered rollout windows, cluster-coordinated installs, and verification that a patch actually landed everywhere it was scoped to
  • Own the incident management process, tooling, on-call design, and post-incident review cadence
  • Drive the automated environment promotion path from development through staging to production
  • Note on workload shape: our estates are appliance-model and single-tenant VM fleets alongside shared services, not purely cloud-native. Fleet upgrade orchestration, golden images, and staged rollout at hundreds-to-thousands scale are core, not edge cases.

Intake and prioritization

  • Run intake and prioritization for operational requests from feature teams and leadership, keeping a single trusted view of active work, owners, and risks
  • Ensure the team is not overcommitted and that feature teams have a clear, responsive interface for operational needs

Team leadership

  • Lead a team of DevOps, SRE, and security automation engineers, providing direction, accountability, and operational clarity
  • Partner with the VP of Application Engineering on workforce planning, hiring, role design, and onboarding for the function
  • Build a culture of ownership, transparency, and reliable execution; set delivery rhythms, run planning cycles, and maintain visibility into team capacity and health

What Success Looks Like

  • The covered products live in AWS GovCloud under the FedRAMP authorization, with evidence produced by automation rather than by hand
  • Production changes go through a defined, auditable process; uncontrolled changes do not reach production
  • Patches and releases are verified as landed everywhere they were scoped to, as a system property rather than a manual check
  • FedRAMP continuous monitoring obligations are met on time, every month, without feature teams being interrupted or senior engineers pulled from product work

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Job Title: Associate Director, Regional Clinical Study Management

Job Location: Remote (US)

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:


Study management responsibilities:

  • Accountable for regional study or portfolio delivery with appropriate inspection readiness quality, within agreed timelines and budget
  • Acts as regional lead (if needed) for one or multiple studies across an indication or across a program as required.
  • Leads the regional clinical operations team (including external partners working on a regional level) and acts as point of escalation for resolution of issues within the region for the assigned study or portfolio of studies.
  • Contributes to the development of regional tools and leads the development of work instructions and SOPs as required.
  • Drives deliverables regionally for trial or portfolio.

Essential Functions of the Job:


Regional Leadership

Study management responsibilities:

  • Strategically leads the regional clinical operations team effectively across the department, ensures effective decision making and acts as point of escalation for resolution of issues within the region for the assigned study.
  • May oversee external vendors involved in study delivery on a regional level.
  • Collaborates with key stakeholders in the region and provides regular updates on study progress in the region to senior management and Global Clinical Study Manager as required.
  • Oversee the regional study team at internal meetings and at the cross-functional Clinical Study Team (CST) meetings.
  • Develops and articulates regional goals, inspiring performance across teams, and develops cross-functional strategies that lead to study success.
  • Displays therapeutic area knowledge and expertise of assigned portfolio.

Timelines, Planning and Execution

Study management responsibilities:

  • Leads or oversees the planning and management of the assigned clinical study(ies) from feasibility through closeout activities for region, in line with global study timelines.
  • Generates, manages, and maintains high quality study start up and recruitment timelines for region and tracks progress.
  • Drives strategy to ensure that the clinical study is operationally feasible in the region, drives trial feasibility, country allocation and site selection process for assigned region in collaboration with feasibility managers, country heads, medical affairs and any other stakeholders.
  • Provides regional input on global study plans as required.
  • Ensures timely availability of local adaptations of global study documents such as informed consent forms, in close collaboration with other key stake holders to ensure timely submission to regulatory authorities and ECs/IRBs.
  • Accountable for submissions of study in countries in assigned region in close collaboration with regional study start up team and regulatory affairs.
  • Ensures regional and country information in study systems and tools is entered and up to date.
  • Develops and implements effective coaching and mentoring to CRAs in the region to ensure proper study execution at the sites. May review and sign off monitoring reports.
  • Guides the team responsible for working with regional and country teams to ensure that country and site level Trial Master File is created, maintained and QC’d on a regular basis as per the study TMF QC plan.
  • Provides input to Global Clinical Supplies regarding drug inventories in region and reviews local drug labels for region. Provides input on local regulatory approval and reimbursement status of comparator drugs used in study for countries in region.
  • Anticipates and manages the trial data collection process for the region, drives data entry and query resolution.
  • As required, supports planning and execution of the Clinical Study Report in collaboration with Global Clinical Study Manager and Medical Writing.

Quality

Study management responsibilities:

  • Anticipates potential concerns and resolves escalated issues or problems with the sites in region in close collaboration with stakeholders such as country heads.
  • Monitors study activities in region to ensure compliance with study protocol, SOPs, ICH/GCP and all other relevant regulations.
  • Ensures inspection readiness for studies in region at any point in time throughout the study life cycle.
  • As regional study lead, informs Global Clinical Study Manager of any issues arising in the study, evaluates impact and ensures solutions are implemented. As portfolio lead, informs appropriate Global Clinical Study Managers and appropriate Global Clinical Program Leader of regional risk trends arising across portfolio of studies, evaluates impact and ensures solutions are implemented.
  • As study lead, prepares sites for quality assurance audits and inspections, drives responses to audit and inspection findings as appropriate.
  • Engages effectively with CST members and other colleagues to ensure cross-team, site learnings, and best practices are shared, promoting awareness and cross-functional collaborations.
  • Leads improvements and partners with CST members to enhance the efficiency and the quality of the work performed on assigned studies.
  • Leads the development, optimization and review of work instructions and SOPs as required.

Budget and Resources

Study management responsibilities:

  • Works with the sourcing team to select and manage regional study vendors.
  • Manages and negotiates regional study budgets.
  • Works closely with Clinical Business Operation on investigator fees, site payment issues and patient travel reimbursement activities.
  • Monitors regional resource utilization over study lifecycle and liaises with functional managers as needed.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Study management responsibilities:

  • Ensures the competencies and skills required for the Clinical team are consistent with the company defined requirements.
  • Mentor junior team members to support development by delegating responsibilities, overseeing and supporting development plans.

Computer Skills:

  • MS Office, Project Planning Applications

Other Qualifications:

  • Solid leadership and management experience either as direct line manager or as cross functional team lead
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Exercises sound judgement and discretion in matters of significance
  • Ability to work independently and effectively handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, strong organizational skills and ability to influence and lead

Travel:

  • Travel might be required as per business need.

Education Required:

Bachelor's degree in a scientific or healthcare discipline and 8+ years of progressive experience in clinical operations within biotech, pharmaceutical or CRO industry. Preferably master’s degree in a scientific or healthcare discipline and 6+ years of progressive experience in clinical operations within biotech, pharmaceutical or CRO industry

.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented

jobs.excerpt: About Baringa Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value.
jobs.description:
About Baringa

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Technology and Cyber team are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Engineer to join the team.

Baringa has grown so fast, and it continues to grow rapidly. Those new joiners keep on coming! We are a global function supporting the firm as it enters new markets. We are re-architecting and evolving our cloud-based business systems and infrastructure. We are on a mission to develop great technology products, deliver great services, and protect the trust our people and clients place in us. We have installed a new operating system for ourselves, and rebooted what was a corporate IT department into a corporate technology company, transforming the way we work.

Now we are building for the next era of work. AI is becoming part of the fabric of how Baringa operates, and we are developing the products and platforms that will help colleagues find knowledge, act on insight, navigate complexity, and get work done with greater speed, quality, and confidence. Some of this will be visible through intelligent experiences and agentic systems. Some of it will sit beneath the surface: data products, workflow platforms, integrations, automations, cyber security, governance, and the architecture that makes all of it safe, scalable, resilient, and useful.

So much to build on, so much to progress. So much to deliver. So much to play for!

Do you know what though? We are going to do it. All of it and more. We have the support to drive change. We have the belief. We are going to do great things. Come and join us!

What you will be doing

  • Design, build and support enterprise-grade integrations across Baringa’s business systems and technology platforms.
  • Develop Azure Function App solutions that enable secure, reliable and scalable integration between strategic systems including Dynamics 365, Workday, Dataverse and other enterprise applications.
  • Build and maintain custom APIs, services and integration components that support critical business processes and data flows.
  • Design and implement integration patterns using Azure services including API Management, Service Bus, Storage Accounts and Key Vault.
  • Support the ongoing modernisation of legacy integrations and data exchange processes, helping create more resilient and future-ready platforms.
  • Own technical delivery from design through to deployment, support and continuous improvement.
  • Identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, scalability and maintainability across the integration estate.
  • Design solutions with appropriate security, monitoring, governance and operational controls, ensuring risks are understood and managed from the outset.
  • Participate in troubleshooting, production support and incident resolution for business-critical integrations.
  • Work closely with Product Owners, Engineers and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.

Your skills and experience

  • Strong experience designing, building and supporting integrations using Azure Function Apps.
  • Experience integrating Dynamics 365 applications using custom APIs and native integration capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs and modern integration design principles.
  • Experience working with Azure integration services including API Management (APIM), Service Bus, Storage Accounts and Key Vault.
  • Knowledge of Dataverse integration patterns and the wider Power Platform ecosystem.
  • Experience designing and securing integration solutions using OAuth, Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identity and modern enterprise networking patterns, including private endpoints, network isolation and secure service-to-service communication.
  • Ability to identify and mitigate technical, security and operational risks in integration solutions.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting, retry handling and support processes for production environments.
  • Comfortable leveraging and building with frontier AI engineering tools and autonomous frameworks. You possess a strong architectural discipline, ensuring that while we aggressively push the boundaries of AI-assisted development, we do so with a rigorous commitment to code quality, safety, and governance.

What a career at Baringa will give you

Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave.
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us.
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice.
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success.

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.

Using business as a force for good.

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

jobs.description:
The Senior Integration Developer will design, build, and support integration solutions that connect Alimentiv’s business, clinical, and data platforms. This role requires strong experience with Azure Integration Services, including Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Event Grid, and API Management, with exposure to equivalent AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, and EventBridge. The Senior Integration Developer will develop reliable, secure, and well-monitored integrations using APIs, messaging, and event-driven patterns, and will support automation and production deployments through CI/CD. The role will follow established architecture, engineering standards, and security and data governance requirements, including GxP and HIPAA/GDPR where applicable. The Senior Integration Developer will work closely with lead engineers, application owners, vendors, and business stakeholders, contribute to technical design decisions, and provide guidance to junior developers while delivering high-quality integration solutions aligned with organizational objectives

Integration Design & Development - 55%

  • Design, build, and maintain integration solutions using Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and API Management.
  • Develop REST/JSON and SOAP/XML API integrations between internal systems, SaaS applications, vendors, and the Alimentiv Data Platform.
  • Implement messaging and event-driven patterns, including queues, topics/subscriptions, publish/subscribe, and dead-letter handling.
  • Build serverless functions in Python and/or C# for transformation, orchestration, and custom connectors.
  • Design integrations for reliability, including retries, idempotency, error handling, and message ordering.
  • Optimize integrations for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Logging, Monitoring & Support - 10%

  • Implement centralized logging and monitoring using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics.
  • Build alerts, dashboards, and health checks to track integration performance and failures.
  • Use correlation IDs and structured logging for end-to-end traceability across systems.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production integration issues, including root cause analysis.
  • Support incident, problem, and change management processes for integration services.

Automation, DevOps & Multi-Cloud 10%

  • Automate build and deployment of integration components using Terraform and Git-based CI/CD.
  • Provision and manage integration infrastructure using infrastructure as code (Bicep, ARM, or Terraform).
  • Develop reusable integration templates, patterns, and shared components.
  • Develop automated unit, integration, and regression tests for integration workflows.
  • Build and support integrations using AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, and API Gateway where required by clients or vendors.

Security, Compliance & Governance - 10%

  • Secure integrations using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, OAuth 2.0, and Azure Key Vault.
  • Ensure no credentials or secrets are hardcoded, in line with Alimentiv IT security policies.
  • Ensure compliance with GxP, GDPR/HIPAA, and related regulatory frameworks.
  • Maintain audit trails and support validation documentation for integrations with regulated systems.
  • Develop and maintain integration documentation, interface specifications, and an integration catalog.
  • Conduct code reviews, performance tuning, and security reviews of integration workloads.

Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership - 15%

  • Participate in technical design reviews, support junior developers, and promote integration best practices.
  • Work with cross-functional teams, application owners, vendors, and stakeholders to gather, define, and refine integration requirements.
  • Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to ensure integration solutions support organizational objectives.
  • Recommend the right integration approach (API, messaging, event-driven, or batch) to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Contribute to integration architecture, technical roadmaps, and technology evaluations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve integration processes, performance, reliability, and efficiency, and recommend solutions to technical and functional leaders.

Qualifications

    Job Experience & Education Requirements:

    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred)

    And

    5–8 years of experience designing and developing enterprise integration solutions (APIs, messaging, event-driven and serverless architectures)

    Other:

jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

ABOUT US

There are more than 9 million immunocompromised people in the United States. Almost half a million of those represent a population that are moderately to severely immunocompromised and at highest risk for severe COVID-19, including stem cell and solid organ transplant patients as well as those with hematologic cancers.

At Invivyd, Inc., we take those numbers very seriously and we come to work each day on a mission to deliver protection from serious viral infectious diseases, beginning with SARS-CoV-2. Invivyd deploys a proprietary integrated technology platform unique in the industry designed to assess, monitor, develop, and adapt to create best in class antibodies.

In March 2024, Invivyd received emergency use authorization (EUA) from the U.S. FDA for a monoclonal antibody (mAb) in its pipeline of innovative antibody candidates.

In October 2025, the FDA cleared the company's Investigational New Drug (IND) application and provided feedback to advance the company's REVOLUTION clinical program, Invivyd's development program for VYD2311, a vaccine alternative monoclonal antibody being investigated for the prevention of COVID-19.

Be part of making a difference. Be part of Invivyd.

Location: Mid Atlantic

DC, Maryland, NJ

The Field Reimbursement Manager (FRM) serves as key field-based expert in market access and reimbursement, and the subject matter expert in navigating the reimbursement and access landscape for healthcare providers, office staff, and other critical stakeholders. This role provides education across the entire access journey, with deep expertise in claims submissions, prior authorization processes, coverage criteria, and payer-specific requirements across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid plans.

Success in this role requires strong business acumen, an understanding of the national payer environment, and the ability to build trusted relationships with provider offices, HUB services, pharmacies, and internal cross-functional partners. The FRM ensures a positive customer experience by delivering clear guidance, resolving issues efficiently, and supporting timely and appropriate patient access to therapy.
